paper.title: Second-Moment Memory in Coordinatewise Adam
paper.abstract: Adam retains a moving average of past squared gradients in its denominator, but the optimization cost of this memory is not well understood. We show that second-moment memory can itself suppress progress toward the optimum even under finite-variance stochastic gradients. For a simple two-point oracle, the expected positive normalized update is $O(M_2^{-1/2})$ after an initialization transient, where $M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}$ is the second-moment memory length. summary.core_problem: Adam 的二阶矩 EMA 会把历史 squared gradient 长期保留在分母中；论文研究这种 memory 在有限方差随机梯度下是否本身就会拖慢优化。
summary.importance: 对理解 AdamW 类优化器在大模型训练中的动态有理论启发。长 β2 memory 不只在重尾噪声下有问题；即使梯度方差有限，罕见大梯度的平方也会在分母中残留，持续压制后续正常更新。这为 β2 选择、梯度异常值处理以及 ADOPT/AdaShift 类修改提供了下界视角。但结论来自凸问题构造，不能直接当作 Transformer 训练的经验结论。
summary.technical_approach: 在单坐标、batch size 1、β1=0、固定 β2 的坐标式 Adam 上分析。定义 M2=(1−β2)^−1 为二阶矩记忆长度。构造 two-point oracle：恒定正梯度均值 μ 加有限方差噪声；罕见负异常值概率 ρ=1−β2、幅度 Γ=Θ(ρ^−1/2)，因此 ρΓ²=Θ(1)，方差不发散。异常值复发时间与 v_t 的遗忘时间都约为 M2。一次异常值把常数阶质量写入 v_t，之后分母保持较大；低信号区间分子的正向补偿只有 sqrt(ρ) 阶，导致期望正向归一化更新为 O(M2^−1/2)。再把该方向界转化为一维光滑凸问题上的平均平稳性下界：在 M2^{3/2}≤T 且步长不超过 M2/T 时，Adam 至少为 1/2 M2^−1/2；无记忆对照为 Oκ(M2^−1)。令 M2=T^{2s}，得到 T^−s 与 T^−2s 的速率差，s∈(0,1/3]。
summary.experiments: 没有深度学习实验。关键结果是解析界：在 Δ=L=σ=1 的凸问题上，长二阶矩记忆使平均平稳性下界为 1/2 M2^−1/2；初始化瞬态贡献总计不超过约 2M2。无记忆更新在同一构造上快约一个 M2 因子。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看引言和“Effect of second-moment memory”一节，理解 two-point oracle 与主定理的缩放关系即可，约 15–20 分钟。证明细节可跳过；若关注优化器理论，可对照 Yu et al. 的 corridor lower bound 以及 AdaShift/ADOPT 对时间错配的修改。

summary_en.core_problem: Adam keeps an exponential moving average of past squared gradients in its denominator. The paper asks whether this second-moment memory can itself slow optimization, even when stochastic gradients have finite variance.
summary_en.importance: It is relevant to understanding AdamW-style optimizer dynamics in large-scale training. Long β2 memory is not only problematic under heavy-tailed noise: with finite variance, a rare large gradient can leave its square in the denominator and suppress ordinary updates for many steps. This gives a lower-bound perspective on β2 tuning, gradient outliers, and modifications such as ADOPT or AdaShift. The evidence is from constructed convex problems, not transformer training, so it should be read as mechanism analysis rather than an empirical recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis is coordinatewise Adam on a single coordinate with batch size one, β1=0, and fixed β2. M2=(1−β2)^−1 is the second-moment memory length. A two-point oracle uses a constant positive mean μ plus finite-variance noise: a rare negative outlier has probability ρ=1−β2 and magnitude Γ=Θ(ρ^−1/2), so ρΓ²=Θ(1) and variance stays finite. The outlier recurrence time matches the forgetting time of v_t. One outlier writes constant-order mass into v_t, keeping the denominator large; in the low-signal regime the numerator’s positive compensation is only sqrt(ρ), so the expected positive normalized update is O(M2^−1/2). This directional bound is converted into an average-stationarity lower bound on a one-dimensional smooth convex problem: for M2^{3/2}≤T and stepsizes at most M2/T, Adam has stationarity at least 1/2 M2^−1/2, while a memoryless comparison achieves Oκ(M2^−1). Setting M2=T^{2s} yields rates T^−s versus T^−2s for s∈(0,1/3].
summary_en.experiments: There are no deep-learning experiments. The main results are analytical bounds on a constructed convex problem with Δ=L=σ=1: long second-moment memory gives an average stationarity lower bound of 1/2 M2^−1/2, while the initialization transient contributes at most about 2M2 in total. A memoryless update is faster by roughly a factor of M2 on the same instance.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, read the introduction and the section on the effect of second-moment memory; the two-point oracle and scaling of the main theorem are the key parts, about 15–20 minutes. Proof details can be skipped. For optimizer-theory context, compare this with the corridor lower bound in Yu et al. and with temporal-mismatch fixes in AdaShift and ADOPT.

recommendation.zh: 只看主定理和构造例：它提醒 β2 不是免费稳定器，长记忆在某些噪声结构下会吃掉有效步长。
recommendation.en: Read the main theorem and construction: β2 is not a free stabilizer, and long memory can consume effective step size under certain noise structures.

paper.title: A Reproducibility Study of Partial Residual Ablations in Pre-LN Transformers
paper.abstract: Residual connections are a fundamental component of transformer architectures, yet the roles of the attention and feed-forward residual pathways remain poorly understood when considered independently. This paper presents a reproducibility study of partial residual ablations in Pre-LN GPT-style transformers trained at two scales (10M and 124M parameters).   I compare four architectural configurations by selectively removing the attention residual connection, the feed-forward residual connection,

summary.core_problem: Pre-LN GPT 风格 Transformer 中，attention 残差与 FFN 残差各自承担什么作用，移除其中之一会如何影响训练。
summary.importance: 原理分析/可复现性研究：在 10M 与 124M 两个尺度用多 seed 对照四种残差配置，并修正了原实验中的一个 runtime 测量混淆。
summary.technical_approach: 选择性移除 attention 残差（FFNOnly）、FFN 残差（AttnOnly）、或两者（No-Residual），在受控 8-seed 设置下比较 loss/性能；属于消融复现而非新架构。
summary.experiments: 10M 与 124M Pre-LN GPT；FFNOnly 在所有设置下确定性塌缩到 No-Residual 底线；AttnOnly 在 10M 出现可复现的恢复效应，但 124M 因 seed 方差大尚无定论；修正了原 runtime 测量 confound。

summary_en.core_problem: What distinct roles the attention and feed-forward residual pathways play in Pre-LN GPT-style transformers, and what happens when each is ablated.
summary_en.importance: Reproducibility/analysis: compares four residual configurations at 10M and 124M parameters with multiple seeds and corrects a runtime measurement confound in the original setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: Selectively removes the attention residual (FFNOnly), the FFN residual (AttnOnly), or both (No-Residual), under a controlled 8-seed deterministic study; this is an ablation reproduction, not a new architecture.
summary_en.experiments: 10M and 124M Pre-LN GPTs; FFNOnly deterministically collapses to the No-Residual floor across settings; AttnOnly shows a reproducible recovery effect at 10M, but behavior at 124M is unresolved due to substantial seed variance; a runtime measurement confound was identified and corrected.

recommendation.zh: 小规模残差消融，结论受 seed 方差限制；作为'FFN 残差比 attention 残差更关键'的弱信号备查，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Small-scale residual ablation with seed-variance caveats; treat as weak evidence that FFN residuals matter more than attention residuals, don't over-read.

paper.title: Language models suffer from a curse of ambiguity
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on sampling as a driver of their own improvement, making the fidelity of their learned distributions more critical than ever. Yet, not all distributions are equally easy to learn. In this work, we identify a curse of ambiguity: in large language models, and more broadly in all neural networks that produce discrete probability distributions, the more ambiguous a next-token distribution is, the harder it is to learn accurately. Through an extensive theoretic

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个比“会不会预测下一个 token”更细的问题：当真实下一词分布本身是多峰、分散、存在多个合理续写时，神经网络为什么会系统性地学不好这类分布。作者把这个现象定义为“ambiguity curse”。这里的 ambiguity 不是语言学里狭义歧义，而是指目标分布把概率质量摊在更多 token 上。论文的核心结论是：对离散分布建模的神经网络，尤其是自回归语言模型，目标分布越“散”，越难被准确表示、存储和优化拟合；困难不只体现在 top-1 错误，而是体现在整个条件分布的保真度上。这直接触及一个当前很现实的问题：如果模型越来越依赖 sampling、on-policy RL、合成数据自举和 test-time search，那么“尾部概率和次优候选是否被学对”就不再是边角问题，而是训练闭环能否稳定工作的前提。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“为什么模型在不确定上下文里分布学不准”从经验现象推进到可分析对象，给出了架构层和学习层两类根因，而不是停留在 calibration 不好这种描述。第二，它提醒预训练目标的难点并不只来自长程依赖或知识容量，还来自条件熵本身；同样数量的 token，不同 ambiguity 的学习难度并不相同，这对 scaling law、data curriculum、loss reweighting、synthetic data 设计都有直接影响。第三，它解释了很多后训练现象为什么会受限：RL 只能强化模型采样得到的轨迹，推理时的多样性搜索依赖模型先把概率铺开，合成数据闭环也要求模型别过早塌缩到少数 continuation。贡献量级上，这不是一个新架构或新 recipe，而是一个关于 AR LM 学习动力学的基础性诊断框架，价值在于它给后续方法设计提供了明确的受力点。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上，作者先把自回归 LM 重新表述成“context embedding 到 next-token distribution 的分类问题”。Transformer backbone 产出上下文向量 e，最后一层线性 head W 加 softmax 生成词表分布。论文刻意先把 backbone 固定，只分析最后线性层，因为它是唯一直接把表示映射到词表分布的部件，也决定了回传到 backbone 的梯度形态。理论部分采用一个可控 toy setting：每个上下文对应一个大小为 k 的随机 support，目标分布在 support 上均匀，k 用来控制 ambiguity；真实语料中的非均匀分布则用 effective support size，也就是 exp(entropy)，来度量。

作者把 curse 拆成两类来源。架构根因方面，结论是更高 ambiguity 的分布需要更大的“存储容量”和更高维的 embedding 才能在给定误差下被表示。直观上，k=1 时只需把一个 token 从其余 token 中分离出来；k>1 时需要同时为多个 token 保持相近高 logit，并与大量非 support token 拉开间隔，这对线性可分性和几何表示都更苛刻。论文分析了随机 embedding 与可联合优化 embedding 两种情形：前者展示在固定 h 下误差如何随 k 恶化，后者说明即便允许最优表示，embedding 维度仍需随 ambiguity 增长，否则无法同时容纳足够多彼此不同的高熵目标分布。

学习根因方面，作者分析了梯度和采样噪声。训练时我们并不直接看到目标分布 p，而是从 p 采样一个 token 做交叉熵更新。对高 ambiguity 上下文，单个样本只暴露 support 中一个 token，导致梯度对完整分布的估计方差更大；换句话说，同样一次 SGD 更新，对 k 大的分布提供的信息更少、更噪。论文进一步给出优化步数需求随 ambiguity 增长的理论结果：要把预测分布拟合到同等精度，需要更多样本和更多步数。这里的关键不是 label smoothing 那种人为加熵，而是真实条件分布的熵越高，token-level sampling 对分布学习越低效。

实证部分分三层推进。第一层是严格受控的合成实验，单独训练 logistic head 或小网络，验证表示误差、所需维度、收敛速度、梯度噪声都随 k 变差。第二层是在真实语言模型上做上下文分桶，按下一词分布的 effective support 或 entropy 分析 loss、拟合误差、训练动态，观察到与理论一致的 signature。第三层是规模外推：作者论证这些现象在更大模型上仍存在，不会因为参数变大而自动消失，只是阈值后移。与已有工作相比，这篇论文的区别不在于提出新的 uncertainty metric，而在于把“高熵目标更难学”具体落实到最后层几何、样本复杂度和 token sampling 噪声三个机制上，并把它们连到 LM 训练闭环。
summary.experiments:
关键实验重点不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是几类稳定出现的趋势。合成任务里，作者控制 support size k，发现当 k 增大时：1）在固定 head 容量和 embedding 维度下，预测分布与真分布的误差显著上升；2）若想维持同等误差，需要更大的表示维度 h；3）优化收敛明显变慢，需要更多训练步；4）基于 sampled token 的梯度方差更高，训练噪声更大。论文还比较了随机 embedding 与联合学习 embedding 的情形，说明问题不只是表示学得不好，而是目标本身对几何容量有更高要求。

在真实数据实验中，作者不再假设均匀 support，而是用 effective support size=exp(H(p)) 来衡量 ambiguity。结果显示，高 ambiguity 上下文在训练中 loss 更高、下降更慢，模型对完整 next-token 分布的拟合更差；这种差异不是只体现在 top-1 accuracy，而是体现在概率质量分配上。论文还展示了类似现象在完整 LM 而非孤立线性头中依然存在，说明最后层分析抓住了主导瓶颈而不是纯 toy artifact。

从摘要和正文可确认的定量信息主要是：理论与实验都围绕 support size k、embedding dimension h、训练步数以及 effective support size 展开；真实语料部分强调 signature 在更大模型上仍可见。若精读时需要具体数值，建议直接看实验图中不同 k/h 配置下的误差曲线、收敛曲线和梯度噪声统计，因为论文的主要信息承载在趋势图而不是单个表格汇总。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题定义 → 架构根因 → 学习根因 → 真实 LM 验证”这个顺序读。

先看 Introduction 和第 2 节，重点理解作者为什么把 AR LM 视作 context classification，以及为什么 ambiguity 用 uniform-support toy model 和 effective support size 两套定义。这里决定了后面理论是否成立，也决定你会不会把结论误读成“高 entropy token 本来就 loss 大”这种平凡命题。

第 3 节最值得精读。要抓住两个问题：固定容量时为什么高 ambiguity 更难存储；固定误差时为什么需要更高 embedding 维度。读图时不要只看结论，要看作者如何把“多个合理 token”转成线性头几何约束。若你关心 tokenizer、词表大小、输出层设计，这一节最有延展空间。

第 4 节建议连同附录一起看。这里讨论优化步数和 token sampling 噪声，是和预训练 recipe 最相关的部分。重点看梯度方差如何随 ambiguity 变化，以及为什么 sampled-token CE 对高熵目标特别低效。这部分会自然联想到是否需要多样本目标、soft target、teacher distribution、sequence-level credit 或 curriculum。

第 5 节主要看两类图：一类是合成实验验证理论斜率和趋势；另一类是真实 LM 中按 ambiguity 分桶后的 loss/拟合差异。读到这里要问两个问题：这些现象是否会被更大模型消除；如果不会，最可能的工程干预点在哪里。预计精读时间 60–90 分钟，若只抓主线，30 分钟可读完正文核心。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in autoregressive language modeling: when the true next-token distribution is genuinely spread over multiple plausible continuations, neural networks learn that distribution less faithfully. The authors call this the curse of ambiguity. Here, ambiguity means that probability mass is distributed over more tokens, not merely linguistic ambiguity in the narrow sense. The central claim is that for neural networks producing discrete distributions, and especially for AR LMs, higher-ambiguity targets are harder to represent, store, and fit. The issue is not just worse top-1 prediction. It is degraded fidelity of the full conditional distribution. That matters because modern LM improvement increasingly depends on sampling, on-policy RL, synthetic data bootstrapping, and inference-time search, all of which require the model to assign sensible probability mass beyond the single most likely token.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is threefold. First, it turns an empirical complaint—models are poorly calibrated in uncertain contexts—into a mechanistic object of study with architectural and optimization roots. Second, it suggests that learning difficulty in pretraining is shaped not only by sequence length, knowledge content, or model size, but also by conditional entropy itself. Two contexts with the same token count can impose very different learning burdens depending on how diffuse the target distribution is. That has implications for scaling laws, data curricula, loss weighting, tokenizer design, and synthetic data generation. Third, it clarifies why several post-training methods hit a ceiling: RL can only reinforce sampled trajectories, search-based inference needs probability mass to be spread over viable branches, and self-generated corpora become fragile if the model collapses too early onto a narrow set of continuations. This is not a new architecture paper. It is a foundational diagnosis of AR LM learning dynamics, useful because it identifies where interventions might matter.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper reframes autoregressive language modeling as context classification. A Transformer backbone maps a context to an embedding e, and the final linear head W plus softmax maps that embedding to a vocabulary distribution. The analysis first isolates this last layer while treating the backbone representations as given. That choice is deliberate: the output head is the only component that directly parameterizes the next-token distribution, and it also shapes the gradients flowing back into the backbone.

The theoretical setup is a controlled toy model. Each context is associated with a target distribution that is uniform over a random support set of size k. The support size k controls ambiguity. For real, non-uniform language distributions, ambiguity is measured by effective support size, exp(H(p)), which reduces to k in the uniform-support setting.

The authors then separate the curse into architectural and learning roots. On the architectural side, they show that more ambiguous target distributions require more storage capacity and larger embedding dimensions to be represented to a fixed accuracy. Intuitively, predicting one correct token is geometrically easier than assigning similarly high logits to many plausible tokens while separating them from the rest of the vocabulary. The paper studies both random embeddings and jointly optimized embeddings. The first shows degradation at fixed hidden dimension h as k grows. The second shows that even with optimal embeddings, the required representation dimension still increases with ambiguity.

On the learning side, the key issue is token-sampling noise. Training does not observe the full target distribution p directly. It observes one sampled token from p and updates with cross-entropy. For high-ambiguity contexts, a single sample reveals only one element of a larger support, so the stochastic gradient is a noisier estimator of the full distributional objective. The paper derives that fitting such targets to the same precision requires more optimization steps and more samples. The point is not that entropy makes the loss numerically larger. The point is that token-level supervision becomes a less efficient channel for learning the full conditional distribution as ambiguity increases.

Empirically, the paper proceeds in three stages. First, controlled synthetic experiments validate the predicted trends in representation error, required dimension, convergence speed, and gradient noise. Second, real-language-model analyses bucket contexts by ambiguity and show analogous signatures in training dynamics and distribution fitting. Third, the authors argue that scaling model size does not remove the phenomenon; it only shifts the regime where it becomes visible. Relative to prior work, the contribution is not a new uncertainty metric. It is the decomposition of the problem into output-layer geometry, sample complexity, and token-sampling noise, tied back to practical LM training.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental contribution is mostly in the consistency of the observed trends rather than in a single benchmark number. In synthetic settings, the authors vary support size k and show that as k increases: (1) the error between predicted and true distributions rises at fixed head capacity and embedding dimension, (2) maintaining the same error requires larger hidden dimension h, (3) optimization slows down and needs more steps, and (4) sampled-token training induces higher gradient variance. They also compare random embeddings with jointly learned embeddings, showing that the problem is not merely poor representation learning but a genuine increase in geometric and statistical difficulty.

On real data, the paper replaces uniform support size with effective support size exp(H(p)) as the ambiguity measure. Contexts with higher ambiguity exhibit higher loss, slower fitting, and worse approximation of the full next-token distribution. Importantly, the gap is not only in top-1 behavior. It appears in probability allocation across plausible continuations. The same qualitative signatures remain visible in full language models rather than only isolated linear heads, which supports the claim that the simplified analysis captures a real bottleneck.

The quantitative setup explicitly revolves around support size k, hidden dimension h, optimization steps, and effective support size. For close reading, the most informative artifacts are the plots showing error versus k, convergence versus k, and gradient-noise statistics, rather than any single summary table.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of problem setup, architectural roots, learning roots, then real-LM validation.

Start with the introduction and the formalization section. The key is to understand why the authors cast AR LM as context classification, and why they use both a uniform-support toy model and effective support size for real distributions. Without that, it is easy to misread the result as the trivial statement that high-entropy targets have higher loss.

Section 3 deserves the closest attention. Focus on two questions: why higher ambiguity requires more storage capacity, and why it demands larger embedding dimension at fixed error. The useful part is the geometry of the output layer: how multiple plausible tokens translate into stricter linear constraints. If you care about tokenization, vocabulary size, or output-layer design, this section has the most room for extension.

Section 4 is the most relevant for training recipe design. Read it together with the appendix if possible. The important part is how gradient variance scales with ambiguity, and why sampled-token cross-entropy is especially inefficient for high-entropy targets. This naturally connects to ideas such as soft targets, teacher distributions, multi-sample supervision, sequence-level credit assignment, or curricula.

In Section 5, focus on two kinds of figures: synthetic validations of the theoretical trends, and real-LM analyses stratified by ambiguity. The practical question to keep in mind is whether scale alone can wash out the effect. The paper argues it cannot. A careful read takes about 60–90 minutes; a focused pass over the main argument takes around 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 应读理论和真实 LM signature；它会改变“只要 CE 够低分布就学准”的默认想法，并影响采样自训练设计。
recommendation.en: Read the theory and real-LM signatures; it weakens the default belief that low CE means faithful distributions, and it matters for sampling-based self-training.

paper.title: Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner
paper.abstract: Capability development is routinely inferred from behavioural thresholds, from final checkpoints, or from what a decoder can read out of a hidden state. These quantities need not identify the same event. We study a 30M-parameter recurrent-depth relational reasoner in a closed, oracle-defined world, using dense behavioural trajectories, two training surfaces, preregistered pre-arrival hidden-state probes, prospectively checked evaluability, and explicit untrained and negative controls, holding th

summary.core_problem: 在评估模型是否“掌握”某种能力时，仅依赖行为阈值（如 held-out 准确率）或隐藏状态探针（probe）是不充分的。行为表现、内部状态可读性和最终检查点分析这三种测量方式往往不一致，且这种不一致本身无法说明模型实际学到了什么计算机制。
summary.importance: 通过在一个受控的封闭关系世界中，使用循环深度推理器（recurrent-depth reasoner）进行严格的对比实验，揭示了行为测量和可访问性测量的局限性。这提醒预训练和机制可解释性研究者，不能简单地将行为阈值等同于能力获得，必须引入因果分析来确认模型学到的真实计算机制。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个包含固定实体和关系的封闭世界，使用 30M 参数的循环深度 Transformer，通过跳数深度（hop-depth）课程进行训练。设计了两种表达相同关系任务的训练表面（symbolic 和 verbal）。通过密集记录行为轨迹、预注册的隐藏状态探针、前瞻性检查的可评估性以及显式的未训练和负对照，严格区分训练时间和推理时间轴，对比分析模型在不同表面上的能力发展过程。
summary.experiments: 实验发现：1. 行为发展具有隐藏结构。在保持其他条件不变的情况下，仅改变训练表面，会导致截然不同的获取成本和发展形态（例如，三跳能力在 symbolic 表面耗时 70 个逻辑 epoch，而在 verbal 表面耗时 13,055 个，差异达 186.5 倍）。2. 在模型行为上输出正确答案之前，隐藏状态中就已经存在关于未来答案的微弱、异质信息（在 verbal 表面），且这种现象在 symbolic 表面也存在。3. 即使是更丰富的观察（如追踪训练过程中的到达前可访问性）也存在识别限制，因为探针的适用群体是由正在研究的行为事件定义的。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对三种常用测量方式（行为、内部、回顾）的批判，以及 Experimental setting 中对封闭世界、循环深度模型和两种训练表面的精心设计。理解作者为何强调区分训练时间和推理时间，以及为何得出“行为和可访问性测量不足以识别获得的计算，必须进行因果分析”的结论。

summary_en.core_problem: When evaluating whether a model has 'acquired' a capability, relying solely on behavioral thresholds (e.g., held-out accuracy) or hidden-state probes is insufficient. Behavioral performance, internal state readability, and final checkpoint analysis often disagree, and this disagreement itself does not reveal the actual computational mechanism the model has learned.
summary_en.importance: Through rigorous comparative experiments in a controlled, closed relational world using a recurrent-depth reasoner, this paper exposes the limitations of behavioral and accessibility measurements. It serves as a crucial reminder to pre-training and mechanistic interpretability researchers that behavioral thresholds cannot be simply equated with capability acquisition; causal analysis is necessary to confirm the true computational mechanisms learned by the model.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructed a closed world with fixed entities and relations, employing a 30M-parameter recurrent-depth Transformer trained via a hop-depth curriculum. Designed two training surfaces (symbolic and verbal) expressing the same relational tasks. By densely recording behavioral trajectories, using preregistered hidden-state probes, prospectively checked evaluability, and explicit untrained and negative controls, the study strictly separates training-time and inference-time axes to comparatively analyze capability development across different surfaces.
summary_en.experiments: Findings include: 1. Behavioral development has hidden structure. Changing only the training surface while holding other conditions constant leads to radically different acquisition costs and developmental shapes (e.g., 3-hop competence cost 70 logical epochs on the symbolic surface vs. 13,055 on the verbal surface, a 186.5x difference). 2. Weak, heterogeneous information about the future answer is present in the hidden state before the model behaviorally produces it (on the verbal surface), and this phenomenon persists on the symbolic surface. 3. Even richer observations (like tracking pre-arrival accessibility across training) have identification limits because the eligible population for the probe is defined by the behavioral event being studied.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction's critique of the three common measurement methods (behavioral, internal, retrospective) and the careful design of the closed world, recurrent-depth model, and two training surfaces in the Experimental setting. Understand why the authors emphasize separating training time from inference time, and why they conclude that 'behavioral and accessibility measurements alone are insufficient to identify the acquired computation, and the next step must be causal.'

recommendation.zh: 小模型但控制极干净，直接动摇“看held-out准确率判断能力是否学到了”的习惯，训练过程中内部表征先于行为到位的结论对理解grokking与annealing有参考，只看行为-内部解耦那几张图即可。
recommendation.en: Small model but unusually clean controls; it undermines the habit of reading capability onset from held-out accuracy, and the internal-knowledge-before-behavior finding is relevant to grokking and annealing—just read the behavior-vs-probe decoupling figures.

paper.title: When Do Concepts Become Functionally Sufficient During Language-Model Training?
paper.abstract: Understanding a model and its learning mechanisms in depth requires identifying when its internal structures become useful, rather than simply looking at the final state. We study this through concept dynamics: at each layer and checkpoint, we decompose activations, select sparse soft masks, and inject masked reconstructions into the model. Concept analysis is therefore tested functionally: a mask is useful only insofar as it preserves a target under intervention. We compare sufficiency for acti

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究语言模型训练过程中，内部“概念”在什么时候不仅能被分解或线性读出，而且足以支撑模型原本的预测行为。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于提供了一套观察训练动态的干预工具。它把“表示里有信息”和“模型实际使用这些信息”分开测量。对分析 checkpoint、层深、学习阶段、表征迁移都有用，尤其适合研究预训练中能力何时出现、哪些结构只是可解码、哪些结构已经进入模型计算路径。它不是直接改进预训练 recipe 的论文，但能帮助解释训练过程中的功能性表征形成。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 concept-mask intervention。对每个 checkpoint 和 layer，先在训练 split 上拟合一种 activation decomposition，例如 SVD、ICA、NMF、SemiNMF 或 sparse dictionary，同时得到 code、dictionary 和 affine reconstruction baseline。候选维度 Kmax 用训练激活的 two-nearest-neighbor intrinsic-dimension estimate 估计，并做保守裁剪。然后在 calibration split 上学习一个 sparse soft mask，mask 通过带温度的连续门控表示，并用 Adam 优化，目标函数包含 preservation loss 和 sparsity penalty。最后在 test split 上把 masked reconstruction 注入原模型计算图，直接测干预后的行为。论文比较四类 preservation target：第一是几何重构，即保留归一化后的激活方差；第二是 fixed-head decodability，用一个 affine translator 接到固定输出头，测试信息是否容易被读出；第三是 native downstream preservation，把重构后的激活送入原模型后续层，用 KL 保持原预测分布；第四是 checkpoint transfer，用学习到的 affine alignment 测试早期 checkpoint 的概念是否能重构最终 checkpoint 的表示。这个设计把 decomposition 只当作候选坐标系，而不是把分解结果直接视为语义概念。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个带 checkpoint 的语言模型，并报告不同目标下的 sparse operating point、checkpoint profile 和 depth profile。关键观察是：重构误差低、线性可解码和真实下游保持不是同一个性质；某些信息可以存在于激活中，也可以被 probe 读出，但干预后未必能保持模型原预测。native downstream KL 更接近“模型是否实际使用该结构”。checkpoint transfer 部分用于观察早期结构与最终结构之间是否可对齐。给出的正文片段没有列出具体模型名称、参数量、数据规模和数值提升，因此不宜补造数字；可确认的是实验重点在不同 preservation objective 的差异，而不是单一性能指标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Concept-Mask Interventions 一节，重点理解 train/cal/test 分离、soft mask、Ksoft/Khard、masked activation 注入原计算图的流程。然后看 Preservation Objectives 一节，四个目标函数是全文最核心的技术内容，尤其要区分 reconstruction、fixed-head decodability 和 native downstream KL。结果部分可重点看 checkpoint-by-layer 的 profile 图，以及不同 decomposition 方法在相同 preservation target 下的稀疏度和 KL 曲线。预计 20–30 分钟可完成方法层面的泛读；如果做 mechanistic interpretability 或训练动态分析，需要细读附录中的 Kmax 设置、mask 优化稳定性和 transfer alignment。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when internal concepts during language-model training become functionally sufficient, rather than merely reconstructable or linearly decodable.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is methodological. It provides an intervention-based way to inspect training dynamics across checkpoints and layers. The key distinction is between information that is present in activations and information that the model actually uses for prediction. This is useful for studying when capabilities become operational, how representations stabilize, and how early checkpoint structures relate to the final model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework is a concept-mask intervention pipeline. For each layer and checkpoint, an activation decomposition is fitted on a training split, using methods such as SVD, ICA, NMF, SemiNMF, or sparse dictionaries. The decomposition provides codes, a dictionary, and a reconstruction baseline. A conservative candidate width Kmax is estimated from training activations using a two-nearest-neighbor intrinsic-dimension estimate with clipping. On a calibration split, the method learns a sparse soft mask with temperature-controlled gates, optimized with Adam under a preservation objective plus a sparsity penalty. On the test split, the masked reconstruction is inserted back into the original model graph. The paper compares four preservation targets: geometric reconstruction, fixed-head decodability through an affine translator, native downstream preservation through the remaining model layers measured by KL to the original predictions, and checkpoint transfer through a learned affine alignment from an earlier checkpoint to the final checkpoint. The important design choice is that decomposition coordinates are treated as hypotheses, not as guaranteed semantic concepts.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover seven checkpointed language models and report target-conditional sparse operating points, depth profiles, and checkpoint profiles. The main empirical message is that reconstruction quality, linear decodability, and native behavioral preservation can diverge. A component may reconstruct activations or support a probe while failing to preserve the model’s own prediction distribution under intervention. Native downstream KL is therefore a closer test of functional use. The transfer experiments examine whether concepts from earlier checkpoints can be aligned to final-checkpoint structures. The provided text does not include the full model list, parameter counts, data scales, or exact numeric tables, so the safe reading is qualitative: the contribution is the intervention protocol and the comparison among preservation notions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Concept-Mask Interventions section first. The critical details are the train/cal/test split, soft mask learning, Ksoft and Khard reporting, and insertion of masked activations into the original computation graph. Then read the Preservation Objectives section carefully; the four objectives define the paper’s main contribution. In the results, focus on checkpoint-by-layer profiles and on cases where reconstruction or fixed-head decodability diverges from native downstream KL. A method-level skim should take about 20–30 minutes. For work on training dynamics or mechanistic interpretability, also inspect the appendix details on Kmax, mask optimization, and transfer alignment.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是直接改 recipe，但会提醒你别再把“可解码=已学会”当真；重点看功能干预设定和 checkpoint transfer，适合做训练动态的人读。
recommendation.en: This will not change your recipe directly, but it is a useful warning against equating decodability with learned function. Read the intervention setup and checkpoint-transfer analysis if you care about training dynamics.

paper.title: Quantifying Depth Sufficiency in Residual Neural Networks: A First-Order Criterion
paper.abstract: How can we determine whether a trained neural network is already deep enough? We study this under a fixed function-preserving residual-growth protocol specifying insertion locations, residual families, zero-output initializations, and zero-state first-order updates. We define first-order residual depth saturation as the absence of a strict local decrease from every admissible insertion. We prove residual non-degeneracy is necessary and sufficient: additional depth has first-order value exactly w

summary.core_problem: 如何判断一个训练好的残差网络是否已经'足够深'，再加层是否还有一阶收益。
summary.importance: 原理分析：给出深度饱和的一阶判据，并在 ResNet、GPT-2 风格模型和 Pythia 持续预训练 checkpoint 上验证，对理解训练后期加层/继续训练有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 在函数保持的残差增长协议（指定插入位置、残差族、零输出初始化、零状态一阶更新）下，定义一阶残差深度饱和；证明残差非退化是充要条件：当条件激活梯度在某个可接受残差切空间上有非零投影时，加深度才有一阶价值；在残差信号可实现条件下，原始激活梯度消失恰好证明饱和。
summary.experiments: 在 ResNet、GPT-2 风格模型、持续预训练的 Pythia checkpoint 上观察最大激活梯度范数随深度趋于零，与饱和判据一致。

summary_en.core_problem: How to determine whether a trained residual network is already deep enough, i.e., whether adding layers still has first-order value.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis offering a first-order depth-saturation criterion, validated on ResNets, GPT-2-style models, and continually-pretrained Pythia checkpoints; relevant to understanding late-stage layer growth and continued pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under a function-preserving residual-growth protocol (insertion locations, residual families, zero-output init, zero-state first-order updates), defines first-order residual depth saturation and proves residual non-degeneracy is necessary and sufficient: added depth has first-order value iff conditional activation gradients have nonzero projection onto some admissible residual tangent space. Under residual-signal realizability, raw activation-gradient vanishing certifies saturation.
summary_en.experiments: Across ResNets, GPT-2-style models, and continued-pretrained Pythia checkpoints, the maximum activation-gradient norm decays toward zero, consistent with the saturation criterion.

recommendation.zh: 理论味较重但 GPT-2/Pythia 实验让它和'继续预训练是否还吃深度'沾边；看定理陈述和 Pythia 曲线即可，证明可跳。
recommendation.en: Mostly theory, but the GPT-2/Pythia experiments touch on whether continued pretraining still benefits from depth; read the theorem statement and Pythia curves, skip proofs.

paper.title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study
paper.abstract: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, wit

summary.core_problem: 度量神经网络训练轨迹中的短期可预测性，判断哪些参数、哪些训练阶段、哪些训练条件下，近期更新能预测未来参数运动。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练动态分析。它把“训练轨迹是否存在时间冗余”做成可测量对象，并覆盖 CIFAR 视觉训练和公开 Pythia 预训练 checkpoint，对理解 checkpoint 间隔、训练状态压缩、参数组动态差异有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文组合三类 probe：位移方向 probe、子空间残差 probe、预测器 probe，并用 convention-aware、null-calibrated 的组级读数减少坐标约定和随机基线的干扰。分析对象区分归一化参数、bias 等 auxiliary parameters 与矩阵型 feature-transforming weights。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多轮 CIFAR 视觉训练和公开 Pythia 预训练 checkpoint。摘要报告的主要发现是：辅助参数的短期动态更简单、更可预测；矩阵型主体参数的可预测性只在局部、随时间变化的区域出现，并且多种 probe 的结果相互一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures short-horizon predictability in neural training trajectories: where, when, and under what conditions recent updates predict near-future parameter motion.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is training-dynamics analysis. It turns temporal redundancy in optimization trajectories into a measurable object and includes both CIFAR vision training and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints, making it mildly relevant to checkpoint scheduling, state compression, and parameter-group diagnostics.
summary_en.technical_approach: It combines three probe families: displacement-direction probes, subspace-residual probes, and predictor-based probes. The readouts are convention-aware and null-calibrated, and the analysis separates auxiliary parameters such as normalization and biases from matrix-like feature-transforming weights.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses multi-pass vision training on CIFAR and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints. The abstract reports that auxiliary parameters have simpler short-horizon dynamics, while bulk matrix parameters show predictability only in localized and time-varying pockets, with agreement across probe families.

recommendation.zh: 看结果图即可：Pythia 上辅助参数更可预测这个信号有趣，但离优化器或 checkpoint 策略还差验证。
recommendation.en: Skim the result figures: the Pythia signal that auxiliary parameters are more predictable is interesting, but not yet an optimizer or checkpointing recipe.

paper.title: Neural Quadratic Forms: A Unified Minimal Model for Sudden Learning and Scaling Laws
paper.abstract: Neural networks trained by gradient descent on a smooth cost function can nevertheless learn in steps: the cost holds on long plateaus and then drops abruptly. Meanwhile, training losses instead follow smooth power laws. Variants of both behaviors occur in architectures with very different microscopic structures, which is the signature of a few relevant collective variables. We show that a symmetry fixes what those variables are: a network layer is a sum over interchangeable units, so relabeling

summary.core_problem: 神经网络训练中两类看似矛盾的规律性现象——单条轨迹上的 plateau-then-drop 阶跃式学习，以及跨模型/数据/计算规模的平滑幂律 scaling law——能否由同一个最小模型统一解释？论文从置换对称性出发，给出了一个普适的二次型展开。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值偏理论侧：它把 matrix sensing、phase retrieval、diagonal/quadratic networks、deep linear networks 等 17 个此前各自独立分析的可解代理模型统一到同一个 NQF 表达式下，并指出架构差异只通过一个结构矩阵 A(x) 进入。这为理解 feature acquisition 的顺序、plateau 成因以及 scaling law 的谱结构提供了共同语言，但目前主要是 near-origin 小初始化展开，对真实大规模 LLM 训练的定量预测能力仍需后续验证。
summary.technical_approach: 核心观察是：一个由 d 个可交换单元组成的模块（MLP 隐单元、attention head、MoE expert、conv channel）在重标号下不变，即具有 S_d 对称性。在初始化尺度 ε 很小、且单元梯度在原点为零的条件下，对参数空间原点做 Taylor 展开，对称性强制三阶项消失，最低阶非平凡项为 Tr[WW^T A(x)]，外加一个 μ^T g(x) 线性项（多数实际架构中为零）。所有架构特异性被压缩进 p×p 的对称结构矩阵 A(x)，其稀疏模式和耦合由架构和输入决定；序参量是 M=WW^T 而非单个权重。值得注意的是，对 attention 而言，value 和 readout 块在二阶出现，而 Q、K 矩阵要到四阶才进入——这给出了 attention 训练早期动力学的一个具体预测。论文进一步用该二次型推导 excess loss 对 rescaled training time 的幂律，并指出同一谱结构也支配模型/数据规模 scaling。
summary.experiments: 论文以理论构造为主，实验部分用于验证 NQF 对不同架构的统一描述以及 plateau/drop 动力学和幂律拟合。具体数字在提供的全文片段中未完整给出；论文声称 17 个既有可解模型是 NQF 在特定 A 下的特例，并引用大模型二次模型仍定量准确的相关工作作为支撑。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看 Figure 1（NQF 形式与 A(x) 的架构对应）、Theorem 1 的陈述与对称性论证、以及 attention 部分关于 Q/K 到四阶才出现的讨论。对做训练动力学或 scaling law 理论建模的人，这篇提供了一个干净的对称性出发点；对主要做大规模实验的研究员，知道有这样一个统一框架即可，不必深究证明细节。预计精读 1–2 小时，泛读 30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Can two seemingly incompatible regularities of neural network training—step-like plateau-then-drop learning along a single trajectory and smooth power-law scaling across model/data/compute—be explained by one minimal model? The paper derives a universal quadratic expansion from permutation symmetry.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily theoretical. It unifies 17 previously separate solvable proxies—matrix sensing, phase retrieval, diagonal and quadratic networks, deep linear networks, and others—under a single neural quadratic form (NQF), with architectural differences entering only through a structure matrix A(x). This offers a common language for feature acquisition order, plateau formation, and the spectral structure behind scaling laws. It is, however, a near-origin small-initialization expansion; quantitative predictive power for real large-scale LLM training remains to be established.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key observation is that a module of d interchangeable units (hidden units, attention heads, MoE experts, conv channels) is invariant under relabeling, i.e. has S_d symmetry. Under small initialization scale ε and a vanishing-gradient-at-origin condition, a Taylor expansion about the origin has its cubic term killed by symmetry, leaving the leading nontrivial term Tr[WW^T A(x)] plus a linear μ^T g(x) term that vanishes for most practical architectures. All architecture specificity is compressed into a p×p symmetric structure matrix A(x) whose sparsity pattern and couplings are fixed by the architecture and input; the order parameter is M=WW^T rather than individual weights. Notably, for attention the value and readout blocks appear at quadratic order, while Q and K enter only at quartic order—a concrete prediction about early-training dynamics. The same quadratic form is then used to derive a power law for excess loss versus rescaled training time, with the same spectral structure argued to govern model- and data-size scaling.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is primarily a theoretical construction; experiments validate the NQF as a unified description across architectures and its fit to plateau/drop dynamics and power laws. Specific numbers are not fully contained in the available text. The paper claims 17 existing solvable models are special cases of the NQF at particular A, and cites prior work arguing quadratic models remain quantitatively accurate even for large language models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim material. Focus on Figure 1 (the NQF form and how A(x) maps to architecture), the statement of Theorem 1 and its symmetry argument, and the discussion of Q/K appearing only at quartic order in attention. For researchers working on training dynamics or scaling-law theory, it provides a clean symmetry-based starting point; for those mainly running large-scale experiments, awareness of the unifying framework is enough without diving into proofs. Estimated 1–2 hours for a careful read, 30 minutes for a skim.

recommendation.zh: 只看推导假设和跨 attention/MoE 的映射；若实验证据干净，值得加入训练早期动力学 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the assumptions and the attention/MoE reductions; if the evidence is clean, it is worth folding into early-training dynamics ablations.

paper.title: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus
paper.abstract: We present the first systematic study of Massive activations (MAs) in layer-interleaved HLA LLMs and uncover two architecture-aligned morphologies: MAs consistently spike immediately before full attention layers, forming pre-attention spikes (PAS), and can persist through intervening linear attention layers, giving rise to inter-spike plateaus (ISP). As full attention becomes denser, successive PAS become increasingly connected through ISP, ultimately recovering the stable MA morphology of full

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究混合线性注意力 LLM 中的 massive activations 如何随层演化。核心问题不是单纯解释异常大激活，而是回答：当模型把线性注意力层和 full attention 层交错堆叠时，残差流中的少量极大值会被哪些层写入、放大、保留或抵消。这直接关系到混合架构的内部计算方式，因为 full attention 和线性注意力承担的序列混合能力不同，极大激活的层间形态可以作为观察这种分工的探针。
summary.importance: 价值在于把 hybrid linear attention 的内部训练和推理动态讲得更具体。HLA 架构已经出现在 Qwen3-Next、Qwen3.5、Kimi Linear、Kimi K3、Zamba、Nemotron-H 等模型中，但相关研究通常关注吞吐、长上下文和困惑度，较少分析层间信号如何组织。这项工作给出两个稳定现象：full attention 前一层附近出现 pre-attention spikes，full attention 更密时这些高激活会在中间线性注意力层中延续成 inter-spike plateaus。对预训练研究的启发是，混合比例、full attention 放置方式、输出门控都会改变残差流中的异常信号管理方式，不能只用最终 loss 或下游分数判断混合架构是否健康。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把 massive activations 作为层级诊断信号，比较不同 HLA 配置下每层残差表示中的极端激活强度和位置分布。论文定义了两类与架构对齐的形态。第一类是 PAS，即 massive activations 在 full attention 层之前稳定升高，说明线性层可能在为后续 full attention 准备可被聚合或重分配的高幅值信号。第二类是 ISP，即在两个 PAS 之间，极大激活没有很快消失，而是在若干线性注意力层中保持平台状态。随着 full attention 层更密集，PAS 和 ISP 会逐渐融合，接近纯 full attention Transformer 中较稳定的 massive activation 形态。与已有 full attention 模型中的 attention sink / systematic outlier 分析相比，这项工作把“异常激活何时被抵消”作为统一解释：PAS 更像局部的 write-sink-cancel 过程，ISP 则对应延迟抵消。这个视角把 HLA 和普通 Transformer 的现象放到同一个机制框架下，而不是把混合架构当作完全独立的特例。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖推理期表征分析和受控预训练两部分。推理分析横跨五类线性注意力架构、六种混合配置和五个数据域，观察到 PAS 与 ISP 在不同输入域中反复出现。作者还在开源混合模型上验证，包括 Qwen3.5、Kimi Linear、Nemotron-H、Zamba2，模型规模覆盖约 1.2B 到 397B 总参数，说明该现象不是小模型或单一实现的偶然结果。受控预训练部分使用 GDN-based hybrid 模型，规模最高到 1.3B，追踪 PAS 和 ISP 的形成过程。关键发现是这两种形态在训练早期就会出现，并在优化过程中变得更稳定。full attention 输出门控会显著压低 massive activations 的绝对幅度，但不会消除 PAS/ISP 的层间组织；移除 GDN 输出门控只带来相对温和的放大。这说明门控主要调节幅值，而 full attention 的层级位置更决定形态。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Section 3 和 Section 4。Section 3 的重点是不同架构、混合比例、数据域和开源模型中的 PAS/ISP 证据，尤其要看层号与 full attention 位置对齐的图。Section 3.6 和 Appendix D 适合关注训练动态的人，里面的受控预训练能说明这些激活形态是训练中逐步固化的，而不是推理时的后验现象。Section 4 值得细看，它把 PAS、ISP 和 full attention LLM 中的稳定 massive activations 统一到 cancellation timing 上。若只关心工程启发，重点看 full attention 密度、输出门控和极大激活幅度之间的关系；若关心机制分析，重点看 write-sink-cancel 与 delayed cancellation 的证据链。

summary_en.core_problem: This work studies how massive activations evolve across layers in hybrid linear-attention LLMs. The central question is not merely whether outlier activations exist, but how interleaving linear attention and full attention changes when these large residual-stream values are written, amplified, preserved, or cancelled. This matters because full attention and linear attention provide different forms of sequence mixing, and the layerwise morphology of massive activations becomes a useful probe of that division of labor.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly mechanistic and architectural. Hybrid linear-attention models are increasingly used for long-context LLMs, but most discussions focus on throughput, memory, and end-task quality. This paper shows that hybridization induces a recognizable internal organization: massive activations spike immediately before full-attention layers, forming pre-attention spikes, and can persist through intervening linear-attention layers, forming inter-spike plateaus. For pretraining researchers, the implication is that the hybrid ratio, full-attention placement, and output gating affect how the residual stream manages large-magnitude signals. Loss curves and benchmark scores alone may miss these architectural dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses massive activations as a layerwise diagnostic signal. It measures extreme hidden-state entries across depth and compares their morphology under different hybrid configurations. Two architecture-aligned patterns are identified. Pre-attention spikes appear right before full-attention layers, suggesting that preceding layers prepare high-amplitude information for the next full-attention operation. Inter-spike plateaus appear when these activations persist across the linear-attention layers between two full-attention layers. As full attention becomes denser, spikes and plateaus merge into the more stable massive-activation profile observed in full-attention Transformers. The mechanistic account is organized around cancellation timing: PAS follows a localized write-sink-cancel process, while ISP reflects delayed cancellation. This connects hybrid models to prior observations on attention sinks and systematic outliers in standard Transformers.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical analysis covers both inference-time characterization and controlled pretraining. The inference study spans five linear-attention architectures, six hybridization configurations, and five data domains, and finds PAS and ISP consistently. The same organization is reported in representative open-source hybrid models, including Qwen3.5, Kimi Linear, Nemotron-H, and Zamba2, ranging from about 1.2B to 397B total parameters. The controlled pretraining experiments use GDN-based hybrids up to 1.3B parameters. They show that PAS and ISP emerge early and consolidate during optimization. Full-attention output gating strongly reduces the absolute magnitude of massive activations but does not remove their layerwise organization. Removing GDN output gates causes only a more modest amplification. This separates magnitude control from the architectural origin of the PAS/ISP pattern.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 3 closely for the main evidence: the useful figures are the ones aligning activation magnitude with full-attention layer positions across architectures, hybrid ratios, domains, and open-source models. Section 3.6 and Appendix D are the most relevant parts for training-dynamics questions, because they trace when PAS and ISP appear during pretraining and how gating changes their magnitude. Section 4 is the key mechanistic section. It is worth reading if the goal is to connect hybrid attention to the broader literature on attention sinks, systematic outliers, and residual-stream cancellation. For engineering use, focus on the interaction among full-attention density, output gating, and outlier magnitude.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻在内部 HLA 预训练日志里加 PAS/ISP 监控；这比只盯 loss spike 更能定位架构性不稳。
recommendation.en: Add PAS/ISP monitoring to internal HLA pretraining runs; it is a cleaner architecture-level signal than watching loss spikes alone.

paper.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained and deployed with long contexts that span documents, code repositories, and interaction histories. This scaling reflects the implicit assumption that training on longer contexts will only help the model by exposing it to richer evidence. We challenge this view by studying how the context window shapes a model's mode of learning, shifting it between parametric internalization and contextualization. We propose the Information Abundance Paradox, which

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究长上下文训练是否会改变模型学习知识的方式。核心问题是：当训练上下文中包含大量与预测相关的信息时，模型是否会减少把知识写入参数的压力，转而学习依赖上下文证据。作者把这一现象称为 Information Abundance Paradox，并用 context addiction 作为可观测表现：模型在有相关上下文时表现好，但在上下文缺失或误导时退化。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对长上下文预训练有直接影响。当前常见假设是，上下文窗口变长主要带来更多证据，只要数据足够好，训练就会受益。论文提出相反的风险：长上下文不是中性的供数管道，它会改变 cross-entropy 优化下的最优学习策略。模型可以通过读取上下文降低 loss，而不必把同一信息压缩进权重。对基座训练而言，这意味着长上下文扩展可能提高长文建模能力，却削弱闭卷知识、短上下文泛化或无上下文鲁棒性。Phi-3 和 OLMo 3 中长上下文版本在 few-shot / zero-shot 上落后短上下文版本的现象，被用作这一问题的现实动机。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从两个训练场景验证假设。预训练场景中，作者固定 token budget、数据、模型配置和优化设置，只改变训练上下文窗口长度，用连贯文档跨度作为信息丰富度的代理变量。这样可以把“训练了更多 token”与“上下文更长”区分开。监督微调场景中，作者固定上下文长度，直接控制上下文中任务相关信息的多少，用来隔离相关信息本身的作用。理论部分把语言模型训练看成压缩问题，区分参数知识和上下文知识两条预测通道；当上下文提供足够低复杂度的解时，达到相同风险阈值所需写入权重的任务信息会减少。机制分析进一步从三方面支撑这一点：长上下文提供更低复杂度的训练解；参数更新压力从 FFN 更偏向 attention；推理时模型对上下文 token 的依赖增强。
summary.experiments: 预训练实验在 20M、55M、259M、750M 四个参数规模上进行，固定 token 预算、数据和优化 recipe，改变训练 context window。结果呈现倒 U 型：语言建模、自然语言理解、闭卷多选问答会随上下文变长先提升，到中等长度附近达到较好状态，继续增加上下文后反而下降。这说明问题不是单纯的数据质量或训练量不足。监督微调实验显示，当推理时提供有用上下文，训练中见过丰富任务相关上下文的模型准确率更高；但当上下文缺失或被误导时，鲁棒性下降。机制实验显示，长上下文模型更倾向使用上下文 token，训练更新也更集中到 attention 模块，相对减少了通过 FFN 储存可复用知识的压力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Section 2、Section 3、Section 5。Section 2 给出 Information Abundance Paradox 和 context addiction 的定义，是理解实验设计的关键。Section 3.1 最重要，关注固定 token budget 下不同 context window 的预训练对比，以及四个规模上的倒 U 型曲线。Section 3.2 适合看可控 SFT 实验，因为它把“上下文长度”和“任务相关信息量”拆开。Section 4 的理论模型不必逐行推导，但要看风险阈值与参数内化信息量之间的关系。Section 5 值得细读，尤其是 update pressure 从 FFN 转向 attention、推理时上下文依赖增强的分析；这些结果对设计长上下文训练 mixture、短上下文保持、闭卷能力评估都有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: This work asks whether long-context training changes what a model learns to store in its parameters. The core issue is that abundant task-relevant information inside the training context may reduce the pressure to internalize the same information parametrically. The authors call this the Information Abundance Paradox. Its observable form is context addiction: the model performs well when useful context is present, but degrades when the context is absent, incomplete, or misleading.
summary_en.importance: The paper is directly relevant to long-context pretraining. A common assumption is that longer contexts simply expose the model to richer evidence, so better data and longer windows should help. This work argues that the context window also changes the learning strategy induced by next-token cross-entropy. If the model can lower loss by reading evidence from the context, it may store less reusable knowledge in the weights. For foundation-model training, this creates a trade-off: longer contexts can improve contextual prediction while weakening closed-book knowledge, short-context generalization, or robustness without supporting evidence. The paper uses the gap between long-context and short-context variants of Phi-3 and OLMo 3 as motivating evidence that this issue appears in real training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study tests the hypothesis in both pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. In pretraining, the token budget, data, model configuration, and optimization setup are fixed, while the training context window is varied. Coherent document span length serves as a proxy for the amount of available relevant information. This design separates longer-context learning from simply seeing more tokens. In supervised fine-tuning, the context length is fixed and the amount of task-relevant context is directly controlled, isolating relevance from length. The theoretical account treats language modeling as compression with two predictive channels: information stored in parameters and information supplied in context. When context offers a lower-complexity solution, less task information needs to be encoded in the weights to reach the same risk threshold. The mechanistic analyses then connect this to lower-complexity contextual solutions, a shift in update pressure from feed-forward networks toward attention modules, and stronger reliance on context tokens at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The pretraining experiments cover four model scales: 20M, 55M, 259M, and 750M parameters. With fixed token budget, data, architecture, and optimization, varying the training context window produces an inverted-U pattern. Language modeling, natural language understanding, and closed-book multiple-choice QA improve up to an intermediate context length and then decline as the context becomes longer. This suggests that the degradation is not just a data-quality issue. The supervised fine-tuning experiments show a complementary pattern: informative context improves accuracy when such context is available at inference, but training with abundant relevant context reduces robustness when the context is missing or misleading. Mechanistic measurements indicate that longer-context training increases reliance on context tokens and shifts more learning pressure toward attention relative to feed-forward networks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2 first for the definitions of Information Abundance Paradox and context addiction. Section 3.1 is the main pretraining result: focus on the fixed-token-budget comparisons across context windows and the inverted-U curves across the four model scales. Section 3.2 is useful because the SFT setup directly controls task-relevant information and separates relevance from length. Section 4 is worth reading for the risk-threshold argument, but the main takeaway is the reduction in required parametric information when context provides an easier solution. Section 5 is the most useful part for training researchers interested in mechanisms: the analyses of FFN-versus-attention update pressure and inference-time context reliance have direct implications for long-context data mixtures, short-context retention, and closed-book evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对 long-context pretrain 的 prior：别再默认窗口越长越赚，先看它如何把“会背”换成“会找”，建议优先核查实验控制和中间最优点是否稳。
recommendation.en: This one should update your prior on long-context pretraining: longer context may trade memorization for retrieval, so check whether the intermediate optimum survives clean controls before changing recipe.

paper.title: Faster Query-Key Learning Sharpens Attention in Self-Attention Models
paper.abstract: A standard self-attention layer consists of two interacting circuits: the query-key circuit that governs attention allocation, and the output-value circuit that maps attended representations to predictions. Collapsed and factorized parameterizations of the query-key and output-value circuits lead to qualitatively different attention patterns. In particular, some parameterizations give sharper attention to task-relevant tokens, at a similar training loss. We analyze how the parameterizations of t

summary.core_problem: 在相同预测性能下，自注意力模型会出现差异极大的注意力模式；现有理论只解释了 Transformer 的表达能力，没有说明架构参数化方式与梯度优化如何共同塑造注意力结构，特别是 query-key 电路和 output-value 电路的相对学习速度如何影响注意力锐度。
summary.importance: 给出了注意力模式形成的机制性解释：不是表达能力差异，而是参数化和优化速度差异决定了注意力是否集中在任务相关 token 上。对预训练实践的直接启发是：可以通过调整 Q/K 与 O/V 的参数化形式或相对学习率，在不损失训练损失的前提下得到更可解释、更锐利的注意力，而不需要改动模型结构或数据。
summary.technical_approach: 将单层自注意力拆分为两个线性电路：query-key 电路（W_K W_Q^T，决定注意力分布）和 output-value 电路（W_O W_V，将注意力后的表示映射为预测 logits）。对比四种参数化：FAFO（两路都分解）、CAFO（注意力合并、输出分解）、FACO（注意力分解、输出合并）、CACO（两路都合并）。通过梯度流分析证明：分解式参数化会在对应的合并参数空间中引入状态依赖的梯度重缩放，使得分解模型和合并模型即使损失相近，优化轨迹也不同。在正交性与对称性假设下推导出闭式群体梯度流动力学：output-value 标量按 log(t) 增长，query-key 标量按 log^2(t) 增长，增长常数由两路学习率比值 η_QK / η_OV 控制。由于 query-key 电路通过饱和非线性（softmax）作用于注意力，这种增长速度差异直接解释了相对学习速度如何驱动注意力在训练过程中逐渐锐化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖合成数据和三个带 token 级相关性标注的真实数据集：HateXplain、主谓一致数据集、SQuAD。核心观察：1）提升 query-key 电路相对学习速度，或使用分解式 Q/K 参数化，都会让注意力更集中在任务相关 token 上；2）上述改动对预测损失和下游任务指标几乎没有影响；3）合成数据上的参数演化轨迹与闭式动力学推导高度吻合，验证了 log(t) 与 log^2(t) 的增长规律。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 40-60 分钟。重点看：1）Introduction 中对两个电路的拆分和问题定义；2）第 3 节参数化对比与梯度流推导的核心结论（不必深究全部数学细节）；3）第 5 节真实数据实验的注意力可视化与定量指标。值得深挖的点：把该结论推广到多层、多头、大模型预训练的可行性；是否可以通过分组学习率调度直接控制注意力锐度，进而改善长上下文或可解释性。

summary_en.core_problem: Self-attention models with nearly identical predictive performance can develop drastically different attention patterns. Existing theory focuses on Transformer expressivity but does not explain how architectural parameterization and gradient-based optimization jointly shape attention structure — in particular, how the relative learning speed of the query-key circuit and the output-value circuit affects attention sharpness.
summary_en.importance: Provides a mechanistic account of attention pattern formation: differences in attention sharpness come from parameterization and optimization speed, not from differences in expressivity. A direct practical implication for pretraining is that one can obtain sharper, more interpretable attention on task-relevant tokens without changing model architecture or data, simply by adjusting the parameterization or relative learning rates of the Q/K and O/V paths.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes a single-layer self-attention model into two linear circuits: the query-key circuit (W_K W_Q^T, which controls the attention distribution) and the output-value circuit (W_O W_V, which maps attended representations to prediction logits). Four parameterizations are compared: FAFO (both circuits factorized), CAFO (collapsed attention, factorized output), FACO (factorized attention, collapsed output), CACO (both collapsed). Gradient-flow analysis shows that factorized parameterizations induce a state-dependent rescaling of gradient updates in the corresponding collapsed parameter space, so factorized and collapsed models follow different optimization trajectories even when they reach similar losses. Under orthogonality and symmetry assumptions, closed-form population gradient-flow dynamics are derived: the output-value scalar grows as log(t), while the query-key scalar grows as log^2(t), with constants controlled by the learning-rate ratio η_QK / η_OV. Because the query-key circuit acts on attention through a saturating nonlinearity (softmax), this difference in growth rate directly explains how relative optimization speed drives attention sharpening during training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover synthetic data and three real-world datasets with token-level relevance annotations: HateXplain, subject-verb agreement, and SQuAD. Key observations: (1) increasing the relative learning speed of the query-key circuit, or using a factorized Q/K parameterization, both concentrate attention more strongly on task-relevant tokens; (2) these changes barely affect training loss or downstream task metrics; (3) parameter evolution trajectories on synthetic data match the closed-form dynamics closely, validating the log(t) and log^2(t) scaling laws.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, estimated 40–60 minutes. Focus on: (1) the two-circuit decomposition and problem framing in the Introduction; (2) the core conclusions of the parameterization comparison and gradient-flow derivation in Section 3 (full mathematical detail is optional); (3) attention visualizations and quantitative metrics on real datasets in Section 5. Open directions worth pursuing: whether the findings generalize to multi-layer, multi-head, large-scale pretraining; whether grouped learning-rate scheduling can directly control attention sharpness to improve long-context behavior or interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 把 QK/OV 学习率比与注意力锐度用闭式动态连起来，是少有的干净机制分析；玩具 setup，结论需在大模型上验证，看 §3 推导即可。
recommendation.en: Cleanly links QK/OV LR ratio to attention sharpness via closed-form dynamics; toy setup—read §3 for the derivation, verify at scale yourself.

paper.title: Muon Meets Mamba: Spectral Optimization for State Space Models
paper.abstract: Muon is a recent optimizer that orthogonalizes the update to each weight matrix with a Newton-Schulz iteration, which performs steepest descent under the spectral norm. Almost all the evidence for it comes from Transformer models, and its behavior on state-space models is largely unreported. We compare Muon with AdamW on Mamba-2 130M under a controlled protocol that varies only which weight groups are trained with Muon. The benefit is localized. Muon on the output projection alone beats Muon on

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作问得很具体：Muon 这种基于矩阵更新正交化的优化器，在 Transformer 上已有一些证据，但放到 Mamba-2 这类状态空间模型里，到底有没有稳定收益；如果有，收益来自哪些参数组，而不是“给所有二维矩阵都上 Muon”这种粗放做法。全文的重点不是提出新优化器，而是在严格控制变量的前提下，定位 Muon 在 Mamba-2 中的有效作用点，并检验这种收益是最终 loss 改善、收敛速度改善，还是单纯训练更稳。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它提醒人不要把 Transformer 上的优化器经验直接迁移到 SSM 架构。Mamba-2 的投影矩阵承担的功能与 attention/MLP 里的线性层并不相同，优化几何也未必一致。第二，它给出一个更细的结论：优化器选择可能需要做到参数组级别，而不是模型级别。对大模型训练 recipe 来说，这比“Muon 是否优于 AdamW”更有操作性，因为真实训练里常见的做法本来就是混合优化器、分组学习率和分组正则。贡献量级不算大，更像一篇扎实的负责任实验论文：它没有证明 Muon 普遍适合 Mamba，但较清楚地说明了收益是局部的，而且主要体现在 token efficiency。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上很克制。作者使用官方 Mamba 实现和公开 Muon 参考实现，在同一套训练协议下比较 AdamW 基线与三种 Muon 分配方式：只给输入投影组 G_in 用 Muon，只给输出投影组 G_out 用 Muon，以及同时给两组都用 Muon，其余参数保持 AdamW。这样设计的好处是把问题缩到“Muon 应该放在哪些矩阵上”，避免被学习率、实现细节、初始化差异混淆。

Muon 的核心机制是对矩阵型 momentum update 做固定步数的 Newton-Schulz 正交化，使更新方向更接近谱范数几何下的最速下降；而 AdamW 是逐坐标自适应。作者没有停留在 loss 曲线比较，而是把解释落到矩阵谱诊断上，跟踪被分配 Muon 的投影矩阵的 condition number、effective rank 和 spectral norm，想看收益是否伴随更好的谱性质。

全文最重要的技术判断是：在 Mamba-2 里，Muon 的收益不是“越多越好”。只对输出投影使用 Muon 优于只用在输入投影，也优于输入输出一起用。作者还专门排除了一个常见解释——收益只是因为 Muon 改善了条件数。实验显示 Muon 确实会降低其作用矩阵的 condition number，但这种谱改善并不能单独解释验证损失上的差异，说明矩阵在模块中的功能角色比单纯数值条件更关键。
summary.experiments:
实验主体围绕 Mamba-2 130M 展开，数据集包括 OpenWebText 和 FineWeb-Edu，token budget 覆盖 1B、2.6B 和 50B。这个设置有两个优点：一是既看早期 token efficiency，也看远超 compute-optimal 点之后收益是否还在；二是跨两个语料验证结果不是单一数据集偶然现象。

从全文给出的结论看，最稳定的现象是：G_out-only Muon 在两套语料、多个 token budget 下都优于纯 AdamW，优势主要体现在更快达到同等验证 loss，而不是大幅改变最终可达下界。G_in-only 的收益更弱，甚至不如只改输出投影；G_in∪G_out 也没有进一步变好，说明 Muon 在 Mamba-2 中存在明显的“局部适配”而非普适增益。

作者还看了继续训练到远超常见最优计算点的阶段，发现 token efficiency 优势仍然保留，这一点比只看短程训练更可信。谱分析部分显示：Muon 会系统性降低其所作用矩阵的 condition number，并改变谱范数和有效秩，但这些变化与验证性能并非一一对应。也就是说，“谱更好看”不等于“语言建模更好”，这对后续做优化器解释很重要。

从预训练研究角度，最有信息量的不是某个绝对数值，而是这个模式：同一个优化器，在同一模型里，对不同功能投影矩阵的作用方向不同，甚至联合使用会抵消局部收益。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把几个部分看仔细。

第一，先看实验设置和参数分组定义，弄清 G_in、G_out 在 Mamba-2 block 里的具体位置。没有这个结构感，后面的结论会显得像经验现象。第二，重点看主结果图：不同 Muon 分配方式在 OWT 和 FineWeb-Edu 上的验证 loss 曲线，以及不同 token budget 下的比较。这里要关注的是相对排序是否稳定，而不是单个点的波动。第三，看谱诊断图表，尤其是 condition number 与 loss 改善之间并不严格对应的部分，这决定了作者为何说“conditioning does not explain the gain”。

如果时间有限，30 分钟足够抓住主结论：Muon 在 Mamba-2 上有用，但只在特定投影组上明显有用，而且收益主要是 token efficiency。若想深挖，可以顺着两个问题读：为什么输出投影比输入投影更适合谱几何更新；为什么同时对两组使用 Muon 反而不增益。这两个问题都还没有被论文完全解释，适合作为后续实验切口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but useful question: does Muon, an optimizer that orthogonalizes matrix-valued updates, actually help when training Mamba-2, and if so, where inside the block does it help? Prior evidence for Muon is mostly from Transformers. This work does not assume that optimizer behavior transfers to state-space models. Instead, it isolates whether gains come from applying Muon to specific projection groups, and whether the gain shows up in final validation loss, token efficiency, or training robustness.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly methodological. First, it is a reminder that optimizer conclusions from Transformers should not be treated as architecture-agnostic. Mamba-2 uses projection matrices with different functional roles from attention and MLP layers, so the right update geometry may differ. Second, the paper points toward parameter-group-level optimizer design rather than model-wide optimizer replacement. That is a practical lesson for pretraining recipes, where mixed optimizers, per-group learning rates, and selective regularization are already common. The contribution is modest in scale but solid in execution: it does not claim Muon is broadly better for Mamba, only that the benefit is localized and mostly appears as better token efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is intentionally controlled. Using the official Mamba implementation and the public Muon reference code, the authors compare a pure AdamW baseline against three hybrid assignments: Muon on the input projection group only, Muon on the output projection group only, and Muon on both groups, with all remaining parameters still trained by AdamW. This turns the question into a clean assignment study rather than a noisy optimizer bake-off.

Muon works by applying a fixed-step Newton-Schulz orthogonalization to matrix-valued momentum updates, approximating steepest descent under spectral norm geometry. AdamW, in contrast, is coordinate-wise adaptive. The paper goes beyond loss curves and tracks spectral diagnostics of the affected matrices: condition number, effective rank, and spectral norm. The goal is to test whether any optimization gain is accompanied by systematic spectral changes.

The main technical takeaway is that Muon is not uniformly helpful inside Mamba-2. Applying it only to the output projection group works better than applying it only to the input projection group, and better than applying it to both. The authors also test a natural explanation and reject it: although Muon does reduce the condition number of the matrices it touches, that alone does not explain the validation-loss differences. Functional role matters, not just improved conditioning.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use Mamba-2 130M on OpenWebText and FineWeb-Edu, with token budgets of 1B, 2.6B, and 50B. This is a sensible design because it checks both early token efficiency and behavior well beyond the usual compute-optimal regime, while also testing whether the effect survives across corpora.

The most consistent result is that Muon on the output projection group gives the best outcome among the tested assignments. The gain is primarily in token efficiency: it reaches a given validation loss faster than pure AdamW, rather than dramatically changing the eventual floor. Muon on the input projection is weaker, and applying Muon to both input and output projections does not improve further. That pattern suggests a localized architectural fit rather than a generic optimizer advantage.

The long-budget runs matter. The advantage persists even when training continues far past the nominal compute-optimal point, which makes the result more credible than a short-horizon comparison. On the diagnostic side, Muon systematically lowers the condition number of the matrices it updates and changes their spectral statistics, but those changes do not map cleanly to validation performance. That is an important negative result: cleaner spectra are not sufficient to explain better language-model training.

For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is not a single headline number but the structure of the result: the same optimizer can help one projection group, do little for another, and fail to compose when applied to both.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but a careful skim is worthwhile. Start with the parameter-group definitions and the figure showing where the input and output projection groups sit inside the Mamba-2 block. Without that, the optimizer-assignment result feels arbitrary. Then read the main validation-loss comparisons across datasets and token budgets. Focus on whether the ranking of assignments is stable, not on tiny absolute differences.

After that, read the spectral diagnostics. The key point is not that Muon changes condition numbers, but that improved conditioning does not fully account for the training gain. That is where the paper becomes more than a benchmark table.

If time is limited, 20 to 30 minutes is enough to extract the main message: Muon can help Mamba-2, but the benefit is localized to specific projection groups and mostly shows up as token efficiency. If you want a follow-up experiment idea, the obvious next questions are why the output projection is the right target and why applying Muon to both groups fails to compound the gain.

recommendation.zh: 只看 weight-group 消融和 conditioning 分析；若内部在训 SSM，应复现 output-proj-only Muon。
recommendation.en: Read the weight-group ablation and conditioning analysis; if you train SSMs, replicate output-proj-only Muon internally.

paper.title: AOS: Adaptive Optimizer Switching via Training-State Signals for Faster Convergence and Better Generalization
paper.abstract: Single-optimizer training is a poor fit for the distinct phases of deep network optimization: adaptive methods handle noisy early gradients well but overshoot flat minima, while SGD with momentum generalizes better in the late phase but converges slowly early on.   We introduce AOS-R (Adaptive Optimizer Switching, Rule-Based), a lightweight controller that monitors six online gradient-space signals -- gradient noise scale (GNS), Hutchinson curvature trace, loss stagnation, update stability ratio

summary.core_problem: 解决单一优化器难以同时适配训练早期噪声梯度和后期平坦极小值泛化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练 recipe / 优化器控制策略。它关注 gradient noise scale、曲率、更新稳定性等在线信号，这些信号对 LLM 训练诊断有可迁移价值；但实验主要是小中型视觉分类设定，不能直接外推到大规模预训练。
summary.technical_approach: AOS-R 是 rule-based adaptive optimizer switching 控制器，在线监控六个训练状态信号：GNS、Hutchinson curvature trace、loss stagnation、update stability ratio、gradient stability index 和 loss improvement ratio。它在 AdamW、SGD with momentum、Lion 之间切换，并用 state-preserving momentum transfer 和 400-step learning-rate bridge 减少切换时的精度损伤。
summary.experiments: 在 CIFAR-100 / WRN-28x10 上，AOS-R 到达 78% top-1 需要 81 epochs，相比 AdamW 的 109 epochs 少 26%，相比 SGD-M 的 143 epochs 少 43%，相比 Lion 的 96 epochs 少 16%。摘要称在 8 个 model-dataset benchmark 中取得更好的准确率表现，但未给出 LLM 或大规模预训练实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between a single optimizer and different phases of training: noisy early optimization versus late-stage generalization in flatter regions.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a training-recipe and optimizer-control mechanism. Its use of online signals such as gradient noise scale, curvature, and update stability is relevant to LLM training diagnostics, but the empirical evidence is from small-to-mid-scale vision benchmarks rather than language-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: AOS-R is a rule-based controller that monitors six online training-state signals: GNS, Hutchinson curvature trace, loss stagnation, update stability ratio, gradient stability index, and loss improvement ratio. It switches among AdamW, SGD with momentum, and Lion, using state-preserving momentum transfer and a 400-step learning-rate bridge to avoid degradation at transition points.
summary_en.experiments: On CIFAR-100 with WRN-28x10, AOS-R reaches 78% top-1 in 81 epochs, compared with 109 for AdamW, 143 for SGD-M, and 96 for Lion. The abstract also claims the best accuracy across eight model-dataset benchmarks, but does not include LLM-scale pretraining evidence.

recommendation.zh: 信号选择比结果更值得看；若有内部小模型训练平台，可复现切换规则，但别把 CIFAR 结论外推到 LLM。
recommendation.en: The monitored signals are more useful than the headline gains; reproduce the switching rule on internal small LMs, but do not extrapolate CIFAR results to pretraining.

paper.title: Pseudorandom Streams within Diffusion Models Act as Learnable Inputs That Affect Generation Quality
paper.abstract: Diffusion models rely on stochastic inputs, yet on finite-precision hardware, the "randomness" they consume is realized as deterministic numerical orbits generated by pseudorandom rules. Accessible orbit structure can become a learnable input and affect both training and generation because the realized loss and its gradient depend on the concrete pseudorandom values consumed at each optimization step. A small multilayer perceptron predicts the next value of an orbit from its recent history, meas

summary.core_problem: 研究扩散模型训练和采样中使用的伪随机数流是否只是可互换噪声，还是会被模型利用并影响生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型训练动态和数值随机性分析。它不直接改进 LLM 预训练，但对大规模训练的随机源、复现性、finite-precision 行为有提醒意义：所谓随机输入在硬件上是确定性轨道，可能进入优化信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把伪随机序列视为可观测轨道。先用小型 MLP 根据近期历史预测下一个伪随机值，衡量序列可预测性；再构造 diffusion probe，用在线随机张量替代真实图像，同时保留扩散架构和训练目标，测试模型是否能利用轨道结构。实验还控制边缘统计并筛除明显的动力系统和有限精度失败。
summary.experiments: 实验在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上比较不同伪随机轨道。即使控制边缘分布并排除明显坏轨道，不同轨道仍带来明显不同的 diffusion loss 和生成质量；序列可预测性指标与生成质量指标之间存在强 rank correlation。摘要未给出模型规模和具体相关系数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether pseudorandom streams used by diffusion models are interchangeable noise sources or deterministic inputs that can affect training and generation.
summary_en.importance: It is a training-dynamics and numerical-randomness study for generative models. The direct LLM relevance is limited, but the result is a useful warning for large-scale training reproducibility and finite-precision assumptions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors treat pseudorandom streams as deterministic numerical orbits. A small MLP predicts the next value from recent history to measure sequence predictability, while a diffusion probe replaces images with online random tensors and checks whether the architecture and loss can exploit orbit structure.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 show that different pseudorandom orbits lead to different diffusion losses and generation quality, even after controlling marginal statistics and filtering obvious failures. Predictability and diffusion-probe measures are strongly rank-correlated with quality.

recommendation.zh: 结论别外推到 LLM，但 PRNG 作为隐式输入的 setup 值得看；大训练复现问题又多一个弱信号。
recommendation.en: Do not overgeneralize to LLMs, but the PRNG-as-input setup is worth noting as another weak signal for reproducibility failures.

paper.title: Tunneling the Loss Landscape: Bypassing Memorization with Monte Carlo Parameter Swapping
paper.abstract: Grokking is a striking phenomenon in neural network training, where a model can undergo a prolonged period of pure memorization before abrupt generalization. While previous works have attempted to interpret it through classical machine learning mechanisms like weight norm, recent research draws an analogy from statistical physics, framing grokking as a form of computational glass relaxation. This theory defines the initial memorization as a result of `fast cooling' where the training loss is red

summary.core_problem: 这项工作用玻璃态动力学的工具分析 grokking：模型已经记住训练集但长期不能泛化，是否是因为参数空间进入了动力学迟滞，而不是因为泛化解在能量或熵意义上不可达。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在训练动态和泛化机制，而不是直接给出 LLM 训练配方。它把 grokking 从“训练损失、权重范数、测试精度”的宏观描述推进到参数轨迹动力学：参数是否还在移动、不同 replica 是否会分叉、单条轨迹是否变成狭窄通道。这对理解大模型训练中的 plateau、迟发泛化、弱梯度区间和 optimizer-induced mobility 有借鉴意义。需要注意，它仍主要是 grokking testbed 上的机制研究，不能直接外推到大规模语言模型预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成。第一部分是动力学诊断框架，包含三个量：Parameter Mobility 衡量训练中相邻 step 的参数移动幅度；Replica Correlation 衡量从同一状态分叉出的独立训练轨迹之间的相似度，用于观察历史依赖和 aging；Trajectory Fractal Dimension 衡量单条优化轨迹的形状，区分持续沿通道前进和高弯曲度搜索。作者用这些量检验 AdamW 训练中的 grokking 是否符合 glass-like kinetic arrest。第二部分是 SAM-Swap，即 State-Aware Monte Carlo Parameter Swapping。它借鉴玻璃体系中的 swap Monte Carlo，用非标准梯度步的参数交换来增加参数空间 mobility，目标是在不依赖长时间普通训练的情况下更快离开记忆解附近的迟滞区域。它和调 learning rate、weight decay 或加噪声的区别在于：干预对象不是单步梯度大小，而是跨状态或跨 replica 的参数配置可达性。
summary.experiments: 关键观察包括：AdamW 模型进入 memorization 后，Parameter Mobility 明显塌缩，说明参数仍在训练但有效位移很小；Replica Correlation 出现两阶段 relaxation，并且等待时间越长 decorrelation 越慢，这是 aging 的典型动力学信号；Trajectory Fractal Dimension 在 memorization 后降到接近 1，表示轨迹变得接近一维、通道化，而不是在参数空间中充分探索。这些结果支持 grokking 是 kinetic arrest，而不是宏观能量壁垒或熵壁垒。SAM-Swap 的实验目标是缩短从记忆到泛化的等待时间，验证增加参数 mobility 是否能绕过长期 plateau。可见内容没有给出完整模型规模、数据集规模和提升幅度，精确数字需要看实验表格和算法章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 glass relaxation、volume hypothesis 和 kinetic arrest 的区分，这决定了论文想验证的不是“泛化解是否存在”，而是“优化轨迹为什么慢”。方法部分重点看 PM、RC、FD 的数学定义，尤其是 RC 的 replica 分叉设置和 FD 的估计方式。实验部分重点看三类曲线是否和 train/test accuracy 的 grokking 转折对齐。SAM-Swap 部分建议看 proposal、acceptance rule、state-aware 条件和对 baseline optimizer 的控制变量。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可跳过大部分物理类背景，把注意力放在 mobility collapse 与 optimizer 动态上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether grokking is caused by a glass-like kinetic arrest in parameter space: the model memorizes quickly, gradients become weak, and the trajectory moves slowly toward generalizing solutions that are not macroscopically inaccessible.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about training dynamics and generalization mechanisms. It does not provide a direct large-language-model pretraining recipe, but it offers a useful lens for studying long plateaus, delayed generalization, weak-gradient regimes, and optimizer-dependent mobility. The central point is that training loss and weight norm are not enough to describe the transition; the geometry and mobility of the parameter trajectory also matter. Any implication for LLM-scale training should be treated cautiously because the evidence is from grokking-style controlled settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: The diagnostic framework combines three measurements. Parameter Mobility tracks stepwise movement in parameter space. Replica Correlation measures how independently evolved trajectories, branched from the same state, remain similar or decorrelate over time. Trajectory Fractal Dimension characterizes whether a path is channel-like and persistent or tortuous and exploratory. Applied to AdamW training, these quantities are used to test the computational-glass interpretation of grokking. The intervention is SAM-Swap, State-Aware Monte Carlo Parameter Swapping. Inspired by swap Monte Carlo in glassy systems, it introduces non-gradient parameter swaps to improve mobility and accelerate equilibration toward generalizing states. Unlike simply changing learning rate, weight decay, or gradient noise, the mechanism targets accessibility between parameter configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical signals are consistent with kinetic arrest. After memorization, Parameter Mobility collapses even though test accuracy remains poor. Replica Correlation shows two-step relaxation and aging: trajectories decorrelate more slowly when branched after longer waiting times. Trajectory Fractal Dimension drops to approximately 1 after memorization, indicating a narrow, persistent optimization channel rather than broad exploration. SAM-Swap is then used as a causal probe: if delayed generalization comes from low mobility, parameter-swapping moves should reduce the waiting time before generalization. The available text does not include complete numerical tables, model sizes, or absolute improvement values, so the most reliable takeaway is the qualitative dynamical pattern.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Read the setup that separates entropy or energy barriers from kinetic arrest. Then inspect the definitions of Parameter Mobility, Replica Correlation, and Fractal Dimension, since these are the reusable parts of the paper. In the experiments, focus on plots aligning PM, RC, FD, train accuracy, and test accuracy across the grokking transition. For SAM-Swap, read the algorithm carefully: proposal construction, acceptance criterion, and state-aware conditioning determine whether the method is a controlled dynamics intervention or just another source of optimization noise.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当“能训更强模型”的 recipe；把 PM 度量和参数交换当作诊断/干预工具，复现其训练轨迹图更有价值。
recommendation.en: Don’t treat it as a scalable recipe; the value is in the PM-style diagnostics and the swapping intervention—replicate the trajectory figures, not the headline.

paper.title: The Grokked Illusion: True Equilibrium Mitigates Catastrophic Forgetting
paper.abstract: While neural networks are typically evaluated by their training and test performance, these metrics do not reveal how robust a learned representation is.
