Recent studies have shown that solutions occupying larger volumes in parameter space, as quantified by Boltzmann entropy, often exhibit superior generalizability compared to those reached by conventional optimization, a phenomenon known as the high entropy advantage. Here we ask whether this advantage persists beyond generalization. Specificall

summary.core_problem: 达到完美泛化（grokking）的神经网络，为什么在后续继续学习新数据时仍然会发生严重的灾难性遗忘？这种“看起来已经学会”的解，在参数空间几何性质上有什么根本差异？
summary.importance: 对理解预训练终点状态的质量、持续学习中的遗忘、以及优化器最终收敛到的解的鲁棒性有启发。论文把“高熵解”的讨论从泛化延伸到了抗干扰/抗遗忘，给出了一个清晰的对照实验：同样100%测试准确率的解，鲁棒性可以差很多。这对训练后期的设计（weight decay、熵偏置、平衡态采样、长时间训练后的解选择）有概念上的价值，但当前证据局限在小模型玩具任务，距离大模型预训练结论还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 采用模加法（x+y mod 67）这一经典grokking控制场景，单层Transformer，约21.5万参数，训练集2244个样本，使得传统AdamW训练的模型和通过Wang-Landau Molecular Dynamics（WLMD）采样得到的“给定训练损失下最高Boltzmann熵”的平衡态模型都能达到100%测试准确率，从而控制掉泛化差异这个混淆变量。之后设计噪声注入/继续记忆新数据实验：在保留原始训练数据的情况下，让模型额外记忆噪声样本，比较原任务准确率的保持情况。用SVD分析权重矩阵的有效秩，解释鲁棒性差异的表征来源。
summary.experiments: 最困难条件下，AdamW训练得到的grokked解在记忆新噪声数据后，原任务测试准确率从100%掉到75%以下；而WLMD采样的高熵平衡态解仍保持约98%的原任务准确率。SVD分析显示，高熵解在注意力层和MLP层的权重有效秩显著更高，且在噪声注入后仍维持更高的有效秩，说明更丰富、分布更均匀的特征子空间对参数扰动有缓冲作用。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看Introduction里对“泛化不等于鲁棒性”的问题设定、Figure中AdamW与平衡态解在遗忘程度上的对照、以及SVD有效秩的分析部分。不必深究WLMD采样细节，除非对统计物理采样方法本身有兴趣。预计阅读时间15–20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Why do neural networks that have fully generalized (grokked) still suffer severe catastrophic forgetting when subsequently trained on new data? What underlying geometric differences in parameter space distinguish solutions that merely appear to have learned from those that are genuinely robust?
summary_en.importance: The paper extends the discussion of high-entropy solutions from generalization to robustness against interference and forgetting, using a tightly controlled setup where two models reach identical perfect test accuracy yet differ sharply in resilience. This is conceptually relevant to understanding end-of-pretraining solution quality, continual learning, and the properties of optima found by optimizers. The evidence, however, is limited to a small toy grokking task and should not be over-extrapolated to large-scale pretraining without further work.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses modular arithmetic (x+y mod 67), a standard controlled grokking benchmark, with a single-layer Transformer of about 215k parameters trained on 2244 examples. In this setting, both conventionally AdamW-trained models and equilibrium states sampled via Wang-Landau Molecular Dynamics (WLMD)—maximizing Boltzmann entropy at a given training loss—achieve 100% test accuracy, removing generalization as a confound. The authors then inject a noise-memorization phase: the model must memorize new noisy data while the original training data remains available, and retention of the original task is measured. SVD of weight matrices is used to link robustness to effective rank of learned representations.
summary_en.experiments: Under the hardest noise condition, AdamW-trained grokked solutions drop from 100% to below 75% original-task test accuracy after memorizing noisy data, while WLMD-sampled high-entropy equilibrium solutions retain roughly 98% accuracy. SVD analysis shows that high-entropy solutions maintain substantially higher effective rank in both attention and MLP layers before and after noise injection, suggesting that richer, more distributed feature subspaces buffer against parameter perturbation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the problem framing in the introduction, the direct comparison of forgetting between AdamW and equilibrium solutions, and the SVD effective-rank analysis. The WLMD sampling details are optional unless one has a specific interest in statistical-physics sampling methods. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计就够；toy setup 不能外推到预训练，但“同精度不同遗忘”这个控制变量很干净。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental setup; the toy regime will not transfer directly to pretraining, but the same-accuracy different-forgetting control is clean.

paper.title: Towards joint scaling laws with optimal batch size schedules
paper.abstract: Modern deep learning typically keeps the batch size static throughout training, thus overlooking the joint effect of learning rate and batch size on the training dynamics. In this paper, we study the deep learning dynamics through the lens of convex optimization and derive a joint characterization of loss in terms of both schedules, applicable to general optimizers and model architectures. This characterization yields a closed-form optimal batch size schedule for any prescribed learning rate sch

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：在给定学习率 schedule 和训练预算时，batch size 是否也应该作为随训练动态变化的 schedule 来设计，而不是固定成一个常数。现有 LLM 训练通常把学习率做 warmup 和 decay，却把 batch size 当作独立超参调；这会忽略学习率、梯度噪声、优化步数和数据预算之间的耦合关系。该工作试图给出一个可迁移的答案：什么样的 batch size schedule 对最终 loss 最优，以及它依赖哪些因素。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练 recipe 有直接影响。它把 batch size 从经验调参项提升为一个可由学习率形状和预算推导的 scaling 维度。最重要的结论是，最优 batch size schedule 主要由总预算和学习率 schedule 形状决定，而与 peak learning rate、weight decay、模型大小、架构和优化器基本解耦。这个结论如果在更大规模上继续成立，会改变超参迁移流程：先按训练 horizon 缩放 learning rate 和 weight decay，再用闭式规则生成 batch size schedule，而不是为每个规模重新搜索 batch size。贡献量级较高，因为它触及大模型训练中昂贵且常被简化处理的一个超参维度，并给出零额外训练开销的改进。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线是用随机凸优化的视角近似刻画深度网络训练动态。作者先从 SGD 和凸 loss 出发，建立从学习率序列、batch size 序列到任意迭代 loss 序列的 sequence-to-sequence 预测关系。batch size 的作用通过 mini-batch 梯度噪声进入：期望梯度范数项和 per-example 梯度协方差 trace 项共同决定噪声规模，batch size 越大，采样噪声越小，但在固定数据或计算预算下会减少有效更新次数或改变每步边际收益。随后作者把最后一步 loss 最小化写成一个受约束优化问题，变量是整条 batch size 序列，约束可以是数据预算、计算预算或更一般的预算形式。通过拉格朗日乘子得到闭式最优 schedule。直观上，batch 应该分配给对最终 loss 边际影响更大的训练阶段，这个边际影响由学习率 schedule 的形状决定，而不是由学习率峰值本身决定。与固定 batch、手工随学习率同步变化的 batch、或逐规模搜索 batch 的做法相比，这里给出的是 scale-free 的规则：给定 cosine、linear、WSD 等学习率形状和训练预算，就能生成对应的 batch size schedule。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖预训练和微调两类场景，模型包括 Llama3 系列 dense 模型、Qwen3 MoE，以及视觉语言模型，规模最高到 7B；优化器包括 AdamW 和 Muon。核心结果有三点。第一，基于学习率序列和 batch size 序列的 loss 预测在非凸神经网络和自适应优化器上仍然准确，支持作者所说的 convex-dominant training dynamics。第二，采用 joint scaling law 后，在相同最终效果下相对固定 batch size baseline 有约 6% 到 15% 的计算效率提升，且不引入额外计算。这个 recipe 同时使用随训练步数 T 的 1/sqrt(T) 学习率和 weight decay 缩放，以及推导出的 scale-free batch size schedule。第三，动态 batch size 没有破坏不同规模训练曲线的 universal dynamics，也就是作者称为 supercollapse 的现象；这说明该 schedule 不只是单点调参收益，而是能与跨规模超参迁移兼容。消融还显示，最优 batch schedule 对 peak learning rate、weight decay、模型大小、架构和优化器不敏感，主要随学习率形状和预算改变。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Section 2 和 Section 3。Section 2 的关键是看清 loss sequence 预测式如何把 batch size 作为梯度噪声控制项纳入，而不是只把 batch size 当系统吞吐参数。Section 3 的 Theorem 3 是核心创新，重点看约束优化如何推出闭式 batch size schedule，以及为什么 peak learning rate 会被消掉。Section 7 值得看证明和从 SGD 到 AdamW、Muon 等优化器的经验扩展依据。Section 9 是判断实用性的重点，尤其要看预训练、微调、dense、MoE、VLM、不同 optimizer 下的 ablation 是否一致。Section 11 可快速浏览，用来理解该规则和现有 LLM batch size 经验做法的差异。值得深挖的问题有两个：一是该 schedule 在更长 horizon 和更大 token budget 下是否仍保持同样收益；二是当训练进入数据质量变化、curriculum、annealing 或 cooldown 阶段时，预算约束里的 batch 分配是否需要和数据分布一起建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The central question is whether batch size should be treated as a scheduled training variable, jointly designed with the learning-rate schedule, rather than kept fixed. Modern LLM training already uses shaped learning-rate schedules, but batch size is often tuned as a static hyperparameter. That misses the coupling among learning rate, gradient noise, number of optimizer steps, data budget, and compute budget.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to pretraining recipes. It turns batch size into a scaling dimension that can be derived from the learning-rate shape and the training budget. The main practical claim is that the optimal batch-size schedule depends on total budget and the shape of the learning-rate schedule, but is largely independent of peak learning rate, weight decay, model size, architecture, and optimizer. If this continues to hold at larger scale, hyperparameter transfer becomes simpler: scale learning rate and weight decay with the training horizon, then generate the batch-size schedule analytically instead of retuning it for every run.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method starts from stochastic convex optimization and uses it as an approximation to neural-network training dynamics. The authors derive a sequence-to-sequence characterization that maps an arbitrary learning-rate sequence and batch-size sequence to a predicted loss sequence at any iteration. Batch size enters through the stochastic-gradient noise term: larger batches reduce sampling noise, but under a fixed data or compute budget they also change the allocation of optimization effort. The final-iteration loss is then minimized over the whole batch-size sequence under a budget constraint. Solving this constrained problem gives a closed-form schedule. The key distinction from fixed-batch training or hand-designed schedules is that the allocation is driven by the marginal effect of each training step under the chosen learning-rate shape, not by a separately tuned batch-size constant.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical coverage includes pretraining and fine-tuning settings, dense Llama3-style models, Qwen3 MoE models, and vision-language models up to 7B parameters. The optimizers include AdamW and Muon. The reported results support three claims. First, the loss prediction from learning-rate and batch-size sequences remains accurate beyond the convex SGD setting, including non-convex models and adaptive optimizers. Second, the joint scaling recipe improves compute efficiency by roughly 6% to 15% over static batch-size baselines with no extra training computation. The recipe combines 1/sqrt(T) scaling for learning rate and weight decay with the derived scale-free batch-size schedule. Third, the schedule preserves universal training dynamics, referred to as supercollapse, suggesting that the gain is compatible with cross-scale hyperparameter transfer rather than being a local tuning artifact.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Sections 2 and 3 carefully. Section 2 explains how batch size is incorporated as a gradient-noise control variable in the loss-sequence predictor. Section 3, especially Theorem 3, contains the main result: the closed-form optimal batch-size schedule and the reason peak learning rate drops out. Section 7 is useful for checking the proof assumptions and the empirical extension beyond SGD. Section 9 is the main evidence section; focus on the ablations across pretraining, fine-tuning, dense models, MoE models, VLMs, AdamW, and Muon. Section 11 can be skimmed to compare the proposed schedule with batch-size practices in recent LLM training. Two points deserve deeper follow-up: whether the same rule holds at much longer horizons and whether data-mixture changes, curriculum, annealing, or cooldown phases should be included in the budget model.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看推导假设和实验控制；若 token budget 干净，动态 batch schedule 值得进内部预训练 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the assumptions and controls first; if the token budget is clean, dynamic batch scheduling deserves an internal pretraining ablation.

paper.title: DomainPilot: Domain-Level Loss-Guided Two-Stage Data Mixture Optimization for Efficient Language Model Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: The training efficacy of large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally constrained by the quality and composition of training data. Existing dynamic data scheduling methods face critical limitations in industrial-scale pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT): data selection incurs prohibitive O(N) costs on terabyte-scale corpora, mixture optimization schemes introduce severe I/O bottlenecks or require training auxiliary reference models, and sample-level reweighting strategies rely on loss

summary.core_problem: 工业级 LLM 预训练和 SFT 中的动态数据混合优化面临成本高昂、I/O 瓶颈或依赖不可靠的样本级损失信号等问题，且现有方法难以无缝集成到 Megatron-LM 等主流训练框架中。
summary.importance: 提出了一种轻量级、框架无关的领域级数据混合优化方案，解决了大规模预训练中数据配比动态调整的工程和算法痛点，对提升数据效率和模型最终性能具有实际工业价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DomainPilot，一个领域级损失引导的两阶段数据混合优化框架。首先，通过非侵入式补丁实现 Token 级的领域损失监控，在不中断训练的情况下捕获各领域的学习动态。其次，两阶段优化：阶段一利用领域特定的 Scaling Laws 提取先验信息（收敛损失、速度等）进行粗调；阶段二在粗调基础上进行 Mixing Law 扫描实验，建模跨领域交互，在局部范围内精调配比。架构上采用算法层与适配器层分离的设计，易于迁移。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上进行验证。优化后的数据混合比例在不增加数据或计算成本的情况下，使模型在 LiveCodeBench v5 上提升 3.8%，BFCL v3 上提升 3.6%，在 MMLU-Redux 和 AIME24 上也有稳定提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Methodology 中 Token 级领域损失监控的实现细节，以及两阶段优化（Scaling Law 粗调 + Mixing Law 精调）的逻辑。了解其如何通过少量代码修改适配 Megatron-LM 框架。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Dynamic data mixture optimization in industrial-scale LLM pretraining and SFT faces prohibitive costs, I/O bottlenecks, or relies on unreliable sample-level loss signals. Furthermore, existing methods are difficult to integrate seamlessly into mainstream frameworks like Megatron-LM.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a lightweight, framework-agnostic domain-level data mixture optimization solution, addressing the engineering and algorithmic pain points of dynamic data proportion adjustment in large-scale pretraining, offering practical industrial value for improving data efficiency and final model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces DomainPilot, a domain-level loss-guided two-stage data mixture optimization framework. First, it implements token-level domain loss monitoring via a non-intrusive patch to capture per-domain learning dynamics without halting training. Second, a two-stage optimization: Stage 1 uses domain-specific Scaling Laws to extract priors (convergence loss, speed, etc.) for coarse reallocation; Stage 2 conducts Mixing Law sweep experiments around the coarse baseline to model cross-domain interactions and refine proportions locally. The architecture separates the algorithm layer from the adapter layer for easy migration.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen3-1.7B. The optimized mixture improved performance by up to 3.8% on LiveCodeBench v5 and 3.6% on BFCL v3, with consistent gains on MMLU-Redux and AIME24, without additional data or compute costs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the implementation details of token-level domain loss monitoring in the Methodology, and the logic behind the two-stage optimization (Scaling Law coarse tuning + Mixing Law fine-tuning). Understand how it adapts to the Megatron-LM framework with minimal code changes. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 data mixture 的人可以看：它把 sample-level 选择降到 domain-level，方向对，但先别全信收益，优先看收敛曲线拟合是否真能稳定预测后续最优配比。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you work on data mixture: the domain-level reduction is sensible, but the real question is whether the fitted convergence curves actually predict better mixtures rather than just smoothing noise.

paper.title: Grokking on the Weight-Decay Clock: A Rate Hierarchy from Softly Broken Symmetries
paper.abstract: Delayed generalization, or grokking, remains poorly understood despite extensive empirical study. We identify an exactly solvable late-time relaxation mechanism for grokking in linear models trained with full-batch heavy-ball optimization and weight decay, together with a locally quadratic extension to nonlinear neural networks. Our analysis reveals a distinguished population-active component of the empirical null space, which we call the grokking subspace. Along this subspace, the training pred

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 grokking 的晚期动力学：为什么训练误差已经收敛后，测试误差还会在很长延迟后继续下降。作者关注的不是“存在慢时间尺度”这一点，而是哪一部分慢运动真正影响泛化，以及这个过程如何受 weight decay、学习率和 heavy-ball momentum 控制。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的价值在训练动态和正则化理解。它给出一个可解机制：在训练集上不可见、但在总体分布上可见的参数方向，会在 weight decay 的慢恢复力下驱动晚期泛化改善。它不能直接解释大模型预训练中的所有 grokking-like 现象，因为假设包括平方损失、full-batch heavy-ball、弱正则和局部二次近似；但它提供了清晰的因果预测，例如延迟时间随 (1-β)/(ηλ) 缩放。这类结论有助于理解 weight decay、momentum 和训练后期 cooldown/annealing 对泛化尾部的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 核心几何对象是经验 Gram 矩阵 G_N 和总体 Gram 矩阵 G_pop 的核空间关系。由于 Ker G_pop 包含在 Ker G_N 中，训练集上不改变预测的方向可以分成两类：一类在总体分布上也不可见，另一类在训练集上不可见但在总体上仍然改变预测。作者把后一类称为 grokking subspace。在线性参数模型、平方损失、full-batch heavy-ball 加 coupled L2 regularization 的设置下，训练递推的 mode spectrum 可以精确求出。沿经验核空间的平移是训练损失的对称性，weight decay 软性破坏这个对称性，于是产生慢恢复动力学。论文进一步给出离散时间和连续时间的慢根表达式，并用 soft Noether law 描述慢坐标的守恒破缺；非线性网络部分只做局部二次扩展，并显式说明误差项和适用条件。
summary.experiments: 理论给出的主要时间尺度是 k_grok ≈ (1-β)/(ηλ) log(||Π_g θ_0||/ε)，其中 Π_g θ_0 是初始参数在 grokking subspace 上的分量。实验分两层验证。第一层是精确可计算的 synthetic model，不使用拟合参数，验证了 relaxation count 按 (1-β)/(ηλ) collapse；通过缩放 grokking component 且保持训练预测不变，可以得到对数形式的延迟平移；同时区分了 grokking subspace 和真正 population-null 方向的 train/test 行为；还观察到 coupled L2 与 decoupled weight decay 之间存在 factor-(1-β) 的差异。第二层是 modular addition benchmark，出现真实 delayed generalization，延迟随 (1-β)/(ηλ) 缩放，log-log 斜率为 1.01。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35–50 分钟。先看引言中对 Ker G_N、Ker G_pop 和 grokking subspace 的定义，这是全文的主线。技术部分重点看 Theorem 4 和 Corollary 3.1，它们给出 heavy-ball + weight decay 的精确慢根和 k_grok 缩放；再看 Theorem 20，理解为什么只有 population-active empirical-null 方向贡献晚期 population risk tail。实验部分优先看 Section 7 的 synthetic intervention 和 modular addition 缩放验证。限制条件也值得看：该机制不解释无显式 weight decay 的 grokking、不解释 feature learning 产生新总体可见方向、不处理 mini-batch noise 和 adaptive optimizer。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the late-time dynamics of grokking: test loss can keep improving long after training loss has effectively converged. The central question is not whether weight decay induces a slow timescale, but which part of the post-interpolation motion affects population risk and how that motion depends on heavy-ball momentum, learning rate, and weight decay.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for training-dynamics research. It provides a solvable mechanism in which directions invisible on the training set but visible under the population distribution control the late generalization tail. The result is not a direct model of large-scale LLM pretraining, since it assumes squared loss, full-batch heavy-ball dynamics, weak regularization, and locally quadratic behavior for nonlinear networks. Still, the scaling prediction k_grok proportional to (1-β)/(ηλ) is a concrete handle on how weight decay and momentum can set late-time generalization clocks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key object is the mismatch between the empirical Gram matrix G_N and the population Gram matrix G_pop. The null spaces satisfy Ker G_pop ⊆ Ker G_N. Directions in Ker G_N do not change training predictions, but only the quotient component that remains active under G_pop can change population predictions. The authors call this component the grokking subspace. For models linear in parameters, trained with squared loss using full-batch heavy-ball optimization and coupled L2 regularization, they derive the exact discrete-time mode spectrum. Translations along the empirical null space are symmetries of the training loss; weight decay softly breaks these symmetries, producing a slow restoring dynamics. The paper also gives continuous-time and Hamiltonian interpretations through a soft Noether law, then extends the picture to nonlinear networks under a local quadratic approximation with explicit remainder assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: The main prediction is k_grok ≈ (1-β)/(ηλ) log(||Π_g θ_0||/ε), where Π_g θ_0 is the initial amplitude in the grokking subspace. The first empirical test uses an exactly computable synthetic model and verifies, without fitted parameters, the collapse of relaxation counts under (1-β)/(ηλ). It also shows logarithmic delay shifts when the grokking component is rescaled while training predictions are preserved, separates the signature of the grokking subspace from genuinely population-null directions, and confirms a factor-(1-β) difference between coupled L2 and decoupled weight decay. A modular-addition benchmark then exhibits delayed generalization with a measured log-log slope of 1.01 for the predicted scaling.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 35–50 minute skim with selective close reading. Start with the definitions of Ker G_N, Ker G_pop, and the grokking subspace. Then read Theorem 4 and Corollary 3.1 for the exact slow root and the iteration-count scaling under heavy-ball dynamics. Theorem 20 is the main generalization statement: only the population-active empirical-null component contributes to the slow population-risk tail. Section 7 is the most useful experimental part, especially the synthetic interventions and the modular-addition scaling check. The limitations are important: the mechanism does not cover grokking without explicit weight decay, feature-learning creation of new population-visible directions, mini-batch noise, abrupt accuracy jumps, or adaptive optimizers.

recommendation.zh: 从线性模型解析推导grokking的权重衰减驱动机制，给出精确缩放律，对理解优化器与正则化的交互有参考，重点看§3核心结论。
recommendation.en: Analytically derives weight-decay-driven grokking mechanism in linear models with exact scaling, useful for understanding optimizer-regularization interaction; focus on §3 core results.

paper.title: A Defense of the Quadratic Model
paper.abstract: Due to the complexity of neural network loss landscapes, optimization theory is forced to rely on idealized models, and there is generally a tradeoff between how theoretically tractable the model is, and how accurately it describes the true optimization dynamics. In this work, we stress test the simplest possible model of optimization -- the quadratic model -- and show that it can be surprisingly predictive in an LLM setting with 150M parameters and 3B training tokens. Specifically, we show that

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“二次模型能不能做理论玩具”，而是一个更直接的问题：在真实 LLM 预训练里，局部二次近似到底有多像真实优化动力学。作者把问题拆成三层。第一层是可预测性：在训练中途某个 checkpoint 处，对模型和损失做 Taylor 展开，得到线性化代理 prox 和二次代理 quad，它们能在多长时间尺度上预测后续训练轨迹。第二层是结构：如果局部二次近似确实有效，那么这些局部问题的 Hessian / Gauss-Newton 谱长什么样，哪些部分由词表和 unembedding 主导，哪些部分反映更普遍的训练几何。第三层是稳定性：真实预训练是否长期运行在 edge-of-stability 附近，以及这种结论在不同 batch size 下是确定性机制还是噪声主导机制。这个问题对预训练研究很关键，因为很多学习率、batch scaling、预条件、加速方法的理论直觉都建立在局部二次模型上，但过去缺少在 LLM 训练轨迹上直接验证。
summary.importance: 影响主要有三点。第一，它给“用二次模型理解大模型优化”这条路线补上了经验基础，而且不是只看极短步数的局部拟合，而是显示在 150M、3B tokens 的真实预训练中，局部 Taylor 代理可以在长达约 10% 训练进度的窗口内保持预测力，尤其在训练后期更准。这意味着很多关于学习率调度、稳定边界、预条件器作用的分析，不再只是抽象类比。第二，它给出了较高分辨率的谱测量结果：谱可以分成一个由词表规模决定、且主要由 unembedding 层主导的 head，以及一个跨 batch size 几乎不变、对 Adam 预条件也不敏感的 power-law tail。这个结构对理解 softmax 头、词表设计、输出层参数化和 curvature 的关系很有价值。第三，它对 edge-of-stability 给出更细的结论：小到中等 batch 主要处在 stochastic edge-of-stability，大 batch 则更接近 deterministic edge-of-stability。也就是说，LLM 训练大部分时间都贴着稳定边界运行，只是主导机制随噪声尺度变化。这对 batch-size scaling、cooldown、以及为什么很多 recipe 看起来“卡着边跑”有直接启发。量级上，这不是提出一个新训练算法，而是把一套常被默认接受的优化近似真正落到 LLM 预训练实证上。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线很扎实，核心在于把“局部近似是否有效”做成可直接检验的实验。模型是 150M 参数 Transformer，在 FineWeb 上训练 3B tokens，并每 10% 训练进度保存 checkpoint。围绕每个 checkpoint，作者构造两类代理目标。prox 是对网络输出做一阶线性化，但保留交叉熵，因此等价于 NTK 参数化下的多类 logistic regression；quad 则进一步把这个目标在 checkpoint 处做二阶展开，得到凸二次目标。然后从同一个 checkpoint 出发，在相同数据流和训练设置下继续训练这些代理模型，并与原始非线性模型的真实轨迹比较。这里关键不是只比较 loss 数值，而是比较在一个非平凡时间窗口内，代理模型是否能复现真实训练的下降趋势和超参敏感性。

在谱分析部分，作者估计 Hessian 和 Gauss-Newton 矩阵的谱，并分别考察原始参数空间和 Adam 预条件后的谱。方法上使用很深的 Lanczos quadrature probe，并给出误差带，分辨率覆盖约六个数量级。这一点很重要，因为很多过去的谱结论只看头部几个特征值，难以判断尾部是否真有稳定幂律。作者发现谱存在清晰的 head-tail 分裂：head 的大小与 vocab size 对齐，且主要来自 unembedding；tail 呈 power law，并且在不同 batch size 下几乎重合，Adam 预条件也不改变其形状，只改变某些尺度关系。基于这些谱，作者进一步估计 source exponent β 和 capacity exponent α，在可分辨尾部中得到 α≈1，而 β<1，不满足一些文献常用的可求和假设。这意味着若用经典 inverse-problem 或 kernel-regression 风格的谱假设来分析 LLM 训练，很多前提并不成立。

稳定性分析则把理论预测和真实 blow-up 实验对上。作者从多个 checkpoint 出发，用预条件 SGD 在学习率和 batch size 的乘子网格上做扫描，直接测哪些组合会发散，再与线性稳定性分析给出的边界比较。这里的“预条件 SGD”是为了更贴近 Adam 类训练的局部线性动力学。结果显示，小中 batch 下，噪声会把系统推到 stochastic edge-of-stability；大 batch 下则更接近经典线性理论中的 deterministic edge。这个设计的好处是，它没有把 edge-of-stability 当作单一现象，而是区分了噪声主导和曲率主导两种机制。
summary.experiments:
实验主体围绕一个 150M Transformer、3B 训练 tokens 展开，数据来自 FineWeb。作者每隔 10% 训练进度保存 checkpoint，并在这些点上构造 prox 与 quad 代理。核心结果是：这两种 Taylor 代理都能在最长约 10% 总训练长度的窗口内较好预测真实优化轨迹，而且越接近训练末期，近似越准确。quad 作为二次目标，提供了更强的理论可分析性；prox 保留交叉熵，通常更贴近真实模型。论文强调的不是“全程都能拟合”，而是“在一个足够长、足以影响训练决策的局部窗口内可预测”。

谱实验方面，作者用深 Lanczos 探针解析 Hessian 与 Gauss-Newton 谱，分辨率跨六个数量级。最重要的观察有三个。其一，谱头部的维度与词表规模相关，并且主要由 unembedding 层贡献，这说明输出层在局部曲率里占据特殊地位。其二，尾部呈稳定的幂律衰减，在不同 batch size 下几乎不变。其三，Adam 预条件并没有消除这种尾部结构，说明预条件器没有把问题“白化”成简单各向同性几何。作者据此估计 capacity exponent α≈1，source exponent β<1。后者直接反驳了一类常见理论分析中的 summability 假设。

稳定性实验通过学习率和 batch size 网格扫描来测发散边界。结果表明，训练在大部分阶段都靠近 edge-of-stability。小到中等 batch 时，噪声主导，表现为 stochastic edge-of-stability；大 batch 时，边界更接近确定性线性稳定分析的预测。论文还显示，线性稳定性分析对 blow-up 区域有相当解释力，但这种解释力依赖 checkpoint 所处训练阶段，后期通常更准。就预训练实践而言，这组结果支持一个经验事实：很多有效 recipe 并不是远离不稳定区，而是在边界附近运行以换取更快进展。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“验证近似是否成立 → 看谱结构 → 看稳定性”这个顺序读。

第一遍先看引言、Section 3 的实验设定和主结果图。重点不是公式，而是作者如何定义 prox 和 quad、如何从真实 checkpoint 出发做对照训练、以及“能预测 10% 训练窗口”到底是怎样的比较标准。这里决定了整篇工作的可信度。

第二遍精读 Section 4。要重点看 Hessian 与 Gauss-Newton 的谱图、Adam 预条件前后的对比、以及 head-tail 分裂的证据。值得深挖的点有两个：一是为什么谱头部和 vocab / unembedding 强相关，这和 softmax 输出层的参数化、词表大小、logit geometry 有什么关系；二是 power-law tail 对 batch size 与 Adam 都近乎不变，这意味着哪些训练现象是“几何固有”的，哪些只是优化器表面效应。

第三遍看 Section 5 的稳定性分析。重点关注作者如何定义 blow-up、如何做学习率与 batch size 乘子扫描、以及理论边界与实测边界的对应关系。这里最值得思考的是 stochastic edge 与 deterministic edge 的区分，因为它直接关系到 batch scaling law、gradient noise scale、以及为什么大 batch 训练常需要更谨慎的调度。

如果只抓最有信息量的图表，优先看：Taylor 代理与真实轨迹对比图；Hessian / Gauss-Newton 谱图；Adam 预条件前后谱对比；学习率-批大小稳定区域图。阅读时间上，完整精读大概需要 1.5 到 2 小时，若只抓结论和方法设计，40 分钟左右可以建立较完整印象。
summary.authors_note: 代码仓库链接指向 alexandrumeterez/QuadraticModel，作者应包含 Alexandru Meterez 等。摘要与正文片段未完整给出作者列表和机构，无法可靠确认，故留空。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a concrete question that optimization theory often sidesteps: how far can a local quadratic model actually describe real LLM pretraining dynamics? It breaks this into three subproblems. First, predictivity: if we Taylor-expand the model and loss at an intermediate checkpoint, can the resulting local proxy predict the future training trajectory over a nontrivial window? Second, structure: if the local approximation is meaningful, what do the Hessian and Gauss-Newton spectra look like along training, and which parts are tied to vocabulary/output-layer effects versus more universal geometry? Third, stability: does pretraining spend most of its time near the edge of stability, and does that regime differ across batch sizes? This matters because a large fraction of practical intuition around learning-rate schedules, batch scaling, preconditioning, and acceleration is built on quadratic or linearized models, but direct validation on actual LLM training has been limited.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is important less as a new optimizer and more as a validation layer for a large body of optimization reasoning. First, it shows that local Taylor proxies are not merely infinitesimal approximations: in a 150M-parameter transformer trained on 3B tokens, they can remain predictive over windows as long as roughly 10% of total training, with noticeably better agreement later in training. That gives empirical support to using quadratic analyses for practical pretraining questions. Second, the spectral measurements are unusually informative: the spectrum separates into a head whose size is set by vocabulary and dominated by the unembedding layer, and a power-law tail that is nearly invariant across batch sizes and largely unaffected by Adam preconditioning. That is directly relevant to output-layer parameterization, tokenizer/vocabulary choices, and curvature structure. Third, the stability analysis sharpens the edge-of-stability story: small and medium batches operate in a noise-dominated stochastic edge regime, while large batches move toward the deterministic edge predicted by linear theory. The broader implication is that LLM training is typically run close to stability limits regardless of batch size, but the mechanism changes with noise scale.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The methodology is strong because the paper turns a vague theoretical claim into a falsifiable training experiment. The base model is a 150M transformer trained on 3B FineWeb tokens, with checkpoints saved every 10% of training. Around each checkpoint, the authors build two local proxies. The first, prox, linearizes the network outputs while keeping the cross-entropy objective; this is equivalent to multiclass logistic regression in the NTK parameterization. The second, quad, further takes a second-order Taylor expansion of that objective, yielding a convex quadratic problem. Starting from the same checkpoint, they continue training these proxy systems and compare them against the original nonlinear trajectory under matched conditions. The key point is not just local loss fitting at a single step, but whether the proxies reproduce meaningful optimization behavior over a sizable future window.

For geometry, the paper estimates Hessian and Gauss-Newton spectra along training, both before and after Adam-style preconditioning. The estimation uses very deep Lanczos quadrature probes with error bands, resolving the spectrum over roughly six orders of magnitude. This is a major practical detail: many prior empirical studies only resolve the top few eigenvalues, which is insufficient for claims about tail behavior. The resulting picture is a clear head-tail split. The head is tied to vocabulary size and is dominated by the unembedding layer. The tail follows a power law and appears universal in the sense that it is nearly identical across batch sizes and not materially altered by Adam preconditioning. Using these curves, the authors estimate a capacity exponent around alpha ≈ 1 in the resolvable tail and a source exponent beta < 1, contradicting summability assumptions that appear in parts of the optimization and inverse-problems literature.

For stability, the paper combines theory with direct blow-up tests. From multiple checkpoints, it runs preconditioned SGD over a grid of learning-rate and batch-size multipliers, measuring which settings diverge and comparing the observed boundary to linear stability predictions. This is a good design choice because it tests the practical content of edge-of-stability theory rather than treating it as a metaphor. The results separate two regimes: stochastic edge of stability at small to medium batch sizes, where gradient noise is essential, and deterministic edge of stability at large batch sizes, where classical linear analysis becomes more accurate.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments use a 150M-parameter transformer trained on 3B FineWeb tokens. Checkpoints are saved every 10% of training, and around each checkpoint the authors construct the prox and quad local surrogates. The central empirical result is that both surrogates can track the real optimization trajectory over windows up to about 10% of total training, with substantially better agreement later in training than early on. The paper does not claim that a single quadratic model explains the entire run; the claim is more precise and more useful: over a practically meaningful local horizon, the approximation is predictive enough to support analysis.

The spectral experiments estimate Hessian and Gauss-Newton spectra with deep Lanczos probes over six orders of magnitude. Three observations stand out. First, the spectral head has a size linked to vocabulary and is dominated by the unembedding layer, indicating that the output layer contributes a distinct curvature structure. Second, the tail follows a stable power law and is almost unchanged across batch sizes. Third, Adam preconditioning does not remove this tail structure, suggesting that preconditioning does not whiten the problem into something close to isotropic geometry. From the measured spectra, the paper estimates a capacity exponent alpha ≈ 1 and a source exponent beta < 1 in the resolvable tail, which runs against common summability assumptions.

The stability experiments scan learning-rate and batch-size multipliers to map divergence boundaries. The outcome is that training spends most of its time near the edge of stability. At small and medium batch sizes, the regime is noise-dominated and better described as a stochastic edge of stability. At large batch sizes, the observed boundary aligns more closely with deterministic linear stability theory. The predictive quality of the linearized analysis also improves later in training, matching the earlier observation that local Taylor models become more accurate toward the end of pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good reading order is: first verify that the local approximation is genuinely predictive, then study the spectral structure, then read the stability section.

Start with the introduction and the main experiments in Section 3. Focus on how prox and quad are defined, how the checkpoint-based continuation experiments are set up, and what exactly it means for a proxy to remain predictive over a 10%-of-training window. That section determines whether the rest of the paper should be taken as more than a theoretical analogy.

Then read Section 4 carefully. The most important figures are the Hessian and Gauss-Newton spectra, the before/after-Adam comparisons, and the evidence for the head-tail split. Two questions are worth keeping in mind. Why is the spectral head so tightly linked to vocabulary size and the unembedding layer? And why is the power-law tail so insensitive to batch size and Adam preconditioning? Those observations have implications for output-layer design, tokenizer/vocabulary choices, and what parts of optimization geometry are intrinsic versus optimizer-induced.

Finally, read Section 5 on stability. Pay attention to how blow-up is operationally defined, how the learning-rate/batch-size multiplier grid is constructed, and how the measured instability boundary compares to linear predictions. The distinction between stochastic and deterministic edge-of-stability regimes is the part most likely to matter for practical pretraining recipes, especially for batch scaling and schedule design.

If time is limited, prioritize the trajectory-comparison figures, the spectral plots, the Adam-preconditioned spectrum comparison, and the stability maps. A full careful read is about 1.5 to 2 hours; a focused pass for the main ideas is around 40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 应读实验 setup 和 Hessian 分析；若 10% 训练窗口可复现，局部二次模型不再只是理论玩具。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and Hessian analysis; if the 10% training-window prediction holds up, the quadratic model is no longer just a theory toy.

paper.title: Hyperball May Not Be a Free Lunch
paper.abstract: For scale-invariant deep networks, Hyperball-style optimizers have shown strong performance in large-scale training by fixing the norms of matrix-valued parameters and normalizing updates. However, the source of their advantage remains unclear. Starting from the angular displacement between consecutive parameter states, we derive an angular effective learning rate that accounts for the parameter-update angle, parameter norm, and update norm. We also show that the conventional norm-based measure

summary.core_problem: Hyperball类优化器将矩阵参数约束在范数球面上，在大规模预训练中表现出性能优势，但其增益来源不明确；传统有效学习率分析默认参数与更新正交，无法解释Hyperball训练中前期落后、后期反超的阶段依赖行为。
summary.importance: 角有效学习率框架为预训练中的学习率调度、矩阵优化器（如MuonH）选型提供了更精细的分析工具；径向更新对训练动态的直接贡献有限，提示预训练中范数约束的收益可能更多来自更新方向的调整，而非单纯的步长控制。
summary.technical_approach: 从连续参数状态间的角位移出发，推导同时考虑参数-更新夹角、参数范数、更新范数的角有效学习率，证明传统基于范数的有效学习率是参数-更新正交条件下的特例。将优化器更新分解为径向（沿参数范数方向）和切向分量，量化分析径向更新对单步角位移的影响。提出状态依赖的学习率对齐方法，将非Hyperball优化器的每步角有效学习率与Hyperball版本对齐，以此分离两类优化器训练动态差异的来源。
summary.experiments: 在所测试的训练配置下，径向分量对角有效学习率的直接影响相对较小；通过对齐角有效学习率，可以复现Hyperball优化器部分阶段依赖的训练行为，说明其性能增益部分来自有效步长的变化，而非完全来自范数约束本身的特殊作用。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第2节的角有效学习率推导逻辑和实验部分的学习率对齐结果，可跳过过于理论化的数学推导细节；预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Hyperball-style optimizers, which constrain matrix parameters to norm spheres, show strong performance in large-scale pretraining, but the source of their advantage remains unclear. Conventional effective learning rate analysis assumes orthogonality between parameters and updates, failing to explain the phase-dependent behavior of Hyperball training (underperforming early, overtaking in later stages).
summary_en.importance: The angular effective learning rate framework provides a more fine-grained analytical tool for learning rate scheduling and matrix optimizer (e.g., MuonH) selection in pretraining. The finding that radial updates have limited direct contribution suggests that the benefits of norm constraints in pretraining may come more from update direction adjustment than pure step size control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from angular displacement between consecutive parameter states, the work derives an angular effective learning rate that explicitly accounts for the parameter-update angle, parameter norm, and update norm, recovering the conventional norm-based measure as a special case under parameter-update orthogonality. It decomposes optimizer updates into radial (along parameter norm direction) and tangential components, and quantifies the direct effect of radial updates on one-step angular displacement. A state-dependent learning rate alignment procedure is proposed to match the per-step angular effective learning rate of non-Hyperball optimizers to their Hyperball counterparts, isolating the source of dynamical differences between the two optimizer families.
summary_en.experiments: Under the training configurations tested, the radial component has relatively small direct effect on the angular effective learning rate. By aligning angular effective learning rates, part of the phase-dependent training behavior of Hyperball optimizers can be reproduced, indicating that part of their performance gain comes from changes in effective step size rather than entirely from the norm constraint itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: focus on Section 2 for the derivation logic of angular effective learning rate and the experimental results of learning rate alignment; skip overly theoretical mathematical derivation details. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这类 paper 不直接给 recipe，但会改你看 Muon/Hyperball 的方式；重点读角度学习率定义和 radial/tangential 分解，别只看最终收敛曲线。
recommendation.en: This won’t hand you a recipe, but it may change how you reason about Muon/Hyperball; read the angular LR definition and the radial/tangential decomposition, not just the end metrics.

paper.title: Thermodynamic Weight Decay: Exploring Grokking Acceleration via Attention Specific Heat
paper.abstract: Grokking -- the delayed generalization of neural networks long after they have memorized their training data -- wastes thousands of training epochs and is notoriously unpredictable. Building on the recent result that Transformer attention is formally isomorphic to a thermodynamic system, we treat the variance of attention logits as a specific heat Cv and show that its peak reliably precedes the generalization transition. We introduce CvAdamW, a drop-in AdamW variant that monitors Cv online and i

summary.core_problem: grokking 现象（先记忆后泛化）训练周期长且不可预测，想要更早、更稳定地触发泛化相变。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练动态信号+优化器改造：把注意力logits方差当作“比热”并用于在线调参；对理解Transformer训练相变有一定启发，但目前证据主要在玩具任务。
summary.technical_approach: 基于“注意力≈热力学系统”的类比，定义注意力logits方差为比热Cv；观察Cv峰值先于泛化转折点出现。提出CvAdamW：在线监控Cv，在检测到相变时动态缩放weight decay以“注入热能”。为稳定信号，加入memorization gate与EMA shock absorber，处理初始化噪声、mini-batch微波纹、slingshot blinding三类失败模式。
summary.experiments: 主要在模算术任务(a+b mod 97)上：声称在4000 epoch预算下，baseline不grok，而CvAdamW可在epoch 2802发生grokking；其余扩展实验在摘要中未给出细节（需看正文验证是否跨seed/规模稳健）。

summary_en.core_problem: Grokking is delayed and unpredictable; the paper aims to trigger the generalization phase transition earlier and more reliably.
summary_en.importance: A training-dynamics signal plus an optimizer tweak: uses an attention-derived ‘specific heat’ to adapt weight decay online. Potentially interesting, but evidence appears mostly toy-task based.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treat attention-logit variance as specific heat Cv; empirically, Cv peaks before the generalization transition. Proposes CvAdamW: monitor Cv online and dynamically scale weight decay when a phase transition is detected. Adds a memorization gate and an EMA shock absorber to mitigate noise/micro-ripples/blinding failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: Primarily modular arithmetic (a+b mod 97): within 4,000 epochs, baseline never groks while CvAdamW reportedly groks at epoch 2,802; robustness across seeds/scales is unclear from the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把“注意力logit方差峰值→相变预警”做成自适应weight decay，想法有趣但像玩具任务调参；只需看信号定义和失败模式排查。
recommendation.en: Turns “attention-logit variance peak as phase-transition early warning” into adaptive weight decay; intriguing but likely toy-task tuning—read for the signal definition and failure-mode analysis only.

paper.title: Adaptive Depth in Looped Transformers: Diagnosing Learned Halting Gates and Trajectory Readouts
paper.abstract: Looped Transformers increase test-time computation by repeatedly applying a shared recurrent block. Learned halting objectives in looped Transformers typically use a single exit distribution both as the inference-time stopping rule and as the training-time weighting of per-depth losses. This entangles exit selection with trajectory formation: the gate not only chooses which recurrent state to use, but also determines how strongly each intermediate state is supervised. Consequently, poor adaptive

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 looped Transformer 的自适应深度为什么经常表现不稳定。核心问题不是单纯“halting gate 学得好不好”，而是现有目标把两个角色绑在了一起：同一个 exit distribution 既用于推理时决定在哪一层停止，也用于训练时加权不同 recurrent depth 的 loss。这样 gate 会同时影响停止策略和隐藏状态轨迹的形成，导致性能问题很难归因。
summary.importance: 对预训练和推理时可扩展计算有直接启发。Looped Transformer 试图用共享 block 的反复迭代来换取更灵活的 test-time compute，这和动态深度、latent refinement、reasoning-time scaling 都有关。论文的主要贡献是把 adaptive depth 拆成 trajectory formation 和 readout selection 两个问题。这个拆分很有用，因为它提醒训练目标本身可能污染中间状态轨迹，不能只在 gate 参数化上做小改动。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先形式化 looped Transformer：输入经过 embedding 得到 h0，然后反复应用共享 Transformer block Fθ，得到 h1 到 hT 的 hidden-state trajectory。常见 PonderNet 式 halting gate 在每个深度 t 输出条件停止概率 e_t=σ(gφ(h_t))，由此得到 exit depth 分布 q_t。推理时用累计概率超过阈值 α 的位置作为停止深度；训练时则用 q_t 对每个深度的交叉熵 loss 加权，并加上与目标 depth prior 的正则。问题在于 q_t 进入训练 loss 后，gate 不只是 readout，还会改变哪些深度被强监督，从而改变轨迹。为了解耦，作者引入 fixed-prior depth supervision：用固定深度先验来塑造 recurrent trajectory，而不是让输入相关 gate 同时决定监督权重。之后再用 post-hoc readout，包括简单 confidence readout、线性 gate、MLP gate、forced exit 等方式，单独评估不同轨迹上的停止策略。这个设计比直接比较 halting gate 更干净，因为它能区分“轨迹本身是否有可早退的中间状态”和“readout 是否能选对停止点”。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖受控合成任务和较大规模 checkpoint。合成任务包括 MANO modular arithmetic 和 binary parity，用来观察不同难度样本的 recurrent trajectory 是否自然分化。大模型部分使用 Ouro-1.4B 和 Ouro-2.6B checkpoint，评估已有 ponder gates 在真实语言模型上的 compute-quality tradeoff。主要结果有三点。第一，fixed-prior depth supervision 即使没有学习输入相关 halting policy，也能产生 difficulty-aware trajectories，中间状态对简单样本更早可用。第二，简单 confidence readout 在若干设置下可以匹配甚至超过 learned linear / MLP gates，说明瓶颈不一定在 gate 表达能力。第三，Ouro 预训练 ponder gates 并不总在 Pareto frontier 上，post-hoc readout 有时能取得更好的平均退出深度与精度折中。论文还报告了 latency measurement，用实际延迟验证平均 exit depth 的下降能转化为推理速度收益，而不只是理论 FLOPs 改善。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 formalization 部分，尤其是 q_t 同时作为 inference stopping rule 和 training loss weight 的推导，这是全文最关键的诊断。然后看 fixed-prior depth supervision 的设计，以及 learned gate、confidence readout、forced exit 的对照实验。图表上优先找 compute-accuracy Pareto 曲线、MANO 难度分层轨迹分析、Ouro-1.4B/2.6B 的 post-hoc readout 对比和 latency 结果。若关注动态深度预训练，可以深挖一个问题：训练阶段是否应该先学出“可读”的深度轨迹，再把 halting policy 作为独立模块训练，而不是端到端把二者绑在一个 objective 里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why adaptive depth in looped Transformers is hard to make reliable. The central issue is the coupling between two roles of the learned exit distribution: it acts as the inference-time stopping rule, and it also weights the per-depth training losses. As a result, a halting gate does not only choose an exit state; it also shapes the recurrent trajectory from which exits are later selected.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining and inference-time compute scaling for recurrent or looped language models. Looped Transformers reuse a shared block over multiple iterations, so adaptive depth is a natural way to allocate more computation to harder inputs. The useful contribution here is the trajectory-readout decomposition. It shows that failures of learned halting should not be attributed only to weak gate architectures. The training objective itself can change the intermediate representations and make the stopping problem ill-posed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes a looped Transformer as a sequence of hidden states h1...hT produced by repeatedly applying a shared Transformer block Fθ. A PonderNet-style gate predicts a conditional halt probability e_t=σ(gφ(h_t)) at each recurrent depth, inducing an exit distribution q_t. At inference time, the model exits when the cumulative exit probability exceeds a threshold. During training, the same q_t is used to weight the cross-entropy losses at different depths, usually with a regularizer toward a target depth prior. This creates the coupling: the learned gate controls both supervision allocation and final readout. To separate these effects, the authors introduce fixed-prior depth supervision, where a fixed depth prior shapes the recurrent trajectory without learning an input-dependent halting policy. They then evaluate post-hoc readouts on the resulting trajectories, including confidence-based exits, linear gates, MLP gates, and forced-exit diagnostics.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span controlled synthetic tasks and larger pretrained checkpoints. The synthetic side includes MANO modular arithmetic and binary parity, where difficulty can be analyzed more directly. The large-model side evaluates Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B checkpoints. The main findings are consistent across settings. Fixed-prior depth supervision can produce difficulty-aware trajectories even without a learned input-dependent halting policy. Simple confidence-based readouts often match or outperform learned linear and MLP gates in compute-accuracy tradeoffs. Pretrained ponder gates in Ouro are not uniformly Pareto-optimal. The paper also includes latency measurements, showing that lower average exit depth can translate into practical inference speedups rather than only nominal compute reductions.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Start with the formalization of adaptive depth and focus on the equations where q_t appears both in the inference stopping rule and in the training loss. Then read the fixed-prior depth supervision setup and the comparison between learned gates, confidence readouts, and forced exits. The most informative plots are the compute-accuracy Pareto curves, the difficulty-stratified MANO trajectory analysis, the Ouro-1.4B/Ouro-2.6B readout comparisons, and the latency measurements. For readers working on dynamic-depth pretraining, the key question to pursue is whether trajectory learning and halting-policy learning should be staged or otherwise decoupled.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 adaptive depth 失效原因的 prior：先别怪模型不会算，先查 gate 把监督和停机绑死了；读合成任务和 Ouro 分析就够。
recommendation.en: This can change your prior on why adaptive depth fails: don’t blame the model first—check whether the gate entangles supervision with halting; the synthetic tasks plus Ouro analysis are the parts to read.

paper.title: The Orthogonalized Read Is a Removable Training Scaffold for Recurrent Memory
paper.abstract: A recent report finds that orthogonalizing the mLSTM memory matrix at read time (five Newton-Schulz iterations, trained through) substantially improves noisy associative recall. The effect replicates, but it is not a memory improvement. Training on this task is a long chance plateau followed by a sharp escape, and the orthogonalized read acts by re-conditioning the learning problem during the plateau. Three properties establish this. It must be self-consistent: an exact recursive least-squares r

summary.core_problem: 有研究提出，mLSTM读记忆矩阵时做五次带梯度回传的Newton-Schulz正交化迭代，可大幅提升噪声联想召回任务性能。这篇工作旨在拆解该干预的实际作用机制，区分其效果是来自记忆容量的固有提升，还是来自训练动力学层面的影响。
summary.importance: 这一工作揭示了循环/SSM类架构小尺度机械化评测的关键误区：在MAD、Zoology等合成联想召回基准上的固定预算性能，往往衡量的是优化器逃离随机平台的概率，而非架构的渐近能力。部分被认为是架构层面的能力改进，实际只是可移除的训练脚手架，这对“小尺度基准排名可直接迁移到大模型训练”的常用假设提出了反证。分析过程也为理解大模型中阈值式的性能跃迁现象提供了小尺度可完全复现的观测样本。
summary.technical_approach: 作者通过控制变量消融、训练动力学追踪、脚手架移除实验系统拆解正交化读的作用：（1）复现原报告的性能提升；（2）发现训练过程符合“长期随机平台→突然逃逸收敛”的两阶段模式，固定训练步长下的准确率是逃逸概率的删失观测值；（3）通过一系列对照实验（直通估计器拆分、delta规则写入、冻结随机key、纯归一化、精确递归最小二乘读等），确认自一致的读白化是效果产生的唯一必要条件；（4）通过推理期移除正交化、训练后期退火将正交化强度降到零的实验，验证脚手架属性；（5）在学习率、任务难度、batch size构成的实验网格上，量化正交化对逃逸概率的影响，拟合逃逸风险关于优化超参的缩放关系。
summary.experiments: （1）复现结果：原实验设置下，正交化读将任务解决率从3/16提升到9/16，统计显著；（2）调度混淆：将余弦学习率周期从2000步拉长到4000步，基线解决率提升到11/16，和正交化方法2000步的效果相当；墙钟时间对齐的常量学习率基线解决率达14/16，超过正交化方法的9/16；（3）机制消融：只有自一致白化读（正交化、精确RLS读）能产生效果，直通拆分、delta规则保持记忆条件数、纯Frobenius归一化均无收益，记忆秩坍缩是平台期的症状而非原因；（4）脚手架属性：用正交化读训练收敛的9个模型中，7个在推理期移除正交化后仍保持性能，仅带来5-9个点的精度损失；训练最后30%退火将正交化强度降到零，最终得到标准mLSTM模型，解决率12/16，精度95-100%；按逃逸事件触发退火而非固定时间窗口，解决率达13/16，所有收敛模型推理时完全不用正交化，平均精度99.6%；（5）网格实验：正交化读将逃逸率提升6.4倍，效果与任务难度无交互，核心作用是拓宽可用学习率区间，挽救过低学习率的慢收敛、抑制过高学习率的不稳定；（6）逃逸律：逃逸率与单步更新强度正相关（弹性3.0），与SGD梯度噪声（lr²/B）负相关（弹性-1.65），两者的抵消效应解释了稳定学习率走廊的存在。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第4章的调度混淆分析、第6章的脚手架移除实验、第8章的逃逸律拟合，这几部分的结论对训练动力学研究和架构评测有普适参考价值。如果不直接做mLSTM相关开发，可以跳过Newton-Schulz迭代的实现细节，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: A recent intervention reports that applying five Newton-Schulz orthogonalization iterations to the mLSTM memory matrix at read time (with gradients propagated through the iterations) dramatically improves noisy associative recall performance. This work investigates the actual mechanism behind this improvement, to distinguish whether it reflects an intrinsic increase in memory capacity, or an effect on training dynamics.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a critical caveat for small-scale mechanistic architecture evaluation of recurrent/SSM models: fixed-budget performance on synthetic recall benchmarks such as MAD and Zoology often measures the optimizer's probability of escaping a chance-level plateau, not the asymptotic capability of the architecture. It demonstrates that several purported architectural improvements act only as removable training scaffolds, which calls into question the common assumption that small-scale benchmark rankings transfer directly to large-scale training setups. The analysis also provides a fully instrumented small-scale analogue of thresholded performance transitions observed in large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use controlled ablations, training dynamics tracking, and scaffold removal experiments to isolate the effect of read-time orthogonalization: (1) replicate the original reported performance gain; (2) characterize training as a two-stage process of extended chance plateau followed by abrupt escape to high performance, showing fixed-step performance is a censored measurement of escape hazard; (3) run a sequence of controlled ablations (straight-through estimator splits, delta-rule writes, frozen random keys, pure normalization, exact RLS readout) to identify that self-consistent read whitening is the only necessary condition for the effect; (4) test scaffold properties by removing orthogonalization at inference, and annealing orthogonalization strength to zero late in training; (5) run a grid of experiments across learning rate, task hardness, and batch size to quantify the effect of orthogonalization on escape probability, and fit a scaling law for escape hazard as a function of optimization hyperparameters.
summary_en.experiments: (1) Replication: Orthogonalized read increases solve rate from 3/16 to 9/16 on the original setup, a statistically significant gain; (2) Schedule confound: Extending the cosine learning rate period from 2000 to 4000 steps lifts baseline solve rate to 11/16, matching the orthogonalized result at 2000 steps. A constant learning rate baseline reaches 14/16 solve rate matched on wall-clock time, outperforming the 9/16 rate of the orthogonalized setup; (3) Mechanism ablations: Only self-consistent whitening (orthogonalization, exact RLS read) produces the gain; straight-through splits, delta-rule memory conditioning, and Frobenius normalization alone show no benefit. Memory rank collapse is a symptom of the plateau, not its cause; (4) Scaffold property: 7/9 converged models trained with orthogonalized read retain performance when orthogonalization is removed at inference, with only a 5-9 point accuracy drop. Annealing orthogonalization strength to zero over the last 30% of training produces standard mLSTM models with 12/16 solve rate and 95-100% accuracy. Triggering annealing based on escape detection rather than a fixed schedule reaches 13/16 solve rate, with all converged models using zero orthogonalization at inference and 99.6% mean accuracy; (5) Grid experiments: Orthogonalized read increases escape hazard by 6.4x across settings, with no detectable interaction with task hardness, primarily acting to widen the usable learning rate range by rescuing overly low learning rates and suppressing instability at overly high learning rates; (6) Escape law: Escape hazard scales with per-step update magnitude (elasticity 3.0) and inversely with SGD gradient noise (lr²/B, elasticity -1.65); the cancellation of these two effects explains the existence of the stable learning rate corridor.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4 (schedule confound analysis), Section 6 (scaffold removal experiments), and Section 8 (escape law fitting), which carry the most generalizable insights for training dynamics and architecture evaluation. Skip implementation details of Newton-Schulz iterations unless working directly on mLSTM variants. Allocate ~25 minutes for reading.

recommendation.zh: 做循环架构（mLSTM/SSM）或训练动态的研究员可看§3的可移除性实验，纠正了正交化读取是推理增强的错误认知。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on recurrent architectures (mLSTM/SSM) or training dynamics should check §3 removability experiments; corrects the misconception that orthogonalized read is inference-time enhancement.

paper.title: Disentangling Curriculum Learning in NLP: Towards a Unifying Taxonomy
paper.abstract: Despite more than a decade of curriculum learning (CL) research in NLP, the field lacks a principled account of which difficulty function or scheduler to use for a given problem. To understand what has hindered progress towards this account, we propose a fine-grained taxonomy separating difficulty evaluation from training scheduling to enable systematic analysis of CL strategies. For difficulty evaluation, we distinguish attribution source and task dependence, revealing difficulty as a perspecti

summary.core_problem: 解决 NLP 中 curriculum learning 研究长期缺乏统一描述框架的问题，尤其是 difficulty function 与 scheduler 经常被混在一起，导致结果不可比。
summary.importance: 这是分析与概念澄清工作，不直接提出新的预训练 recipe，但对数据课程、样本排序和训练调度研究有方法论价值。对做 pretrain data curriculum 的研究员，主要价值是避免把“难度定义”和“调度策略”混为一谈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出细粒度 taxonomy，将 curriculum learning 拆成 difficulty evaluation 与 training scheduling 两部分；在 difficulty 侧区分 attribution source 和 task dependence，在 scheduling 侧用 expected training contribution 形式化 scheduler，并引入 retention regimes 与 monotonicity 等性质来比较不同实现。
summary.experiments: 核心不是新模型实验，而是对既有 NLP curriculum learning 工作做系统分析，指出大量工作因难度概念和调度机制耦合而不可直接比较。摘要未给出新的大规模预训练实验或统一 benchmark 复现实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of a unifying account of curriculum learning in NLP, where difficulty functions and schedulers are often conflated, making prior results hard to compare.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis and conceptual-clarification paper rather than a new pretraining recipe. Its value for pretraining researchers lies in cleaning up how data curriculum, sample ordering, and scheduling should be discussed and compared.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a fine-grained taxonomy that separates curriculum learning into difficulty evaluation and training scheduling. On the difficulty side, it distinguishes attribution source and task dependence; on the scheduling side, it formalizes schedulers via expected training contribution and introduces properties such as retention regimes and monotonicity for comparing implementations.
summary_en.experiments: The contribution is mainly a structured analysis of prior NLP curriculum-learning papers, arguing that many are systematically incomparable because they mix distinct notions of difficulty and scheduling. The abstract does not indicate new large-scale pretraining experiments or a unified benchmark reproduction.

recommendation.zh: 不是结果型论文，但概念拆分是干净的；如果你在做 data curriculum，只看 taxonomy 和 scheduler formalization，能少踩很多“比较不成立”的坑。
recommendation.en: Not a results paper, but the conceptual split is clean; if you work on data curriculum, read the taxonomy and scheduler formalization to avoid a lot of invalid apples-to-oranges comparisons.

paper.title: Reassessing Muon for Matrix Factorization
paper.abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large-scale deep learning, where it reshapes gradient updates through approximate orthogonalization and has been reported to outperform Adam and AdamW in large language model training. Its empirical success has motivated a growing body of theoretical work that interprets Muon as steepest descent under the spectral norm. Yet it remains unclear which of Muon's advantages stem from its update rule itself and which are artifacts of the scale, archi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“Muon 在大模型上有没有用”，而是更基础的问题：把架构、数据、规模这些混杂因素拿掉之后，Muon 这个优化器本身到底在什么问题上占优。作者选了低秩矩阵分解、矩阵补全和非负矩阵分解这类结构清楚、谱性质明确的问题，专门检验 Muon 的正交化更新是否真的能利用谱结构、改善病态条件下的优化，还是它在 LLM 里的收益更多来自深网特有的训练动力学。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义在于，它给 Muon 这类“矩阵感知”优化器降了一次噪。过去不少结论来自 GPT 类训练，容易把优化器效果和模型深度、归一化、数据分布、batch 规模混在一起。这里的结果比较克制：在标准低秩分解和矩阵补全上，只要调参公平，AdamW 和 GD 往往能追平甚至超过 Muon；Muon 的稳定优势主要出现在 NMF 这类存在冗余因子竞争、表示多样性更关键的约束问题上。对做 LLM 预训练的人，这意味着 Muon 不是一个“普适更优”的替代品，它更像是在某些几何结构下有偏好的更新规则。这个判断比单纯看大模型 loss 曲线更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者没有提出新优化器，而是做了一个控制变量很严的再评估。核心做法有三层。第一，选取可系统扫描的问题族：对称 PSD 低秩分解、一般矩阵补全，以及非负矩阵分解。它们分别覆盖了无约束低秩恢复、观测缺失、以及带非负约束和因子冗余的情形。第二，做等预算、细调参比较。论文强调 Muon、Adam、AdamW、GD 都经过系统调参，而不是沿用社区默认超参，这一点很关键，因为 Muon 的 reported gain 很容易受学习率、动量、weight decay、正交化近似步数影响。第三，围绕“谱结构是否真的被利用”来解释结果。Muon 的更新会对梯度矩阵做近似正交化，相当于压平奇异值方向上的尺度差异，使更新更接近谱范数意义下的最速下降。直觉上这应当有利于低秩问题，但作者发现，在经典矩阵分解里，这种谱归一化并不天然优于坐标自适应；相反，AdamW 的逐坐标缩放在病态条件数下更直接。Muon 真正显出优势的地方，是 NMF 中它会抑制多个因子朝同一方向塌缩，减少冗余表示，促使因子更分散、更“去共线”。也就是说，Muon 的收益未必来自更快地拟合主奇异方向，而可能来自一种隐式的表示正则化。这个解释和它在深网里可能改善特征多样性、缓解表示退化的经验现象是相通的。
summary.experiments: 从全文给出的结论看，实验重点不是追求单一最好数值，而是比较不同问题结构下的相对排序。主要发现有四点。第一，在标准低秩矩阵分解上，Muon 的优势在公平调参后基本消失，AdamW 和 GD 可以达到相当甚至更好的收敛速度与最终误差。第二，在矩阵补全这类带采样缺失的问题上，Muon 同样没有表现出稳定领先，说明“梯度正交化自动更适合谱问题”这个直觉并不成立。第三，在 NMF 上，Muon 有更一致的优势，尤其是在过参数化或因子冗余更明显的设定下，能得到更好的重构和更少的因子重合。第四，病态条件数并不会自动把优势推向 Muon；很多情况下 AdamW 的自适应缩放更有效。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但正文的价值在于系统扫了条件数、参数化程度、任务变体，并把结论建立在 tuned comparison 上，而不是单点实验。对研究者来说，最该看的不是某个提升百分点，而是“哪类问题 Muon 不赢、哪类问题它才开始赢”这个边界。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 里的三个研究问题和 findings，再看实验主表与不同任务设定的对比图，最后补 Appendix 中 Muon 机制说明和 bilinear / completion 变体。预计 20 到 30 分钟能抓住主线。阅读时重点留意两件事：一是作者如何定义“公平比较”，包括超参搜索和预算控制；二是 NMF 里对因子冗余、表示多样性的解释，这部分比单纯的 loss 排名更有启发。如果你关心 Muon 能否迁移到 LLM 预训练 recipe，值得把这篇和大规模 Muon 经验论文对照着看：这里提供的是失败案例和适用边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a cleaner question than “does Muon help on large models?”: once architecture, data, and scale confounders are removed, where does Muon itself actually help. The authors use low-rank matrix factorization, matrix completion, and nonnegative matrix factorization as controlled testbeds to examine whether Muon’s orthogonalized update truly exploits spectral structure and improves optimization under ill-conditioning, or whether its gains in LLM training are tied to deep-network-specific dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is that it deconfounds a popular optimizer. Much of the excitement around Muon comes from GPT-style training, where optimizer effects are entangled with depth, normalization, data mixture, and large-batch behavior. The conclusion here is measured: on standard low-rank factorization and matrix completion, Muon’s reported gains largely disappear under fair tuning, and AdamW or even GD can match or beat it; Muon shows a more consistent advantage mainly in NMF-like settings where redundant factors compete and representation diversity matters. For LLM pretraining, that means Muon should not be read as a uniformly better drop-in replacement. It looks more like an optimizer with preferences for certain geometries.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is not a new optimizer but a tightly controlled reassessment. The setup has three important pieces. First, the authors choose problem families that can be systematically swept: symmetric PSD factorization, matrix completion, and NMF. These cover unconstrained low-rank recovery, missing-observation settings, and constrained factorization with nonnegativity and redundancy. Second, they run equal-budget, carefully tuned comparisons across Muon, Adam, AdamW, and GD, instead of inheriting community-default hyperparameters. This matters because Muon is sensitive to learning rate, momentum, weight decay, and the approximation details of the orthogonalization step. Third, they interpret results through the lens of what orthogonalization is actually doing. Muon approximately orthogonalizes matrix-shaped gradients, flattening singular-value anisotropy and moving closer to steepest descent under the spectral norm. One might expect that to help on spectral problems, but the paper shows that in classical matrix factorization this does not automatically beat coordinate-wise adaptivity; AdamW’s per-coordinate scaling is often more useful under ill-conditioning. Where Muon does help is NMF: orthogonalized updates appear to discourage factor collapse and reduce redundant directions, leading to more diverse factors. So the gain may come less from faster fitting of dominant singular directions and more from an implicit regularization effect on representation geometry.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental contribution is about relative behavior across regimes rather than a single headline number. Four findings stand out. First, on standard low-rank matrix factorization, Muon’s advantage mostly vanishes after fair tuning, with AdamW and GD reaching similar or better convergence and final error. Second, on matrix completion, Muon again does not show a stable lead, which weakens the simple intuition that spectral normalization should automatically help on spectrally structured tasks. Third, on NMF, Muon shows a more consistent advantage, especially in overparameterized settings or when factor redundancy is more severe, yielding better reconstruction and less factor overlap. Fourth, ill-conditioning alone does not hand the win to Muon; in many cases AdamW’s adaptive scaling remains stronger. The abstract truncates before detailed numbers, but the full paper’s value is the systematic sweep over conditioning, parameterization, and task variants, with conclusions grounded in tuned comparisons rather than one-off runs.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the Introduction and the three motivating questions, then read the main experimental figures and tables comparing tasks and regimes, and finally check the appendix sections that describe Muon and the bilinear/completion variants. About 20–30 minutes is enough to get the main message. Pay attention to two things: how the paper defines a fair optimizer comparison, including hyperparameter search and budget control; and how it explains Muon’s advantage in NMF through reduced redundancy and increased factor diversity. If you care about whether Muon should enter an LLM pretraining recipe, this paper is useful precisely because it maps out where Muon does not win.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不会直接给你新 recipe，但会压低你对 Muon 神效的先验；重点看它如何做 clean control，适合拿来校正内部 optimizer ablation 的口径。
recommendation.en: It will not hand you a new recipe, but it should lower your prior on Muon hype; read it for the clean control logic and use it to tighten internal optimizer ablations.

paper.title: Fisher Rank Inflation: A Spectral Signature of Memorization under Label Noise
paper.abstract: Deep networks trained with label noise often learn clean structure before memorizing corrupted labels. We show that this transition leaves a spectral signature in the centered scatter of per-example last-layer gradients. Its effective rank transiently expands during memorization and contracts after corrupted labels are fit. We call this phenomenon Fisher Rank Inflation. Corrupted labels increase effective rank by injecting spectral mass into low-energy or previously unused eigendirections, incre

summary.core_problem: 解决如何检测深度网络在标签噪声训练中从学习干净结构转向记忆噪声标签的转变问题，缺乏可解释的训练动态谱特征。
summary.importance: 原理分析，首次发现标签噪声下记忆过程的Fisher秩膨胀谱签名，为记忆检测和数据质量评估提供新视角。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Fisher Rank Inflation现象，通过分析每个样本最后一层梯度的中心散度有效秩，发现记忆阶段有效秩先膨胀后坍缩，推导留一法归因公式解释噪声样本的贡献。
summary.experiments: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CIFAR-10N数据集上，用SmallCNN、ResNet18、Vision Transformer验证了Fisher有效秩膨胀-坍缩轨迹的一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the problem of detecting the transition from learning clean structure to memorizing noisy labels in deep networks, where interpretable spectral signatures of training dynamics are lacking.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis work that first identifies the Fisher Rank Inflation spectral signature of memorization under label noise, providing a new perspective for memorization detection and data quality assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Fisher Rank Inflation phenomenon: the effective rank of per-example last-layer gradient centered scatter transiently expands during memorization and contracts after corrupted labels are fit. Derives a first-order leave-one-out attribution formula to explain the contribution of corrupted examples.
summary_en.experiments: Validates the consistent inflation-collapse trajectory of Fisher effective rank across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CIFAR-10N datasets with SmallCNN, ResNet18, and Vision Transformer models.

recommendation.zh: CV小模型上的记忆谱特征发现，思路可迁移到LLM记忆检测，但场景差异大，仅作参考。
recommendation.en: Spectral signature of memorization found in small CV models; transferable to LLM memorization detection but with large scenario gaps, for reference only.

paper.title: How are linear representations learned? Exact solutions to the dynamics of abstraction
paper.abstract: In artificial and biological neural networks, concepts are often encoded as consistent linear directions in representation space. In deep learning, this idea is known as the linear representation hypothesis and underpins many interpretability and control methods based on linear probes, from concept detection to activation steering. Yet while prior work has studied whether such directions should exist $\textit{after}$ training, the dynamics of how they emerge $\textit{during}$ training remain poo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个比“线性表征是否存在”更前一步的问题：训练过程中，概念方向为什么会逐渐对齐，何时会对齐，何时又会停在明显低于 1 的水平。作者把这个过程称为 abstraction dynamics。在线性表征假说已经被广泛用于 probe、steering、概念检测的背景下，真正缺的不是更多静态证据，而是一个能解释训练轨迹的动力学理论。论文试图回答三件事：数据几何如何决定抽象化速度和上限；网络深度如何改变这一过程；非线性，尤其是 ReLU，为什么常常让表征比线性理论预测得更不抽象。
summary.importance:
它对预训练的直接影响不是 recipe 层面的，而是机制层面的。价值主要体现在三点。第一，它把“抽象表征”从训练终点性质，推进成可解析的训练动力学变量，这对理解表示形成、线性 probe 何时有效、以及为什么某些层更适合 steering 很有帮助。第二，论文给出数据核结构、深度、非线性与 abstraction 之间的明确关系，提供了一个比经验观察更可操作的解释框架。对基座模型研究，这能帮助理解预训练中概念解耦、层间表示演化、以及 probe 泛化失败的来源。第三，作者把理论和现代模型联系起来，不只停在线性网络：他们在 DINOv3 和 Gemma 4 上做了非线性消融，发现去掉非线性后 abstraction 和 probe 泛化都会改善。这一点虽然不是直接的训练改进方案，但对表示工程、可解释性和中间层读写都有启发。

需要控制预期的是：这不是一篇直接告诉你如何把 loss 降得更快的论文。它更像一套关于表示几何形成机制的解析工具。对做大规模预训练的人，价值在于建立判断，而不是立刻改 recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三层推进。

第一层，是最小可解设置下的精确动力学。作者考虑两个二元概念，例如 shape 和 color，对应四个类别，构造出一个具有特定块结构的 dataset kernel，文中称为 2FS。这个设定的好处是，数据几何可以被压缩成少数几类核条目和对应特征模态。在线性网络里，作者把表示分解到若干可解释的方向上，其中关键是“概念主方向”和一个与概念交互相关、会破坏平行性的正交 interaction mode，文中把它视作 noise direction。这样一来，abstraction，也就是不同上下文下概念向量的余弦相似度，就能写成这些模态系数的函数。随后作者求解梯度下降训练下这些模态的完整时间轨迹，从而得到 abstraction 的解析轨迹，而不是只看收敛点。

第二层，是从浅层线性网络推广到任意深度。作者利用深线性网络可解析动力学的工具，推导深度如何改变不同模态的学习速度和相对放大程度。论文的一个核心结论是：深度并不会无条件提高 abstraction，它会通过谱偏置改变各模态的竞争关系，因此最终 abstraction 和训练中达到的最大 abstraction 都受数据谱结构控制。换句话说，深度的作用不是简单“更深更抽象”，而是“更深会重新加权哪些方向先学到、学多快、谁压过谁”。这比很多经验性说法更细。

第三层，是推广到无限宽非线性网络，并分析 feature 与 preactivation 的差异。作者在 NTK/核回归风格的框架下，证明非线性会削弱 feature 中的 abstraction，相比之下 preactivation 更接近线性理论。对 ReLU，作者进一步说明它会重塑动力学，使表示更依赖输入几何而不是目标结构，因此更容易保留或放大 interaction/noise mode，导致抽象化变弱。论文还给出对 tanh 往往比 ReLU 更有利于抽象表征的理论解释，这与先前经验观察对上了。

一个值得注意的点是，作者不仅讨论最终 abstraction，还区分 final abstraction 和 maximum abstraction reached during training。因为训练轨迹可以非单调，模型中途可能更抽象，后期反而回落。这一点对理解 checkpoint 选择、probe 时机、以及中间层监督都很重要。
summary.experiments:
实验分为理论验证和现实模型现象两部分。

理论验证部分，作者在最小合成数据和深线性/非线性网络上检查解析式是否准确预测 abstraction trajectory。文中图 1C 已经给出一个重要现象：真实深网络在 3dshapes 上的 abstraction 轨迹是非单调的，而且平台值明显低于 1，这正是旧理论解释不了的。图 1D 进一步显示 abstraction 与 probe 的跨上下文泛化误差紧密相关，例如只在 red 样本上训练 shape classifier，再测试到 blue 上，其误差趋势能被作者的命题近似预测。这说明 abstraction 不是纯几何指标，而和线性 probe 的 OOD 泛化直接相关。

更贴近大模型的部分在第 5 节。作者对 DINOv3 和 Gemma 4 做非线性消融，结论是 ablate nonlinearity 后，abstraction 提升，线性 probe 泛化也改善。给定正文片段没有完整表格数字，无法可靠抄出具体提升幅度，但从作者的叙述看，这不是单一层的偶然现象，而是跨层可见的趋势。另一个实验方向是神经科学数据：论文展示 macaque ventral stream 层级越往后 abstraction 越强，用来说明理论不只适用于人工网络。

如果从 LLM 研究者角度看，最值得留意的实验不是谁赢了多少点，而是三条经验规律是否成立：1）abstraction 与 probe 跨分布泛化相关；2）非线性，尤其 ReLU，会压低 abstraction；3）训练轨迹可能先升后降，因此只看最终 checkpoint 会漏掉关键信息。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着问题读。泛读可先看第 1 节和图 1，抓住作者到底在解释什么现象。然后直接看第 3 节的主定理和图，理解在线性网络里 abstraction trajectory 是如何被精确求出来的。第 4 节值得看，因为它回答了一个更现实的问题：为什么线性理论到了 ReLU 网络里会失真。最后看第 5 节里 DINOv3 和 Gemma 4 的非线性消融，这部分决定它是否只是一篇漂亮理论。

预计阅读时间 35 到 50 分钟。若时间有限，优先顺序是：图 1 → 2FS 设定与 abstraction 定义 → 线性动力学主结果 → 非线性削弱 abstraction 的命题 → Gemma 4 实验。

值得深挖的点有两个。第一，作者把 interaction mode 当作降低 abstraction 的关键“噪声方向”，这和预训练里常见的 entangled features 很接近，可以思考它是否能映射到真实 LLM 中的 token co-occurrence 或 style/topic 混杂方向。第二，论文区分 preactivation 与 feature 的 abstraction，这对解释为什么某些层做 probe 很好、但经过激活后 steering 变差，提供了一个可检验框架。
summary.authors_note: University College London 相关团队，来自 Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit 与 Sainsbury Wellcome Centre。给定内容显示为神经科学与机器学习交叉背景作者；具体姓名在片段中未完整展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more fundamental question than whether linear concept directions exist after training: how do they emerge during training, why do they sometimes align only partially, and why is the trajectory often non-monotonic? The authors call this process abstraction, defined as the alignment of concept vectors across contexts. This addresses a real gap in the linear representation hypothesis literature. Static end-state arguments are not enough if one wants to understand when linear probes work, why steering directions are cleaner in some layers than others, or why real networks often plateau far below perfect abstraction.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is conceptual rather than recipe-level. The paper turns abstraction from an endpoint property into a dynamical variable with analytic structure. That matters for understanding representation formation, probe generalization, and layerwise disentanglement in large models. A second contribution is that it ties abstraction to concrete factors: dataset geometry, depth, and nonlinearity. Instead of saying that deeper models or larger models become more abstract, it shows how spectral structure and training dynamics determine which modes dominate and when. Third, the theory is connected back to modern models: the paper reports that ablating nonlinearities improves abstraction and probe generalization in DINOv3 and Gemma 4. That does not immediately yield a better pretraining recipe, but it is useful for mechanistic analysis, representation engineering, and thinking about where linear readouts should or should not be trusted.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper builds its theory in three stages.

First, it solves a minimal linear setting exactly. The setup uses two binary concepts, such as shape and color, giving four classes. The dataset kernel is assumed to have a structured block form called 2FS, which compresses the geometry into a small number of entry types and corresponding modes. In this basis, the representation can be decomposed into interpretable components: concept-aligned modes and an orthogonal interaction mode that reduces parallelism between concept vectors. This interaction mode acts as a noise direction for abstraction. With this decomposition, abstraction, measured as cosine similarity between counterfactual concept vectors, becomes an explicit function of mode amplitudes. The authors then derive exact gradient-descent trajectories for these amplitudes, yielding a closed-form training-time trajectory of abstraction rather than only a convergence statement.

Second, the theory is extended to arbitrary depth in deep linear networks. The key result is not that depth always helps abstraction. Instead, depth changes the relative learning dynamics of different spectral modes. Final abstraction and the maximum abstraction reached during training both depend on how depth reweights the competition between concept modes and interaction modes. This is a more nuanced statement than the common intuition that deeper representations are simply more abstract.

Third, the paper moves to infinite-width nonlinear networks. In this regime, it proves that nonlinearities weaken abstraction in features relative to preactivations. For ReLU in particular, the dynamics become more input-driven and less target-driven, which makes it easier for interaction modes to persist and therefore lowers abstraction. The paper also provides a theoretical explanation for prior empirical observations that tanh-like nonlinearities often produce more abstract representations than ReLU.

An especially useful distinction is between final abstraction and the maximum abstraction attained during training. Because the trajectory can be non-monotonic, the most abstract checkpoint may occur before convergence.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section serves two purposes: validating the theory in controlled settings and checking whether the same qualitative laws appear in modern models.

In controlled experiments, the paper shows that abstraction trajectories in realistic deep networks can be non-monotonic and can plateau well below 1, matching the motivation in Figure 1C using a ConvNet on 3dshapes. Figure 1D is particularly important: abstraction tracks cross-context probe generalization. For example, a shape classifier trained only on red samples and tested on blue samples has an error curve that follows the abstraction measure and is well approximated by the theory. This makes abstraction more than a geometric curiosity; it is tied to out-of-distribution linear readout performance.

The more relevant modern-model evidence appears in Section 5. The authors report that ablating nonlinearities improves abstraction and linear-probe generalization in DINOv3 and Gemma 4. The supplied text does not include the full numerical tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains, but the claim is presented as a consistent trend rather than a one-off layer effect. The paper also analyzes macaque ventral-stream data and finds increasing abstraction along the hierarchy, showing that the framework is intended to bridge machine learning and neuroscience.

For an LLM researcher, the most useful empirical takeaways are three qualitative ones: abstraction correlates with cross-distribution probe generalization; ReLU tends to suppress abstraction relative to more linear or smoother alternatives; and the trajectory can rise and then fall, so the final checkpoint may not be the most abstract one.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this one with a concrete question in mind. Start with Figure 1 and the introduction to understand the phenomenon being explained. Then go to the main linear-theory section and focus on how the 2FS kernel structure and mode decomposition make the abstraction trajectory analytically tractable. After that, read the nonlinear section, because it answers the practical question of why linear-network predictions break in ReLU models. Finally, check the DINOv3 and Gemma 4 experiments in Section 5 to see whether the theory survives contact with modern representations.

A reasonable skim takes 35 to 50 minutes. If time is short, the best path is: Figure 1, the abstraction definition and 2FS setup, the main linear dynamics results, the proposition that nonlinearity weakens abstraction, and then the Gemma 4 evidence.

Two details are worth deeper thought. One is the interaction mode as the main abstraction-reducing direction; this resembles entangled feature directions in pretrained language models and may connect to token co-occurrence or style/topic confounds. The other is the distinction between preactivation and feature abstraction, which offers a concrete lens for why some layers support clean probing while post-activation representations are harder to steer linearly.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from University College London, specifically the Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit and the Sainsbury Wellcome Centre. The visible metadata indicates a neuroscience/ML crossover team, but the full author list is not fully shown in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接做 LLM，但它把“线性概念为何出现”从事后描述推进到训练动力学；读定理和结论段，能校正你对 probe/steering 可解释性的直觉。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it upgrades linear-representation talk from post-hoc geometry to training dynamics; read the main results if you use probes or steering and want cleaner priors.

paper.title: Optimal Learning Rate Scaling Depends on Data in Deep Scalar Linear Networks
paper.abstract: In this short note we consider the gradient descent dynamics of deep scalar linear networks, $f(x) = \prod_{l=1}^L w_l x$, which enjoy exact time-course solutions for any integer depth. We show that even in this minimal model, the optimal depth-wise learning rate scaling depends on data, whereas data-agnostic scaling rules fail to transfer across depths. Under the data-dependent optimal scaling, the learning dynamics is independent of data and weakly dependent on depth, resulting in a constant l

summary.core_problem: 深度线性网络中深度方向学习率缩放规则是否与数据无关、能否跨深度迁移尚不明确。
summary.importance: 原理分析贡献：在可精确求解的深度标量线性网络模型中，证明最优深度方向学习率缩放依赖数据分布，挑战数据无关缩放规则的普适性。
summary.technical_approach: 利用深度标量线性网络 f(x)=∏w_l x 存在任意深度精确时间解的特性，对比数据无关与数据依赖的深度方向学习率缩放对梯度下降动力学的影响，并扩展到带残差连接的情形。
summary.experiments: 在任意整数深度的标量线性网络及带残差版本中，解析推导与数值验证表明：数据依赖的最优缩放下学习动力学与数据无关、对深度弱依赖，可在所有深度（含无穷深）下保持恒定线性收敛率。

summary_en.core_problem: It remains unclear whether depth-wise learning rate scaling rules in deep linear networks are data-agnostic and transferable across depths.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis contribution: in the exactly solvable deep scalar linear network, proves that optimal depth-wise learning rate scaling is data-dependent, challenging the generality of data-agnostic scaling rules.
summary_en.technical_approach: Leverages the exact time-course solution of deep scalar linear networks f(x)=∏w_l x for any integer depth, compares data-agnostic vs data-dependent depth-wise LR scaling on gradient descent dynamics, and extends the analysis to residual connections.
summary_en.experiments: Analytical derivation and numerical verification in scalar linear networks (and residual variants) of any depth show that under data-dependent optimal scaling, learning dynamics is data-independent and weakly depth-dependent, with a constant linear convergence rate across all depths including infinity.

recommendation.zh: 结论仅在标量线性网络中成立，对Transformer的直接指导有限，但可作为设计深度相关学习率日程时的弱信号参考，看摘要与Fig 2即可。
