paper.title: When Are Two Networks the Same? Tensor Similarity for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to break models into meaningful parts; verifying that two such parts implement the same computation is a prerequisite. Existing similarity measures evaluate either empirical behaviour, leaving them blind to out-of-distribution mechanisms, or basis-dependent parameters, meaning they disregard weight-space symmetries. To address these issues for the class of tensor-based models, we introduce a weight-based metric, tensor similarity, that is invariant to such symme

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）研究缺乏一个严格的度量标准来验证两个神经网络组件是否执行相同的计算。现有相似性度量存在根本缺陷：基于行为（输入-输出对）的度量无法泛化到分布外且检测不到后门；基于参数的度量（如矩阵相似性）对权重空间对称性（如神经元重排）敏感。需要一个同时满足数据集独立性、对称性不变性和可扩展性的相似性度量。
summary.importance: 对LLM预训练研究中的机制分析和训练动态监测有实用价值。张量相似性提供了一种在权重空间层面追踪功能等价性的方法，可用于：检测训练过程中的功能相变（如grokking）、验证模型组件的功能等价性、监测灾难性遗忘和后门注入。这为预训练研究中分析模型内部机制变化提供了新工具。
summary.technical_approach: 提出张量相似性（tensor similarity）——一种基于权重的度量，对神经网络的参数化对称性（如神经元置换、层间分布变化）保持不变。该方法以张量网络（使用双线性层和乘积注意力替代非线性激活和softmax注意力的多项式网络）为基础，将余弦相似度从向量推广到张量模型，通过高效递归算法评估全局功能等价性。核心创新：(1) 张量代数框架下的权重相似性度量，同时满足数据集独立、对称性不变和可计算三个准则；(2) 可追溯每个组件对总相似度的贡献；(3) 在轻微结构扰动下有良好的退化特性。代价是模型需要使用张量/多项式架构。
summary.experiments: 实验验证了张量相似性在多个领域的判别能力：(1) 追踪视觉模型中的灾难性遗忘；(2) 检测模块化算术任务中的grokking-like相变；(3) 监测语言模型训练动态。结果显示张量相似性比现有度量（行为相似性、矩阵相似性）以更高保真度追踪功能训练动态，能够发现其他方法遗漏的功能变化。具体数值细节需参考原文。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点关注第2章（理论）中张量相似性的构造和对称性不变性的证明，以及第3章（实验）中训练动态追踪的结果。对LLM训练动态分析和机制解读有工具层面的参考价值。预计阅读时间：40-50分钟，张量代数背景不足者可跳过数学推导部分。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括tdooms等（代码仓库在github.com/tdooms/tensor-similarity），机构信息未在提供内容中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Mechanistic interpretability lacks a rigorous metric to verify whether two neural network components implement the same computation. Existing similarity measures have fundamental flaws: behavior-based metrics (input-output pairs) fail to generalize OOD and cannot detect backdoors; parameter-based metrics (matrix similarity) are sensitive to weight-space symmetries (neuron permutations). A metric satisfying dataset independence, symmetry invariance, and tractable scalability is needed.
summary_en.importance: Practical value for mechanism analysis and training dynamics monitoring in LLM pretraining. Tensor similarity provides a weight-space method to track functional equivalence, applicable to: detecting functional phase transitions during training (e.g., grokking), validating functional equivalence of model components, monitoring catastrophic forgetting and backdoor injection. It offers a new tool for analyzing internal mechanism changes in pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tensor similarity is a weight-based metric invariant to neural network parameterization symmetries (neuron permutation, cross-layer distribution shifts). It is built on tensor networks—polynomial networks using bilinear layers and product attention instead of non-linear activations and softmax attention. The method extends cosine similarity from vectors to tensor models via an efficient recursive algorithm assessing global functional equivalence. Key innovations: (1) tensor-algebraic weight similarity satisfying all three criteria; (2) attribution of each component's contribution to total similarity; (3) graceful degradation under minor structural perturbations. The trade-off is requiring tensor/polynomial architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments validate discriminative power across domains: (1) tracking catastrophic forgetting in vision models; (2) detecting grokking-like phase transitions in modular arithmetic; (3) monitoring language model training dynamics. Tensor similarity tracks functional training dynamics with higher fidelity than existing metrics (behavioral similarity, matrix similarity) and exposes functional changes missed by other methods. Specific numerical details require referring to the full paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on Chapter 2 (Theory) for the tensor similarity construction and symmetry invariance proofs, and Chapter 3 (Experiments) for training dynamics tracking results. Provides tool-level value for LLM training dynamics analysis and mechanistic interpretability. Estimated reading time: 40-50 minutes; readers without tensor algebra background can skip mathematical derivations.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include tdooms et al. (code at github.com/tdooms/tensor-similarity). Institution information not explicitly provided in available content.

recommendation.zh: 提出了一种对权重空间对称性不变的张量相似度度量，为机制可解释性提供了一个更干净的代数工具，值得关注其在分析 grokking 等训练动态时的表现。
recommendation.en: Proposes a tensor similarity metric invariant to weight-space symmetries, providing a cleaner algebraic tool for mechanistic interpretability. Worth noting its performance in analyzing training dynamics like grokking.

paper.title: Silent Collapse in Recursive Learning Systems
paper.abstract: Recursive learning -- where models are trained on data generated by previous versions of themselves -- is increasingly common in large language models, autonomous agents, and self-supervised systems. However, standard performance metrics (loss, perplexity, accuracy) often fail to detect internal degradation before it becomes irreversible. Here we identify a phenomenon we call silent collapse: under broad recursive conditions, model internal distributions -- predictive entropy, representational d

summary.core_problem: 递归学习系统（如用自身前版输出训练LLM、伪标签自监督、带偏置奖励的RL）会出现内部表征持续退化，但传统验证指标（损失、困惑度、准确率）无法在退化不可逆前检测到异常，此前的模型坍缩研究也未解决提前预警和无原始真实数据干预的问题。
summary.importance: 为LLM递归自训练、持续学习、RLHF迭代等常用训练范式的健康度监控提供了可落地的观测维度，打破了「验证指标稳定等于训练动态健康」的固有认知，为避免长期迭代过程中的隐性能力退化提供了预警和干预思路。
summary.technical_approach: 定义「静默坍缩」现象：系统内部预测熵、表征多样性、尾部分布覆盖率持续收缩的同时，传统验证指标仍保持稳定甚至提升；识别出三个早于指标恶化出现的轨迹层面前兆：锚点熵收缩、表征漂移冻结、尾部覆盖侵蚀；提出不需要持续接入原始真实数据的MTR框架，仅用初始checkpoint的少量固定锚点样本，通过监控轨迹统计量生成信任估计，自适应调节学习强度。
summary.experiments: 在TinyStories递归语言建模、CIFAR-10递归伪标注两个压力测试场景下验证，MTR比传统指标提前多代检测到坍缩前兆，有效阻止了困惑度的灾难性爆炸。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中静默坍缩与传统模型坍缩的差异部分、静默坍缩三个前兆的定义逻辑、MTR框架的设计思路，预计阅读时间20-25分钟，附录实验细节可按需查看。

summary_en.core_problem: Recursive learning systems, including LLMs trained on outputs of previous versions, self-supervised models with pseudo-labels, and RL agents with biased rewards, suffer from progressive internal representational degradation. Standard validation metrics (loss, perplexity, accuracy) cannot detect this degradation before it becomes irreversible, and prior model collapse research did not address early warning or intervention without continuous access to pristine real data.
summary_en.importance: It provides actionable observation dimensions for health monitoring of common LLM training paradigms such as recursive self-training, continual learning, and iterative RLHF. It challenges the default assumption that stable validation metrics equal healthy training dynamics, and offers a practical framework for early warning and intervention to avoid hidden capability degradation during long-term training iterations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work defines silent collapse, a dynamical regime where internal predictive entropy, representational diversity, and tail distribution coverage shrink progressively while standard validation metrics remain stable or even improve. It identifies three trajectory-level precursors that emerge long before visible metric degradation: anchor entropy contraction, representation drift freezing, and tail coverage erosion. It proposes the MTR framework, which requires no continuous access to pristine real data — only a small fixed set of anchor samples from the initial checkpoint — to monitor trajectory statistics, generate trust estimates, and adaptively adjust learning intensity.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two stress test scenarios: recursive language modeling on TinyStories and recursive pseudo-labeling on CIFAR-10. MTR detects collapse precursors multiple generations earlier than standard metrics, and effectively prevents catastrophic perplexity explosion.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the difference between silent collapse and traditional model collapse in the introduction, the definition of the three collapse precursors, and the design logic of the MTR framework. Estimated reading time is 20-25 minutes. Appendix experiment details can be reviewed on demand.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 synthetic data 回流或 continual pretrain，这篇至少该看监测指标定义；结论未必稳，但“内部先塌、外部后坏”这个警报值得立刻加进训练面板。
recommendation.en: If you run synthetic-data recursion or continual pretraining, at least inspect the proposed diagnostics; the claim may be setup-sensitive, but the idea that internals fail before metrics do is worth instrumenting immediately.

institutions: China Mobile GBA (Greater Bay Area) Innovation Institute

paper.title: Understanding and Accelerating the Training of Masked Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models (ARMs) for language modeling. However, MDMs are known to learn substantially more slowly than ARMs, which may become problematic when scaling MDMs to larger models. Therefore, we ask the following question: how can we accelerate standard MDM training while maintaining its final performance? To this end, we first provide a detailed analysis of why MDM training is slow. We find that the main factor is t

summary.core_problem: 掩膜扩散语言模型（MDM）作为自回归（AR）语言模型的替代范式，训练效率远低于AR模型（通常需要约16倍训练算力才能达到相同验证损失），成为其规模化落地的核心瓶颈，需要在不损失最终性能的前提下加速MDM的预训练。
summary.importance: 首次系统性定位了MDM训练慢的核心原因是语言的局部性偏置，而非任意顺序生成的解空间复杂度；提出的钟形时间采样策略实现最高4倍训练加速，将MDM与AR模型的训练算力差距从约16倍缩小至4倍左右，大幅降低了非AR语言建模范式的规模化门槛，对非AR语言模型的预训练工程有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 首先拆解MDM训练慢的两个潜在因素：语言的局部性偏置（token的预测信息集中在相邻位置）、任意顺序生成的解空间复杂度，通过对照实验验证局部性偏置是主因——高上下文（几乎无掩膜）和低上下文（几乎全掩膜）的训练样本几乎无法提供有效学习信号，浪费了大部分训练预算。基于该分析提出钟形时间采样策略：在扩散时间步的采样分布中，提高中间上下文对应时间步的采样概率，降低高、低上下文对应时间步的采样权重。现有MDM优化多集中在推理侧或损失函数修改，该方法无需调整模型架构或训练目标，仅修改训练时的时间步采样分布，通用性强，也适用于从AR基座持续预训练MDM的主流规模化方案。
summary.experiments: 在LM1B数据集上，达到相同负对数似然（NLL）的训练速度最高提升约4倍；在OpenWebText数据集训练的模型上，生成困惑度（PPL）和零样本PPL的提升速度也显著快于均匀时间采样基线；在AR初始化持续预训练MDM的设置下，该策略同样有效，还能进一步提升下游任务性能。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读第2节训练慢的根因分析、第3节钟形采样的设计逻辑、第4节的消融实验和效率对比图表；附录中的扩散目标推导和不同噪声调度器的对比值得深挖，可探索与其他扩散LM优化方法的结合空间。

summary_en.core_problem: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs), a promising alternative to autoregressive language models (ARMs), suffer from drastically lower training efficiency: they require roughly 16x more training compute to reach the same validation loss as ARMs, which becomes a critical bottleneck for scaling MDMs to large LLM sizes. The goal is to accelerate MDM pretraining without compromising final model performance.
summary_en.importance: It systematically identifies that the locality bias of natural language, rather than the large solution space of any-order generation, is the primary cause of slow MDM training. The proposed bell-shaped time sampling strategy delivers up to 4x training speedup, reducing the training compute gap between MDMs and ARMs from ~16x to ~4x, directly lowering the scaling barrier of non-autoregressive language modeling paradigms and providing actionable guidance for non-AR LM pretraining engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first isolates two potential causes of slow MDM training: the locality bias of natural language (predictive information for a token is concentrated in nearby positions) and the complexity of the any-order generation problem space. Controlled experiments confirm locality bias is the dominant factor: samples with very high context (almost no masking) or very low context (almost full masking) provide almost no effective learning signal, wasting most of the training budget. Based on this analysis, it proposes bell-shaped time sampling, which adjusts the diffusion timestep sampling distribution to increase the probability of sampling timesteps corresponding to intermediate context levels and reduce weight on high/low context timesteps. Unlike most existing MDM optimizations that focus on inference speed or loss function modification, this method requires no changes to model architecture or training objective, only adjusts training-time timestep sampling, and is compatible with the common large-scale MDM setup of continual pretraining from an ARM initialization.
summary_en.experiments: On the LM1B dataset, bell-shaped time sampling delivers up to ~4x faster training to reach the same negative log-likelihood (NLL). It also accelerates improvements in generative perplexity (PPL) and zero-shot PPL for models trained on OpenWebText. The strategy remains effective under the ARM-initialized continual pretraining setting, and further improves downstream task performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus closely on Section 2 (root cause analysis of slow training), Section 3 (design logic of bell-shaped sampling), and Section 4 (ablation studies and efficiency comparison figures). The diffusion objective derivation and comparison across different noise schedulers in appendices are worth deep diving to explore potential combinations with other diffusion LM optimization methods.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看方法和 ablation；它把 MDM 慢训练从泛泛的非 AR 缺陷，收敛到 locality 与 time sampling 的错配。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; it reframes slow MDM training as a locality–time-sampling mismatch rather than a vague non-AR weakness.

paper.title: Early Data Exposure Improves Robustness to Subsequent Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: How can we train models whose post-trained capabilities survive subsequent fine-tuning? Rather than focusing on downstream interventions to mitigate forgetting of upstream capabilities, we study how upstream training choices - that is, the manner in which a capability is acquired - shape how robustly that capability is retained. We investigate this question in a controlled three-stage language-model pipeline: pretraining, post-training to acquire a target capability, and downstream fine-tuning o

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 pretrain、post-train 和下游 fine-tune 之间的耐久性问题：一个能力在 post-training 后表现相同，不代表它在后续 fine-tuning 后能同样保留。作者关心的是，上游训练阶段如何让能力更不容易被后续适配破坏。
summary.importance: 这篇值得精读，因为它把灾难性遗忘从“下游 fine-tune 阶段的补救问题”前移到了“上游训练配方的设计问题”。具体贡献不是提出复杂算法，而是给出一个清晰且可操作的信号：把少量未来 post-training 数据提前混入 pretraining，可以改善后续 fine-tuning 后的能力保留。这个结果对持续预训练、mid-training 数据编排、领域能力注入和安全能力保留都有直接参考意义。贡献量级属于机制和训练流程层面的实证发现；实验规模到 135M 和 1B，尚不是生产级大模型规模，但控制变量较干净，结论可迁移性值得继续验证。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造了一个三阶段管线：先在通用语料 D_pre 上预训练，再在较小的目标语料 D_post 上 post-train 获得目标能力，最后由下游用户在新目标 D_ft 上做监督 fine-tuning。核心干预很简单：在第一阶段预训练时，提前混入一部分最终会用于 post-training 的 D_post 数据。评估时不只看 post-training 刚结束时的目标域 loss，而是固定下游 fine-tuning 方法并扫描学习率，画出下游性能、post-training 能力保留和通用预训练分布性能之间的 tradeoff frontier。这个设计很关键，因为同样的即时 post-training loss 可能对应完全不同的后续保留能力。作者还做了 compute-matched 分配实验，比较把稀缺目标数据全部放在 pretraining、全部放在 post-training，或分配在两个阶段。结果显示最优点通常在中间，而不是任一极端。理论解释是，早期暴露让目标能力更容易进入较专门、较稳定的特征子空间，后续 fine-tuning 对这些特征的干扰更小。作者还把 replay 和 dropout 放在同一视角下考察：replay 通过交错旧数据减小新目标更新的覆盖，dropout 通过减少特征共适应提升表示稳健性；二者与早期数据混入有互补性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 135M 和 1B 参数模型、两个 post-training 领域和两个下游 fine-tuning 任务。主要结果有四点。第一，post-training 结束后的即时能力不是可靠预测指标；若只看 D_post 上的当前性能，不同训练配方可能看起来接近，但后续 fine-tuning 后 retention 差异明显。第二，早期混入 D_post 数据能改善 retention 与下游 fine-tuning loss 的前沿，在若干设置中即使即时 post-training 指标变化很小，后续保留也更好。第三，在固定目标数据或计算预算的分配实验中，把全部目标数据放在早期或晚期都不是最佳，早期暴露加后期强化的组合更稳。第四，replay 和 dropout 都能进一步改善 tradeoff frontier，并且不是简单替代早期混入。文中给出的数字级信息包括模型规模 135M/1B、三阶段数据设置、多个学习率扫描和多任务组合；由于提供内容未包含完整结果表，具体 loss 改善幅度不宜臆测。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Preliminaries、Section 4 和 Section 5。Figure 1 用来把三阶段问题定义读清楚；Table 1 需要看实验设置是否覆盖自己关心的 post-train 和 fine-tune 场景；Figure 2 是核心结果，重点看 frontier 而不是单点指标。Section 4.1 说明为什么即时 post-training 性能会误导；Section 4.2 的 compute-matched 分配实验最接近实际训练配方问题；Section 4.4 可看 replay、dropout 与早期混入的互补关系；Section 5 的理论部分适合带着一个问题读：早期数据暴露究竟是在提高目标域记忆，还是在改变特征分解和梯度干扰路径。进一步深挖时，应关注不同混入比例、数据重复次数、目标域数据质量和模型规模扩大后结论是否保持。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why some post-trained capabilities survive later fine-tuning while others are quickly forgotten, even when the models look equally good immediately after post-training. The central question is whether upstream training choices can make acquired capabilities more durable before downstream fine-tuning happens.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong fit for pretraining and post-training interface research. It reframes forgetting as an upstream training-design problem, not only a downstream mitigation problem. The main practical signal is simple: exposing the model to some eventual post-training data during pretraining can improve retention after later fine-tuning. This matters for continual pretraining, mid-training data schedules, domain capability injection, and safety-behavior preservation. The evidence is controlled and reaches 1B parameters, so it should be read as a clean empirical result and a training-design hypothesis rather than a finished scaling claim for frontier models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup has three stages. A model is pretrained on a broad corpus D_pre, post-trained on a smaller target corpus D_post, and then fine-tuned by a downstream user on a new objective D_ft. The main intervention is to mix part of D_post into the pretraining stage before the dedicated post-training stage. The evaluation is not based on immediate post-training loss alone. Instead, the downstream fine-tuning method is fixed, the learning rate is swept, and the resulting frontier between downstream loss, retained D_post capability, and general D_pre performance is compared across upstream recipes. This is the right measurement because two models with similar post-training loss can occupy different retention frontiers after fine-tuning. The paper also runs compute-matched allocation experiments, comparing all early exposure, all late exposure, and mixed schedules. The optimum tends to lie between the extremes. The proposed explanation is feature-level: early exposure lets the target capability be represented in more specialized and less interfering features, making it less vulnerable to later updates. Replay and dropout are evaluated under the same lens. Replay reduces overwriting by interleaving earlier data, while dropout discourages feature co-adaptation; both provide gains that are complementary to early data exposure.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 135M and 1B parameter language models, two post-training domains, and two downstream fine-tuning tasks. The main results are consistent. First, immediate post-training performance is not a reliable predictor of retention after downstream fine-tuning. Second, mixing some target data into pretraining improves the retention-versus-downstream-loss frontier, sometimes with little visible effect on immediate post-training metrics. Third, under a fixed budget of target-data exposure, neither putting all exposure in pretraining nor putting all exposure in post-training is best; a split allocation performs better. Fourth, replay and dropout further improve the frontier and do not simply replace early exposure. The available text specifies model scales, the three-stage design, learning-rate sweeps, and the qualitative frontier shifts, but not enough complete tables to report exact loss deltas without guessing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction, Preliminaries, Section 4, and Section 5 carefully. Figure 1 defines the three-stage pipeline. Table 1 is important for understanding the post-training and downstream fine-tuning settings. Figure 2 is the main result; focus on the tradeoff frontier rather than a single score. Section 4.1 explains why immediate post-training performance can be misleading. Section 4.2 is the most relevant part for training-recipe design because it studies how to allocate scarce target data across stages. Section 4.4 covers replay and dropout as complementary interventions. Section 5 is worth reading with one question in mind: does early exposure merely add memory of the target domain, or does it change the feature decomposition so later gradients interfere less?

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改变你对“post-train 学到就算学到”的默认看法；建议立刻在内部做 early-mix ablation，因为它讨论的是能力写入位置，而不是又一个遗忘补丁。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that a capability learned in post-training is 'already there'; replicate the early-mix ablation internally, because the paper is about where capabilities get written, not another forgetting patch.

paper.title: Tracing Persona Vectors Through LLM Pretraining
paper.abstract: How large language models internally represent high-level behaviors is a core interpretability question with direct relevance to AI safety: it determines what we can detect, audit, or intervene on. Recent work has shown that traits such as evil or sycophancy correspond to linear directions in the internal activations, the so-called persona vectors. Although these vectors are now routinely utilized to inspect and steer model behavior in safety-relevant settings, how these representations are form

summary.core_problem: persona vector（如 evil、sycophancy 等行为特质对应的残差流线性方向）在预训练过程中何时形成、如何演化、以及这种表示是否能跨越 post-training（SFT/DPO/RLVR）保持可用。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接价值在于把“高层行为表征”与“训练时间轴”对齐：人格/特质方向不是 post-train 才出现，而是在极早期预训练就已可提取，并且能迁移到后续指令对齐模型。这会影响三类工作：
1) 训练动态与涌现：一些看似高层的行为控制方向可能在很少 token 后就被写入表示空间，后续训练更多是在重加权/重塑 facets；
2) 数据与安全干预：如果方向很早就稳定，后期仅靠对齐可能难以“抹掉”底层可模拟的 persona 能力，干预点可能要前移到预训练数据与目标；
3) 机制分析方法论：证明“在 base checkpoint 上做的线性表征工程”能跨 SFT/DPO/RLVR 仍有效，提升了用开源中间 checkpoint 做可重复研究的可信度。
summary.technical_approach:
方法沿用并扩展 persona vector 的标准提取范式：
- 将 persona τ 操作化为自然语言描述 + 评分 rubric Rτ；在 decoder-only Transformer 的 residual stream（每层输出的残差向量空间）中寻找线性方向 v_{τ,l}。
- 通过对比提示构造“激活 persona”与“抑制 persona”的两类 prompts，让模型生成；用 judge model 对生成进行 0-100 打分（persona 强度与连贯性），筛选高质量样本。
- 用筛选后的对比样本在指定层/多层上估计 persona direction（论文后续讨论不同 elicitation 方法会恢复不同 facets）。
- 关键实验设计是“跨 checkpoint 追踪”：在 OLMo-3-7B 的多个预训练 checkpoint 上分别提取 persona vectors，然后用这些向量去 steer：a) 同一 base checkpoint；b) 由该 base 派生的 post-trained 模型（SFT、DPO、RLVR）。由此回答“何时出现”“是否保持同一方向”“post-train 是否破坏/旋转该方向”。
- 论文还强调 persona facets 会随训练推进发生漂移：同一高层 persona 名称下，不同阶段/不同提取法得到的向量可能更偏向不同子特征，因此需要把‘方向是否保留’与‘语义细节如何变’分开看。
summary.experiments: 主实验对象是 OLMo-3-7B（公开预训练中间 checkpoint），并在 Apertus 上复现（正文简述、细节在附录）。核心结果：persona vectors 在 OLMo-3 预训练进度的 0.22% 内就已形成；即便在非常早期 checkpoint 提取的向量，也能在完全 post-trained 的 instruct 模型上实现有效 steering。论文还报告：persona vectors 在整个预训练过程中持续演化，但“底层方向”在某种意义上保持可追踪；同时，elicitation 方法会影响恢复到的 persona facets。实验形态包括跨层选择、跨 checkpoint 的 steering 效果对比，以及对 SFT/DPO/RLVR 三种后训练范式的迁移测试。（你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格数字与所有 persona 列表；精读时应以结果章节的曲线/表格为准。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里两条 RQ（何时出现、如何演化）以及 OLMo-3 选择理由：公开 checkpoint 让“训练时间追踪”可复现。
- 精看 Method：persona 的操作化、对比提示与 judge 过滤、以及 persona vector 在 residual stream 的定义；这里决定了后面所有结论的可比性。
- 重点找结果里“0.22% 预训练进度”的证据：通常会是随训练步数的 steering 强度曲线或某个阈值定义，确认它不是由筛选偏差或 judge 泄漏造成。
- 看跨 post-training（SFT/DPO/RLVR）的迁移实验：它回答‘base 上的方向是否在对齐后仍存在’。
- 最后看关于 facets 漂移与 elicitation 依赖的分析：这部分决定 persona vector 是否能被当作稳定的“可审计对象”，还是更像一个随提取流程变化的探针。

summary_en.core_problem: When and how do persona vectors—linear directions in the residual stream associated with high-level behavioral traits (e.g., “Evil”)—emerge during pretraining, and do they remain usable after post-training (SFT/DPO/RLVR)?
summary_en.importance: The paper ties a safety-relevant interpretability object (persona vectors) to the pretraining timeline. The key implication for pretraining research is that some high-level controllable behavior directions appear extremely early and persist through alignment stages. This suggests: (1) post-training may mostly select/reweight existing behavioral modes rather than create them; (2) if a risky persona direction is present early, late-stage alignment might not remove the underlying representational affordance; (3) mechanistic/representation-engineering studies on base checkpoints can generalize to their instruction-tuned descendants, improving the practical value of open intermediate checkpoints for reproducible training-dynamics work.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They operationalize a persona τ via a natural-language description plus a scoring rubric, and assume it corresponds to a linear direction v_{τ,l} in a chosen layer’s residual stream. Extraction follows a contrastive generation protocol: craft prompts that elicit vs suppress the persona, sample model continuations, and use a judge model to score persona strength and coherence (0–100), filtering to high-quality pairs. A direction is then estimated from the contrastive activation statistics.

The central design is checkpoint tracing: extract persona vectors at many pretraining checkpoints of OLMo-3-7B, then use those vectors to steer (a) the base checkpoints and (b) post-trained variants (SFT, DPO, RLVR). This directly tests emergence time, directional stability across training, and whether post-training rotates/erases the representation. They also analyze “facet drift”: the same persona label can correspond to different sub-traits depending on training stage and elicitation method, so they separate directional persistence from semantic drift.
summary_en.experiments: Primary model: OLMo-3-7B with public intermediate pretraining checkpoints; replication on Apertus (briefly in the main text, detailed in an appendix). Headline finding: persona vectors form within 0.22% of OLMo-3 pretraining, and vectors extracted from very early checkpoints can still steer fully post-trained instruction models. They report continued evolution of the vectors over pretraining while preserving an underlying traceable direction, and show elicitation-method dependence in which facets are recovered. (The provided excerpt does not include the full quantitative tables; the main evidence should be in the results figures/tables tracking steering strength vs training progress and transfer to SFT/DPO/RLVR.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the two research questions in the Introduction and why OLMo-3 checkpoints enable the study.
- Study the Method carefully: prompt construction, judge filtering, and the exact definition of the residual-stream direction; these choices determine whether “early emergence” is meaningful.
- Locate the evidence supporting the “0.22% of pretraining” claim (typically a curve over steps with a threshold); sanity-check potential confounds like selection bias from filtering.
- Check the transfer experiments to SFT/DPO/RLVR; this is the strongest argument that the representation survives alignment.
- Finally, read the facet-drift and elicitation-dependence analysis to understand how stable the persona concept is as an audit/steering handle.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练配方，但会改你对“高层行为表征何时写进模型”的 prior；先看早期形成那组结果，若稳得住，安全表征研究该前移到 pretrain 而不是只盯 post-train。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your recipe directly, but it may change your prior on when high-level behavior gets written into the model; read the early-emergence result first, because if it holds, safety representation work needs to move upstream into pretraining.

paper.title: Routers Learn the Geometry of Their Experts: Geometric Coupling in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models enable scaling language models efficiently, but training them remains challenging, as routing can collapse onto few experts and auxiliary load-balancing losses can reduce specialization. Motivated by these hurdles, we study how routing decisions in SMoEs are formed mechanistically. First, we reveal a geometric coupling between routers and their corresponding experts. For a given token, the router weights for the selected expert and the expert weights proce

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章要解决的不是“MoE 为什么能省算力”这种宏观问题，而是一个更底层、也更难回答的问题：Sparse MoE 里的 router 到底学到了什么几何结构，为什么路由会塌缩，为什么常见的 load-balancing loss 一边改善负载均衡，一边又伤害 expert specialization。作者试图从梯度和表示几何出发，把 router 与 expert 之间的关系讲清楚，而不是把路由器当成一个黑盒打分模块。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值很高，尤其对大规模 MoE 训练。文章的贡献不在于提出一个立刻替代现有工业路由器的方案，而在于给出一个机制层面的解释框架：router 与其对应 expert 在训练中会沿着相同输入方向累积更新，形成几何耦合；而常见 auxiliary balancing loss 会向所有 router 方向注入与输入相关的梯度，导致不同 expert 的 router 方向被拉近，从而削弱 specialization。这个结论直接触及 MoE 训练里的核心张力：负载均衡与专家分工不是两个独立旋钮，而是在参数几何上彼此牵连。对设计更稳的路由损失、理解 expert collapse、分析 DeepSeek/OLMoE 一类大模型中的专家分工，都有实质参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分三层。第一层是理论分析。作者从标准 top-k sparse MoE 层的前向和反向推导出一个很关键的结论：对于某个被分配到 expert i 的 token，router 中与 expert i 对应的权重向量，以及 expert i 内部处理该 token 的权重，会沿着同一个输入 hidden state 方向接收梯度，差别主要在标量系数。也就是说，router 和 expert 虽然是两个模块，但它们不是各学各的；在被路由 token 的条件下，它们共享了同一组“输入方向历史”，因此会形成 matched router–expert directions。这个结论并不是“共享计算图所以梯度相关”那么泛，而是更强的输入方向对齐。第二层是经验验证。作者在一个从头训练的 1B 级 SMoE 上，比较 router 对 expert 的打分排序与该 expert 内部神经元激活强度，发现 router 排名更高的 expert，内部响应也更强；这说明路由决策并非外部硬分配，而是与 expert 的内部计算几何一致。第三层是对 auxiliary load-balancing loss 的再解释。常见 balancing loss 为了让各 expert 使用更均匀，会对每个 token 的所有 router 权重都施加更新，而不是只更新被选中的 expert。这会把原本由 routed token history 形成的 expert-specific 方向混合掉。作者理论上说明了这一点，并在实验中观察到：加入 auxiliary loss 后，不同 router weight vectors 的相似度接近提升到原来的 3 倍，几何上更趋同。基于这个分析，作者进一步提出一个 parameter-free centroid router：不用学习 router 权重，而是让每个 expert 维护其已接收 hidden states 的在线 K-Means/EMA 质心，路由时按与质心的 cosine similarity 选择 expert，并配合 sign-updated bias 调整负载。这个设计不是为了追求更高上限，而是验证“router 学到的很大一部分就是各 expert 所覆盖 token 分布的几何中心”。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕三个问题展开。第一，几何耦合是否真实存在。作者在约 1B 参数的 SMoE 上从头训练约 50B tokens，观察 router 排名与 expert 激活之间的对应关系，结果显示被 router 排得更高的 expert，在处理同一 token 时也有更强的内部激活，这支持了理论中的耦合假设。第二，auxiliary balancing loss 如何改变几何。作者训练两套除 balancing 规则外完全相同的 1B SMoE，对比 router 权重方向的相似性，发现带 auxiliary loss 的模型中，不同 router 向量彼此更接近，近似达到无该损失时的 3 倍相似度；同时负载更均衡，但 specialization 被削弱。第三，centroid router 能否复现 learned router 的主要功能。结果是它在所有变体里取得了最低的 load imbalance，同时 perplexity 与不使用 auxiliary loss 的 learned router 接近，只是有温和退化。摘要里没有给出完整 PPL 数字，但全文的重点不是绝对困惑度，而是证明一个非参数、基于聚类中心的路由器已经能覆盖 learned routing 的相当一部分作用。值得注意的是，作者把“更均衡”和“更好语言建模”明确分开讨论，没有把负载指标改善直接包装成整体质量提升。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇需要精读。先看理论部分，重点抓住 router 权重与 expert 权重对同一 token 的梯度方向为何会对齐。这里最好顺着公式把链式法则推一遍，否则后面的几何结论容易看成直觉描述。然后看经验部分里 router score 与 expert activation 的对应图，这一节把“几何耦合”从公式落到可观测现象。接着重点看 auxiliary load-balancing loss 的分析与相似度统计，这是全文最直接影响 MoE 训练实践的部分：它解释了为什么常见 balancing 虽然有效，却可能把 router 学成一组彼此相近的方向。最后看 centroid router 的实现细节，尤其是 online K-Means/EMA 更新、cosine routing 和 bias 调整方式。阅读时建议把它当成一个机制论文，而不是一个追求 benchmark 最优的模型论文。最值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种几何耦合在 top-1、top-2、shared expert、capacity constraint 等工业设定下是否仍然成立；二是能否据此设计只在未选 expert 上施加更弱、或更去方向化的 balancing 信号，从而少破坏 specialization。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a mechanistic question at the heart of sparse MoE training: what geometry does the router actually learn, why does routing collapse happen, and why do standard load-balancing losses improve utilization while often weakening expert specialization? Instead of treating the router as a black-box scorer, the authors analyze the joint geometry of router and experts during training.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant to pretraining, especially for large-scale MoE language models. The main contribution is not a drop-in industrial routing recipe, but a useful explanatory framework. The paper shows that router directions and their matched expert directions are geometrically coupled through training gradients, and that common auxiliary balancing losses interfere with this coupling by pushing all router directions with input-dependent gradients. That directly reframes a central MoE tension: load balancing and specialization are not independent knobs; they interact through parameter geometry. This has clear implications for routing-loss design, expert-collapse analysis, and interpretation of expert specialization in systems such as DeepSeek-style or OLMoE-style models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has three layers. First is the theoretical analysis. Starting from a standard sparse top-k MoE layer, the authors derive that for a token routed to expert i, the router weight vector associated with expert i and the expert weights processing that token receive gradients along the same input hidden-state direction, differing mainly by scalar coefficients. This is stronger than the generic statement that both modules are in the same computation graph. It means matched router–expert pairs accumulate updates from the same routed-token history and therefore evolve as coupled geometric directions. Second is empirical validation. In a 1B-scale SMoE trained from scratch, the paper compares router scores with the internal activations of experts on the same token and finds that experts ranked higher by the router also respond more strongly internally. So routing is not merely an external assignment layer; it is mirrored in expert computation. Third is a reinterpretation of the auxiliary load-balancing loss. Because this loss sends gradients to every router direction on every token, not only to selected experts, it mixes expert-specific directions and weakens the natural coupling induced by routed-token history. The paper supports this both theoretically and empirically. Motivated by that view, the authors introduce a parameter-free centroid router: each expert maintains an online K-Means or EMA centroid of the hidden states assigned to it, and routing is done by cosine similarity to these centroids, with sign-updated biases for load control. The point is not to beat learned routers outright, but to test whether a large part of routing can be explained as geometric summarization of expert-specific token regions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments address three questions. First, does geometric coupling appear in practice? On a roughly 1B-parameter SMoE trained from scratch on about 50B tokens, the paper shows that experts receiving higher router scores also exhibit stronger internal activations for the same token, which supports the coupling hypothesis. Second, how does auxiliary balancing alter geometry? The authors train two otherwise matched 1B SMoEs differing only in the balancing rule and measure similarity among router directions. With the auxiliary loss, distinct router vectors become nearly three times more similar, indicating stronger directional homogenization. Load balance improves, but specialization weakens. Third, can a centroid router recover much of the learned router’s function? The answer is largely yes: the centroid router achieves the lowest load imbalance among the tested variants while keeping perplexity close to the learned router trained without the auxiliary loss, with only a modest degradation. The paper is careful not to conflate better utilization with better language modeling; the empirical emphasis is on explaining routing behavior rather than claiming absolute perplexity gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one deserves a careful read. Start with the theory section and work through the gradient derivation; the key idea is why router and expert updates align along the same token direction. Without that, the later geometric claims can sound more intuitive than they really are. Then read the plots comparing router scores and expert activations, since they turn the theory into an observable training phenomenon. After that, focus on the analysis of the auxiliary load-balancing loss and the router-direction similarity statistics; this is the part with the clearest practical consequence for MoE training. Finish with the centroid-router section, especially the online K-Means or EMA update rule, cosine routing, and bias adjustment. The paper is best read as a mechanism paper, not as a benchmark paper. Two follow-up questions are especially worth thinking about: whether the same coupling survives in industrial settings with top-2 routing, shared experts, and capacity constraints; and whether one can design balancing signals that regulate load without injecting strongly direction-collapsing gradients into all router vectors.

recommendation.zh: 极佳的 MoE 机制分析工作！揭示了 Router 和 Expert 梯度更新的几何耦合，解释了为什么 load-balancing loss 会损害专业化，做 MoE 预训练的同学必须精读其理论推导和 1B 模型的实证分析。
recommendation.en: Excellent mechanistic analysis of MoE! Reveals the geometric coupling of gradient updates between routers and experts, explaining why load-balancing loss harms specialization. A must-read for anyone doing MoE pretraining, especially the theoretical derivation and 1B empirical analysis.

institutions: Blavatnik School of Computer Science and AI, Tel Aviv University

paper.title: A Causal Language Modeling Detour Improves Encoder Continued Pretraining
paper.abstract: When adapting an encoder to a new domain, the standard approach is to continue training with Masked Language Modeling (MLM). We show that temporarily switching to Causal Language Modeling (CLM) followed by a short MLM decay improves downstream performance. On biomedical texts with ModernBERT, this CLM detour outperforms MLM baselines trained on identical data and compute across 8 French and 11 English biomedical tasks, by +1.2-2.8pp and +0.3-0.8pp respectively, depending on model size. We invest

summary.core_problem: 编码器的领域自适应持续预训练默认使用MLM目标，存在低层级语义表示更新不足的问题，在领域差异较大的场景（如生物医学领域）下性能提升受限，需要优化持续预训练的目标设计。
summary.importance: 提出了简单易用的CLM绕行训练策略，不需要修改模型架构就能显著提升编码器领域自适应预训练的下游性能，揭示了CLM和MLM目标对Transformer不同层级的优化差异，为通用/领域预训练的目标组合设计提供了实践参考。
summary.technical_approach: 训练流程分为两个阶段：第一阶段暂时将编码器的双向注意力替换为因果注意力，使用CLM目标训练；第二阶段恢复双向注意力，使用MLM目标进行短时间的衰减训练，仅调整注意力掩码和损失计算，保持模型架构、优化器状态不变，第二阶段训练时长为第一阶段的10%。通过层冻结干预、CKA表示相似性分析定位CLM增益的来源。
summary.experiments: 在英法双语生物医学领域实验，使用ModernBERT架构，相比相同数据、相同算力的MLM基线，法语任务提升1.2~2.8pp，英语任务提升0.3~0.8pp，模型越大增益越明显。CKA分析显示CLM对0~7层低层级的表示修改强度是MLM的9倍以上，且这些修改在后续MLM衰减阶段不会被逆转。冻结实验验证：CLM阶段冻结低层级会完全消除下游增益，冻结中层级不影响增益，确认低层级表示更新是CLM收益的核心来源。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章的训练流程设计，明确CLM绕行的具体超参数设置；第5章的层冻结实验和CKA分析结果，理解CLM和MLM对不同层级的优化差异；附录的不同数据规模、模型规模的消融实验可以直接用于指导工程落地。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard domain-adaptive continued pretraining for encoders uses the masked language modeling (MLM) objective by default, which leads to insufficient updates of lower-layer semantic representations. This limitation restricts performance gains when the domain gap between general pretraining data and target domain data is large, such as for the biomedical domain.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes a simple CLM detour training strategy that significantly improves downstream performance of encoder domain-adaptive pretraining without modifying model architecture. It reveals the different optimization effects of CLM and MLM objectives on different transformer layers, providing practical reference for objective combination design in general and domain-specific pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The training pipeline has two phases. In Phase 1, the bidirectional attention mask of the encoder is temporarily replaced with a causal mask, and the model is trained with the causal language modeling (CLM) objective. In Phase 2 (decay phase), bidirectional attention is restored, and the model is trained with the MLM objective for a short period (10% of Phase 1 training duration). Only the attention mask and loss computation are adjusted; model architecture and optimizer state are kept unchanged across phases. Layer freeze interventions and CKA representational similarity analysis are used to locate the source of CLM-derived gains.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on French and English biomedical domains with the ModernBERT architecture. Compared to the MLM baseline trained with identical data and compute, the CLM detour improves performance by 1.2~2.8pp on French tasks and 0.3~0.8pp on English tasks, with larger gains for larger models. CKA analysis shows CLM modifies representations of lower layers (0~7) over 9 times more strongly than MLM, and these modifications are not reversed during the subsequent MLM decay phase. Freeze experiments confirm that freezing lower layers during the CLM phase completely eliminates downstream gains, while freezing middle layers does not affect gains, verifying that lower-layer representation updates are the core source of CLM benefits.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the training pipeline design in Section 3 to clarify the specific hyperparameter settings for the CLM detour. Read Section 5 carefully for layer freeze experiment results and CKA analysis, to understand the different optimization effects of CLM and MLM on different layers. The ablation experiments on different data scales and model scales in the appendix can be directly referenced for engineering implementation.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现实验日程；CLM 作为 encoder 继续预训练的低层重写器，比“MLM 一路训到底”更值得纳入 ablation。
recommendation.en: Reproduce the schedule; CLM as a lower-layer rewriting phase for encoder continued pretraining deserves an internal ablation against MLM-only training.

paper.title: Learning to Foresee: Unveiling the Unlocking Efficiency of On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for large language models. However, existing studies largely attribute this advantage to denser and more stable supervision, while the parameter-level mechanisms underlying OPD's efficiency remain poorly understood. In this work, we argue that OPD's efficiency stems from a form of ``foresight'': it establishes a stable update trajectory toward the final model early in training. This foresight manifests in two aspects

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“OPD 比 RL 更稳”这种现象层问题，而是更细一层：为什么 on-policy distillation 在参数更新层面能更快到达有效解，且这种效率差异具体体现在哪些模块、哪些更新方向上。作者把问题拆成两部分。第一，模块分配问题：同样大小的参数更新，为什么 OPD 带来的推理能力增益更高。第二，方向演化问题：为什么 OPD 在训练早期就能沿着接近最终解的方向前进，而 RL 往往需要更长的探索和修正。论文给出的中心结论是，OPD 的效率来自一种可观测的“foresight”：它会更早识别低边际收益模块，避免把更新浪费在功能冗余区域；同时它的更新更早收缩到少数稳定主方向，并且这些主方向与最终解的主子空间高度对齐。
summary.importance: 它的价值主要不在于提出一个全新的 post-train 框架，而在于把“蒸馏更容易优化”这件事从经验判断推进到参数动力学解释。对预训练研究员来说，这有三层启发。第一，训练效率不只是监督更密、更低方差，还和更新是否尽早进入正确子空间有关，这和预训练里常见的 low-rank update、module specialization、mid-layer importance 等现象是连着的。第二，论文把 RL 与 OPD 的差异落到模块边际效用和谱结构上，这为分析 SFT、RL、distillation、continual pretrain 之间的训练轨迹差异提供了可复用工具。第三，作者基于这个观察提出 EffOPD，用简单线性外推就能加速，说明如果一个训练范式早期方向已经足够稳定，那么后续很多算力可能只是沿既定方向缓慢推进。这对 cooldown、annealing、early stopping、trajectory extrapolation 都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法部分分成“解释”与“利用”两层。解释层面，作者先统一起点，用同一个 base model 分别做 RL 和 OPD，把最终参数差写成 ΔW。随后做了几类分析。其一是 norm-controlled scaling：固定最终更新方向，只缩放更新幅度 α，比较在相同更新范数下的性能曲线。结果显示 OPD 在同等 norm 下带来的推理增益更高，说明 RL 的 ΔW 中包含更多与任务弱相关的分量。其二是模块边际效用分析：按层、按模块统计 sensitivity 与 update norm，观察哪些区域“改得多但收益小”。作者发现 RL 与 OPD 对重要模块的敏感性排序并不完全不同，但 RL 会在低效模块上累计更大更新，尤其是一些对最终推理收益贡献有限的区域；OPD 则更早压低这些区域的更新，把预算集中到中间层等更关键模块。论文把这类现象称为 Functional Redundancy Avoidance。其三是更新方向的谱分析与子空间演化分析：对 checkpoint 间的更新矩阵做奇异值分解，考察能量是否集中在少数主方向，以及这些主方向与最终 checkpoint 更新子空间的夹角或对齐度。作者观察到 OPD 的更新更早呈现低秩集中，主子空间更稳定，且与最终解更早对齐；RL 的谱更分散，对齐更晚且波动更大。其四是早期 checkpoint 可恢复性实验：对早期 OPD checkpoint 做 module-wise norm scaling，发现只用约 10% 训练进度的方向信息，就能恢复约 80% 的最终推理性能。这是“早期已锁定主结构”的关键证据。

在利用层面，作者提出 EffOPD。核心做法很直接：既然 OPD 的当前更新方向在早期就与最终方向高度一致，那么可以沿当前方向做线性外推，减少实际训练步数与样本数。它不是加新模块，也不是改 loss，而是一个 plug-and-play 的训练加速策略。论文强调它与现有加速手段正交，意味着可以叠加在已有 OPD pipeline 上。这里真正值得注意的不是线性外推本身，而是它成立的前提：训练轨迹必须足够稳定、方向漂移足够小。作者用前面的谱与子空间分析为这个前提提供了证据。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 1.5B 到 32B 参数规模，包含 pretrained、SFT-tuned 和 thinking 系列模型；RL baseline 包括 PPO、GRPO、DAPO，OPD 则使用 pattern-aligned teacher，通常来自同家族更强模型。关键结果有四类。第一，在最终 checkpoint 上做方向固定、幅度缩放时，OPD 在相同 update norm 下取得明显更高的 reasoning gain，支持“不是更新更大，而是更新更有效”。第二，模块分析显示 RL 在低边际收益模块上累积了更多冗余更新，而 OPD 更集中于中间层等对推理更关键的区域。第三，谱分析显示 OPD 的更新具有更强 low-rank concentration，主子空间更早与最终解对齐；RL 的更新方向更分散，后期还在持续修正。第四，EffOPD 在 1.5B–32B 多个设置上平均带来约 3× 训练加速，同时保持与 vanilla OPD 可比的最终性能。摘要和引言里还给出一个很关键的数字：对 OPD 而言，只用约 10% 训练进度的 checkpoint，经 module-wise norm scaling 后即可恢复约 80% 的最终 reasoning performance。这说明早期方向信息的含金量很高。

如果精读正文，建议特别留意作者是否报告了不同任务、不同 teacher-student gap、不同 RL 算法下子空间对齐曲线的一致性，以及 EffOPD 对超参的敏感性。因为这决定了“foresight”究竟是 OPD 的普遍属性，还是只在 pattern-aligned、同家族蒸馏里最明显。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着问题读，而不是顺着叙述读。先看 Figure 2 对应的 norm-controlled scaling 实验，确认作者要证明的不是“OPD 更新更小”而是“同样的更新量更有效”。再看 Functional Redundancy Avoidance 那一节，重点看层/模块粒度的 sensitivity 与 update norm 是否真的解耦，以及哪些模块被判定为低边际收益。然后看谱分析和子空间演化图，关注两个问题：一是 OPD 的低秩集中是否在训练很早就出现；二是“与最终解对齐”是用什么度量定义的。最后看 EffOPD，判断它到底是稳定可复现的工程技巧，还是高度依赖特定训练曲线形状。

如果只有 20 分钟，建议看 Introduction、Figure 2、谱分析主图、EffOPD 主结果表。若有 1 小时，值得把附录里不同模型规模和不同 RL baseline 的一致性结果也看掉，因为这决定结论能否外推到更广的 post-train 设置。对做预训练的人，最值得深挖的点不是 OPD 本身，而是“早期主子空间锁定”是否也出现在大规模 pretrain、mid-train domain shift、SFT 冷启动这些场景里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more specific question than the usual claim that OPD is simply easier to optimize than RL. It tries to identify the parameter-level mechanism behind that efficiency gap. Why does on-policy distillation reach a useful solution faster, and where exactly does the difference appear in the update trajectory? The authors decompose this into two issues. First, module allocation: under the same update budget, why does OPD convert parameter movement into reasoning gains more efficiently? Second, update direction: why does OPD move toward a final useful solution much earlier, while RL spends more time exploring and correcting? Their answer is a notion of “foresight.” OPD suppresses updates in low-marginal-utility regions early, and its updates collapse early onto a small set of stable dominant directions that are already well aligned with the final solution subspace.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is explanatory rather than purely algorithmic. It turns the vague intuition that distillation benefits from denser supervision into a concrete statement about update geometry. For pretraining researchers, this matters for three reasons. First, training efficiency is not only about lower-variance supervision; it is also about entering the right update subspace early. That connects directly to observations in pretraining around low-rank adaptation, module specialization, and the importance of middle layers. Second, the paper offers a reusable analysis lens for comparing RL, distillation, SFT, and continual pretraining through module utility and spectral structure. Third, the proposed EffOPD result suggests that once a training paradigm locks onto a stable direction early, a nontrivial fraction of later compute may just be slow progress along an already identified path. That has implications for cooldown schedules, early stopping, trajectory extrapolation, and compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two layers: explanation and exploitation. On the explanation side, the authors start from a shared base model and compare RL and OPD through their parameter deltas, ΔW. They then run several analyses. First is norm-controlled scaling: keep the final update direction fixed and scale only its magnitude by a factor α, then evaluate models of the form W_base + αΔW. OPD delivers larger reasoning gains than RL at the same update norm, which implies that RL contains more task-weak components in its update. Second is module-level marginal utility analysis: they inspect sensitivity and accumulated update norm across layers and modules, asking where the model changes a lot without corresponding performance benefit. Their finding is not that RL and OPD care about completely different modules, but that RL spends much more update budget on low-utility regions, whereas OPD suppresses those regions early and concentrates on more reasoning-critical modules, especially in middle layers. They call this Functional Redundancy Avoidance. Third is spectral and subspace evolution analysis: they study singular value concentration of updates across checkpoints and measure alignment between early dominant subspaces and the final update subspace. OPD shows stronger low-rank concentration, earlier stabilization, and much earlier alignment with the final solution. RL remains more diffuse and keeps rotating its update directions later into training. Fourth is early-checkpoint recoverability: after module-wise norm scaling, an OPD checkpoint at roughly 10% of training recovers about 80% of the final reasoning performance. This is a strong empirical sign that the main structure of the final solution is already present very early.

On the exploitation side, they propose EffOPD. The idea is simple: if OPD directions are already close to the final direction early in training, then one can linearly extrapolate along the current update direction and reduce the number of optimization steps and samples. This is not a new architecture or loss; it is a plug-and-play acceleration strategy built on the observed trajectory stability. The important point is not linear extrapolation by itself, but the condition under which it works: the training path must be directionally stable enough. The earlier spectral analysis is used to justify that condition.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span models from 1.5B to 32B parameters, including pretrained, SFT-tuned, and thinking-style models. RL baselines include PPO, GRPO, and DAPO. OPD uses pattern-aligned teachers, typically stronger models from the same family. The main empirical results are fourfold. First, under fixed update direction and matched update norm, OPD yields substantially larger reasoning gains than RL, supporting the claim that OPD updates are more task-relevant rather than merely smaller or larger. Second, module-level analysis shows that RL accumulates more redundant updates in low-marginal-utility modules, while OPD concentrates more on modules that matter for reasoning. Third, spectral analysis shows stronger low-rank concentration and earlier final-subspace alignment for OPD; RL updates are more dispersed and continue to drift later in training. Fourth, EffOPD delivers about 3× average training acceleration across multiple settings from 1.5B to 32B while maintaining final performance comparable to vanilla OPD. One especially important number appears early in the paper: an OPD checkpoint at only around 10% of training can recover roughly 80% of final reasoning performance after module-wise norm scaling. That is the clearest quantitative evidence for early directional lock-in.

When reading the full paper, it is worth checking how robust these findings are across tasks, teacher-student gaps, and RL variants. That determines whether “foresight” is a broad property of OPD or mainly a feature of same-family, pattern-aligned distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this one by following the claims, not the paper order. Start with the norm-controlled scaling result around Figure 2. That establishes the key point: OPD is not just moving parameters differently in size; it is using the same update budget more effectively. Then read the Functional Redundancy Avoidance section and inspect whether sensitivity and update norm really decouple at the module level, and which modules are identified as low utility. Next, read the spectral and subspace evolution analysis. Focus on two questions: how early does low-rank concentration emerge, and how exactly is alignment with the final solution measured? Finish with EffOPD and judge whether it is a robust engineering trick or something that depends strongly on a particular trajectory shape.

If time is limited to 20 minutes, read the introduction, the main scaling figure, the spectral plots, and the main EffOPD table. If you have an hour, the appendix is worth reading for consistency across scales and RL baselines. For a pretraining audience, the most interesting follow-up question is not OPD itself, but whether early dominant-subspace lock-in also appears in large-scale pretraining, mid-training domain shifts, or SFT warm-start regimes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §更新子空间分析即可；如果早期子空间对齐稳定，这个诊断可迁移到 SFT/RL 的训练预算裁剪。
recommendation.en: Read the update-subspace analysis; if early alignment is stable, the diagnostic is reusable for pruning SFT/RL training budgets.

paper.title: Detecting overfitting in Neural Networks during long-horizon grokking using Random Matrix Theory
paper.abstract: Training Neural Networks (NNs) without overfitting is difficult; detecting that overfitting is difficult as well. We present a novel Random Matrix Theory method that detects the onset of overfitting in deep learning models without access to train or test data. For each model layer, we randomize each weight matrix element-wise, $\mathbf{W} \to \mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{rand}}$, fit the randomized empirical spectral distribution with a Marchenko-Pastur distribution, and identify large outliers that viol

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：在没有训练集、验证集、优化器状态和完整 checkpoint 历史的情况下，能否只从权重中识别模型是否进入了有害过拟合。论文把 long-horizon grokking 作为可观测实验场景，区分 pre-grokking、grokking 和 anti-grokking。关键点是 pre-grokking 和 anti-grokking 都可能表现为训练准确率高、测试准确率低，但前者是尚未学到泛化结构，后者是学到后又丢失了泛化结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把过拟合诊断从 loss/accuracy 曲线转向 weight-only diagnostics。对于开源基座模型、持续预训练 checkpoint、长程训练后的模型筛查，这类方法有实际吸引力，因为很多时候无法访问训练数据和 held-out loss。贡献更像一个诊断假设和实证工具，而不是已经可直接用于大规模预训练质量认证的方法。原因是实验主体仍以 grokking 和受控任务为主，GPT-OSS 20B/120B 的筛查更像示例性分析，尚不能证明 trap profile 与真实下游鲁棒性之间存在稳定因果关系。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于随机矩阵理论。对每个线性层权重矩阵 W，先做 element-wise shuffle 得到 W_rand，再构造协方差矩阵 X_rand = 1/N · W_rand^T W_rand。若权重元素在随机化后接近独立同分布，谱分布应接近 Marchenko-Pastur bulk，右边界附近只有 Tracy-Widom 量级的有限样本波动。论文把明显越过 MP/TW 右边界的谱离群点定义为 Correlation Traps。直觉是：这些离群方向表示非 self-averaging 的结构，一小部分方向主导统计量，可能对应训练后期形成的脆弱相关性。与直接看原始权重谱不同，shuffle 后再拟合 MP 是为了构造一个更接近 i.i.d. 的 null model，避免把普通结构化学习信号都当成异常。论文还用 eigenvector localization、condensation 等现象解释 trap 的非随机性，并尝试通过基于 JSD 的行为测试区分 harmful traps 和 benign traps。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个受控设置：MNIST MLP、modular addition Transformer，以及 GPT2-style Transformer 的 long-horizon grokking。共同现象是：在模型进入泛化阶段时，trap count 保持较低；当训练继续推进、测试准确率下降而训练准确率仍保持高位时，Correlation Traps 开始形成，并在数量和尺度上增长。这个信号能区分 pre-grokking 与 anti-grokking，虽然二者从 train/test accuracy 的粗粒度形态上可能相似。论文还对 GPT-OSS 20B/120B checkpoint 做 layer-wise trap profile 筛查，展示该方法可扩展到 foundation-scale 权重分析。提供内容中没有足够细节确认具体阈值、各层 trap 数量、JSD 数字或与下游评测的相关系数，因此不宜把它解读为已完成的大模型质量评估标准。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看方法定义部分，尤其是为什么要 shuffle 权重、如何拟合 MP bulk、如何用 MP/TW 右边界定义 trap。然后看三组 grokking 实验的曲线，关注 trap count 与 test accuracy 下降的时间关系。GPT-OSS 20B/120B 的 layer profile 可以快速扫一遍，主要看方法在大权重矩阵上的工程可行性。需要谨慎阅读的是因果解释部分：spectral outlier 与有害过拟合之间还需要更多真实预训练 checkpoint、不同数据配比、不同优化器和不同架构的验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether harmful overfitting can be detected from model weights alone, without access to training data, validation losses, optimizer state, or checkpoint history. It uses long-horizon grokking as the controlled setting, where pre-grokking, grokking, and post-generalization anti-grokking can be observed in one training run.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the weight-only diagnostic angle. If reliable, this kind of method could help triage open-weight checkpoints, continual-pretraining runs, and long training jobs where held-out curves are missing or incomplete. The current contribution should be read as a promising diagnostic hypothesis rather than a mature foundation-model certification method. The strongest evidence comes from controlled grokking setups; the large-model screening is informative but does not yet establish a robust link to downstream robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each layer matrix W, the method shuffles entries element-wise to form W_rand and computes X_rand = 1/N · W_rand^T W_rand. Under an approximately i.i.d. null, the empirical spectral distribution should follow a Marchenko-Pastur bulk, with finite-size fluctuations near the right edge described by Tracy-Widom behavior. Outliers far beyond this edge are called Correlation Traps. The interpretation is that these outliers mark non-self-averaging structure: a small number of directions dominate the layer statistics and may encode brittle correlations. The shuffle step is important because it defines a simpler random-matrix null; the paper is not merely counting large singular values in the original trained weights.
summary_en.experiments: The reported controlled experiments include an MNIST MLP, a Transformer on modular addition, and a GPT2-style Transformer in a long-horizon grokking regime. In all three cases, trap counts remain low while generalization improves, then grow when the model enters anti-grokking: training accuracy stays high, but test accuracy deteriorates. This separates anti-grokking from pre-grokking, even though both can look similar under coarse train/test accuracy summaries. The paper also applies the layer-wise trap analysis to GPT-OSS 20B and 120B checkpoints. The supplied content does not provide enough detail to quote exact trap counts, thresholds, JSD values, or downstream correlations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is sufficient. Read the definition of Correlation Traps carefully: the shuffle procedure, MP fitting, and right-edge outlier criterion are the core mechanics. Then inspect the grokking figures and compare the timing of trap formation with the drop in test accuracy. The large-checkpoint profiles are worth scanning for scalability and layerwise behavior. Treat the causal interpretation with caution; the next evidence needed would be systematic validation on real pretraining runs with known data, optimizer, and evaluation histories.

recommendation.zh: 做预训练健康监控和grokking研究的可以参考，Correlation Traps的谱检测思路可落地到训练pipeline中
recommendation.en: Referenceable for researchers working on pretraining health monitoring and grokking; the spectral Correlation Traps detection method can be implemented in training pipelines.

paper.title: Learning Rate Transfer in Normalized Transformers
paper.abstract: The Normalized Transformer, or nGPT (arXiv:2410.01131) achieves impressive training speedups and does not require weight decay or learning rate warmup. However, despite having hyperparameters that explicitly scale with model size, we observe that nGPT does not exhibit learning rate transfer across model dimension and token horizon. To rectify this, we combine numerical experiments with a principled use of alignment exponents (arXiv:2407.05872) to revisit and modify the $μ$P approach to hyperpara

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 nGPT 在实际放大时的学习率迁移问题。nGPT 通过大量归一化约束权重和激活范数，去掉了 weight decay 和 learning-rate warmup，并能提升训练速度；但作者观察到，原始 nGPT 即使带有随模型尺寸显式缩放的超参数，也不能稳定地把小模型、小 token horizon 上扫出的学习率迁移到更宽、更深、训练更久的模型上。问题不只是“学习率怎么调”，而是归一化 Transformer 下 μP 式宽度参数化所依赖的权重-激活对齐假设不再合适。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的价值在于，它把超参数迁移从常规 Transformer 推进到 normalized Transformer。nGPT 这类模型的吸引力在于训练稳定、无需 warmup/weight decay，但如果学习率不能跨 width、depth、token horizon 迁移，大规模训练仍然需要昂贵搜索。论文提出的 νGPT 给出了一套面向 nGPT 的参数化和学习率缩放规则，目标是让小规模实验能更可靠地预测大规模设置。贡献类型偏训练参数化和 scaling practice，不是新架构本身；量级上属于会影响预训练实验设计的工作，尤其适合关心 μP、Depth-μP、normalized networks 和 cooldown/长 horizon 调参的人读。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是重新检查 μP 在 nGPT 上的适用条件，而不是直接套用 μP。作者借用 Everett et al. 的 alignment exponent 框架，测量训练中权重矩阵与输入激活之间的对齐程度。μP 常见推导依赖某些矩阵-向量乘法的尺度假设；作者发现 nGPT 中的权重-激活对齐不满足这些假设。于是论文采用一个经验支持的 mid-alignment 假设：权重和激活既不是完全随机独立，也不是完全对齐，而是处在中间状态。基于这个假设，作者重新推导宽度放大时学习率应如何缩放，并把得到的新参数化称为 νGPT。

深度方向上，论文采用 Bordelon et al. 和 Dey et al. 一类工作的启发，关注 residual block 随层数放大时的尺度。相关背景是 residual 更新可写成 h_{l+1}=h_l+n_layers^{-alpha_depth}F_l(h_l)，alpha_depth 控制每层残差贡献。文献中 alpha_depth=1/2 与 alpha_depth=1 对是否能迁移存在分歧；作者选择更稳的深度迁移方案，并强调深模型稳定性。token horizon 方向上，作者测得 nGPT 的最优学习率随训练 token 数近似按 #tokens^{-1/3} 缩放，这一点与 Bjorck et al. 在非归一化 Transformer 上的观测一致。最终 νGPT 同时处理 width、depth 和 token horizon，而不是只做单一维度的学习率迁移。
summary.experiments: 实验结论集中在三条。第一，作者测量了 nGPT 中的权重-激活 alignment，并用实验支持 mid-alignment 假设；对应结果在 Figure 2。这个实验是全文的关键，因为它解释了为什么原始 μP 假设不能直接搬到 nGPT。第二，宽度迁移实验显示 νGPT 比 μP 在 nGPT 上更稳，Figure 7 给出对比。论文表述为“somewhat better than μP”，因此应理解为稳定改进，而不是数量级差距。第三，深度迁移实验显示 νGPT 在更深模型上保持高稳定性，Figure 3 是重点。token horizon 实验给出最优学习率约按 token 数的 -1/3 次方缩放。总体性能上，νGPT 与调好的原始 nGPT baseline 相比没有性能损失，Figure 1 给出主结果。提示中可见的全文片段没有列出具体参数量、token 规模和精确 loss 数字；读原文时需要从实验表格和附录补齐这些数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Section 2、Section 3、Section 3.1，以及 Figure 1/2/3/7。Section 2 主要用于确认 nGPT 的归一化细节和可训练 scale 参数，因为这些设计决定了尺度分析不能照搬普通 Transformer。Section 3 和 3.1 是核心，应重点看 alignment exponent 如何定义、mid-alignment 如何从测量结果进入推导、νGPT 对不同参数组的学习率和初始化如何设定。Figure 2 用来判断理论假设是否可信；Figure 7 用来看 νGPT 与 μP 在宽度迁移上的差别；Figure 3 用来看深度放大是否稳定；Figure 1 用来看新参数化是否牺牲了原始 nGPT 的训练效果。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 alignment 在训练早期、中期、后期是否变化，二是 #tokens^{-1/3} 的 horizon scaling 能否和 batch size、optimizer、cooldown 一起形成可操作的调参规则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses learning-rate transfer for normalized Transformers, specifically nGPT. nGPT constrains weight and activation norms through extensive normalization, removes the need for weight decay and learning-rate warmup, and trains fast when well tuned. The problem is that its original parameterization does not reliably transfer the optimal learning rate across width, depth, or training-token horizon. The paper argues that this failure comes from applying μP-style assumptions in a regime where the weight-activation alignment behavior of nGPT is different from that of standard Transformer parameterizations.
summary_en.importance: The practical contribution is a scaling recipe for normalized Transformer pretraining. If nGPT-like models are to be used at larger scale, the main bottleneck is not only architecture stability but also whether small-scale sweeps can predict large-scale hyperparameters. νGPT is meant to make that extrapolation possible across model width, number of layers, and token budget. For pretraining researchers, the paper is useful because it connects three usually separate issues: μP-style width transfer, residual-depth scaling, and token-horizon learning-rate scaling. It is not a new language-modeling objective; it is a parameterization and optimization-scaling paper with direct implications for large-run planning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper starts by testing whether the assumptions behind standard μP apply to nGPT. It uses the alignment-exponent framework of Everett et al. to measure how weight matrices and activations align during training. The key empirical observation is that nGPT does not match the alignment assumptions usually used in μP derivations. The authors therefore introduce a mid-alignment assumption: weights and activations are neither independent in the random-feature sense nor fully aligned, but partially aligned. Under this assumption, they derive a different width-scaling prescription for the learning rate and package it as a new nGPT parameterization called νGPT.

For depth transfer, the paper follows the line of work that studies residual networks with updates of the form h_{l+1}=h_l+n_layers^{-alpha_depth}F_l(h_l). The choice of alpha_depth controls the relative contribution of each residual block as depth grows. Prior work disagrees on whether alpha_depth=1/2 can provide reliable depth transfer in realistic blocks, while alpha_depth=1 is more consistently stable. νGPT adopts a depth-scaling heuristic aligned with the stable-transfer side of that literature. For token horizon, the paper finds that the optimal learning rate in nGPT scales approximately as the number of training tokens to the power -1/3, consistent with measurements reported for unnormalized Transformers. The final recipe combines width, depth, and horizon scaling rather than treating learning-rate transfer as a width-only issue.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental evidence has four main parts. First, the authors measure weight-activation alignment in nGPT and show that the observed behavior supports the mid-alignment assumption; Figure 2 is the central evidence for this claim. Second, width-transfer experiments compare νGPT with μP and show that νGPT transfers learning rates somewhat better for nGPT; Figure 7 is the relevant comparison. Third, depth-transfer experiments show stable behavior for deep νGPT models; Figure 3 is the key result. Fourth, token-horizon experiments estimate the optimal learning-rate scaling as #tokens^{-1/3}. The main performance comparison reports no loss relative to a well-tuned original nGPT baseline; Figure 1 summarizes that point. The provided text does not expose exact parameter counts, token budgets, or loss numbers, so those should be checked directly in the experimental tables and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Sections 2, 3, and 3.1 carefully. Section 2 matters because nGPT’s normalization and trainable scale parameters determine the correct scale analysis. Sections 3 and 3.1 contain the main derivation: how alignment exponents are measured, why the usual μP assumptions fail, and how the νGPT learning-rate prescription is obtained. The most important figures are Figure 2 for the alignment evidence, Figure 7 for width transfer against μP, Figure 3 for depth stability, and Figure 1 for the no-regression comparison against tuned nGPT. The most useful follow-up questions are whether alignment changes systematically over training time, whether the #tokens^{-1/3} rule interacts with batch-size scaling, and whether νGPT remains stable under different optimizers or long-horizon cooldown schedules.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻读宽度与 token-horizon transfer 实验；若结论稳，normalized Transformer 的调参流程要改。
recommendation.en: Read the width and token-horizon transfer experiments first; if they hold up, normalized-Transformer tuning protocols need revision.

commentary.article_excerpt: 大模型任我行 关注 Meta：超参跨尺度无损迁移 📖标题：Learning Rate Transfer in Normalized Transformers 🌐来源：arXiv, 2604.27077v2 🛎️文章简介 🔸研究问题：如何在归一化 Transformer（nGPT）架构中，修正现有参数化方法的不足，以实现学习率在模型宽度、深度及训练 token 数量上的有效迁移？ 🔸主要贡献：论文提出了名为νGPT 的新型参数化方案，通过引入中间对齐假设和实证缩放律，成功实现了 nGPT 在宽、深及时序维度上的超参数无损迁移。 📝重点思路 🔸基于对齐指数理论，摒弃了传统µP 假设的完全对齐或无对齐极端情况， empirically 验证并采用了权重与激活部分对齐的“中间对齐”假设（指数为 3/4），据此推导出隐藏层学习率随宽度变化的缩放规则。 🔸针对深度扩展，借鉴启发式方法，将残差连接中的可学习缩放参数初始值设为与深度成反比，而非调整隐藏层学习率，从而在保证深层模型稳定性的同时实现深度迁移。 🔸重新设计了嵌入层、隐藏层及输出层的独立学习率缩放系数，确保各模块在不同尺度下更新幅度一致。 🔎分析总结 🔸实验表明，原始 nGPT 在改变模型宽度时无法保持学习率的有效性，而νGPT 在头数从 8 扩展到 40 的过程中展现了近乎完美的学习率迁移能力，且性能略优于 µP 风格修正。 🔸在深度扩展实验中，νGPT 不仅复现了基线模型良好的深度迁移特性，还显著提升了极深模型（如 128 层）的训练稳定性，证明了深度修正参数的有效性。 🔸通过对齐指数的动态测量发现，训练过程中权重与激活的对齐程度并非固定为 0.5 或 1，而是介于两者之间，证实了采用 0.75 作为对齐指数进行理论推导的正确性。 🔸验证了学习率随训练步长增加而降低的规律符合幂律，该结论与非归一化 Transformer 的观测结果一致，修正了以往随机微分方程理论预测的偏差。 💡个人观点 论文通过细致的实证测量发现了“中间对齐”现象，并据此构建了更贴合归一化 Transformer 特性的νGPT 参数化体系。 #LLM #大模型 #transformer #论文分享 #Meta 1小时前

paper.title: How to Train Your Latent Diffusion Language Model Jointly With the Latent Space
paper.abstract: Latent diffusion models offer an attractive alternative to discrete diffusion for non-autoregressive text generation by operating on continuous text representations and denoising entire sequences in parallel. The major challenge in latent diffusion modeling is constructing a suitable latent space. In this work, we present the Latent Diffusion Language Model (LDLM), in which the latent encoder, diffusion model, and decoder are trained jointly. LDLM builds its latent space by reshaping the represe

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是连续潜空间 diffusion LM 的关键瓶颈：文本 latent 既要容易被扩散模型去噪，又要能稳定解码回 token。已有 latent diffusion LM 通常冻结一个预训练 encoder，把它的表示当作扩散空间；这样做训练简单，但 latent 并不是为 diffusion 目标优化的。直接端到端联合训练 encoder、diffusion model 和 decoder 又会带来退化，论文观察到的主要现象是生成多样性下降和 diffusion 质量变差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它把“语言建模目标”和“表示空间构造”重新绑在一起。AR LM 的 token space 是固定的，离散 diffusion LM 也常受限于逐位置独立预测；连续 latent diffusion 如果要成为可扩展的语言建模范式，latent space 不能只是一个冻结 encoder 的副产物。LDLM 给出了一个可训练 recipe，说明 contextual latent 可以在联合训练中被塑造成更适合并行去噪的空间。贡献量级主要在建模范式和训练动态层面，而不是单一 benchmark 的增量改进。
summary.technical_approach: LDLM 使用两级编码。第一层是冻结的 GPT-2 token encoder，提取上下文 hidden states；第二层是可训练 latent encoder，把这些 hidden states 映射到 diffusion latent。扩散模型在该 latent 空间中做 Gaussian denoising，目标是从带噪 latent 预测干净 latent。解码也采用两级结构：先把 latent 解回语言模型表示空间，再映射到 token。关键点不是简单把 encoder 接到 diffusion model 前面，而是控制联合训练的梯度和重构约束。论文指出，朴素联合训练会让 latent 空间朝“扩散损失容易下降”的方向塌缩，但这种空间未必保留足够 token 信息，也未必支持多样生成。为此作者加入 MSE decoder loss，用连续表示重构约束稳定 decoder 与 latent geometry；同时加入 diffusion-to-encoder 方向的训练控制，避免扩散目标直接把 encoder 推到低信息或低多样性的解。这个设计和冻结 encoder 的 latent diffusion 不同：冻结方案依赖预训练表示的偶然适配性，LDLM 则让 latent encoder 在训练中重排表示，使其同时满足 denoising 和 decoding。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LM1B 和 OpenWebText。论文比较了多类文本 diffusion 空间，包括浅层 token embedding、冻结 contextual encoder 表示、以及联合学习的 contextual latent。主要结果是，联合学习的 contextual latent 在生成质量上优于这些替代方案，并且在同等或更好质量下比近期离散和连续 diffusion LM 快约 2 到 13 倍。消融重点显示：朴素端到端训练会产生低多样性样本；MSE decoder loss 对保持 latent 可解码性和训练稳定性有明显作用；diffusion 与 encoder 之间的梯度处理决定了模型是否会学到兼顾去噪与语义保真的 latent。论文还强调 few-step generation 的差异：离散 diffusion 每步通常按位置独立预测 token，少步生成质量容易受限；连续 latent diffusion 在最终解码前逐步细化整段表示，因此更适合并行修正。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Method、训练 recipe 和 ablation 部分。Introduction 里关于 discrete diffusion 的逐位置因子化问题，以及 frozen encoder latent 的局限，是理解论文动机的关键。Method 重点看两级 encoder/decoder 如何连接，尤其是哪些模块冻结、哪些模块训练。训练 recipe 和消融表需要细看：这里决定了“联合训练为什么会失败”以及“哪些约束让它重新可用”。实验部分建议重点看 LM1B、OpenWebText 主表、速度-质量对比图，以及不同 latent space 的比较。值得深挖的是 latent collapse 或低多样性背后的机制：扩散 MSE、latent 尺度、表示信息量、decoder 可逆性之间存在张力，这对后续设计非 AR 语言模型很有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the central failure mode of latent diffusion language models: the latent representation must be both denoisable by a diffusion model and reliably decodable into tokens. Prior systems usually freeze a pretrained text encoder and diffuse in its representation space. That is convenient, but the space is not optimized for diffusion. Naive end-to-end training of the encoder, diffusion model, and decoder also fails; the paper reports degraded diffusion quality and low-diversity generations.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is in language modeling objectives and representation learning. If continuous diffusion is to be a serious alternative to left-to-right next-token modeling, the text latent space cannot remain an incidental byproduct of a pretrained encoder. LDLM shows that the latent space can be learned jointly with the generative objective, provided the training dynamics are controlled. This is a modeling contribution rather than a narrow benchmark improvement: it clarifies how denoising, decodability, and diversity interact in non-autoregressive text generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: LDLM uses a two-stage encoder. A frozen GPT-2 encoder first produces contextual hidden states. A trainable latent encoder then reshapes these hidden states into the continuous space used by Gaussian diffusion. The diffusion model learns to recover clean latents from noisy latents. Decoding is also staged: latents are mapped back toward the language-model representation space and then decoded into tokens. The important part is the training recipe. Directly propagating the diffusion objective through the whole encoder-decoder stack can produce latents that reduce denoising loss but lose useful information or diversity. The paper adds an MSE decoder loss to keep the latent space reconstructive and uses a controlled diffusion-to-encoder training path so that the encoder is shaped for diffusion without collapsing into a degenerate solution. This differs from frozen-encoder latent diffusion, where the model inherits a representation space trained for a different objective.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are run on LM1B and OpenWebText. The paper compares shallow token embeddings, frozen contextual representations, and jointly learned contextual latents. The jointly learned latent space gives better generation quality than the alternatives and is reported to be about 2 to 13 times faster than recent discrete and continuous diffusion language models at comparable or better quality. The ablations are more informative than the headline numbers. Naive joint training leads to low-diversity outputs. The MSE decoder loss improves decodability and stabilizes the latent geometry. The way diffusion gradients interact with the encoder is critical: without this control, the learned space can become easy to denoise but poor for text generation. The results also support the paper’s broader claim that continuous latent diffusion is better suited to few-step parallel refinement than token-space discrete diffusion, where each denoising step often predicts positions independently.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the motivation, method, and ablation sections carefully. The motivation section explains why discrete diffusion’s position-wise factorization limits high-quality few-step generation and why frozen encoder latents are not enough. In the method section, focus on which components are frozen, which are trained, and how the two-stage encoder and decoder are wired. The most important technical material is in the training recipe and ablations: those parts explain why joint training fails and which constraints make it work. In the results, prioritize the LM1B and OpenWebText quality-speed comparisons and the latent-space comparison tables. A useful follow-up question is how latent scale, reconstruction fidelity, denoising difficulty, and sample diversity trade off during training.

recommendation.zh: 应读训练 recipe 和 ablation；它把 latent LM 的失败点落到 joint training 动态，而不只是 tokenizer 选择。
recommendation.en: Read the training recipe and ablations; the useful signal is that latent-LM failure is about joint-training dynamics, not just tokenizer choice.

paper.title: Beyond Reasoning: Reinforcement Learning Unlocks Parametric Knowledge in LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in LLM reasoning, but whether it can also improve direct recall of parametric knowledge remains an open question. We study this question in a controlled zero-shot, one-hop, closed-book QA setting with no chain-of-thought, training only on binary correctness rewards and applying fact-level train-test deduplication to ensure gains reflect improved recall rather than reasoning or memorization. Across three model families and multiple factu

summary.core_problem: 检验 RL 是否只能提升推理，还是也能在无 CoT、闭卷、一跳事实问答中提升 LLM 的参数知识召回。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控实证和机制分析。它把 RL 的作用从 reasoning-time search 扩展到 parametric knowledge recall，并用 fact-level train-test deduplication 和无 CoT 设置排除记忆泄漏与显式推理因素，对理解 RL 与预训练知识的接口很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 在 zero-shot、one-hop、closed-book QA 中训练模型，只使用二元正确性奖励，不引入 chain-of-thought。通过事实级去重保证测试事实未在训练中重复，并用采样分布和数据归因分析区分“学到新事实”与“重排已有知识概率质量”。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三个模型家族和多个事实 QA benchmark。RL 带来约 27% 平均相对提升，并超过训练时和推理时 baseline。机制上，RL 主要把正确答案从低概率尾部推到 greedy generation 可稳定输出的位置，而不是真正获取新事实。数据归因显示最难样本最有训练价值：pre-RL 采样 128 次也从未出现正确答案的样本只占约 18%，却驱动了主要收益。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学院计算技术研究所、人工智能安全全国重点实验室和中国科学院大学；摘要中未能确认更具体的知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether RL can improve parametric knowledge recall, not only reasoning, in no-CoT closed-book one-hop QA.
summary_en.importance: This is a controlled empirical and mechanistic study. It extends the role of RL from reasoning-time behavior to recall of stored knowledge, using fact-level train-test deduplication and a no-chain-of-thought setup to reduce leakage and reasoning confounds.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup trains with binary correctness rewards in zero-shot, one-hop, closed-book QA and removes chain-of-thought. The analysis uses fact-level deduplication, sampling-distribution inspection, and data attribution to separate new fact acquisition from probability-mass redistribution over existing knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers three model families and multiple factual QA benchmarks. RL gives roughly 27% average relative gains and beats both training-time and inference-time baselines. Mechanistically, RL mostly moves correct answers from the low-probability tail into reliable greedy generations rather than acquiring new facts. The hardest examples are most informative: examples whose answers never appear in 128 pre-RL samples make up about 18% of training data but drive the main gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, the State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, and the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; no widely known author background can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改 prior：RL 不只是推理搜索，还能重排预训练知识概率；应复现 hard-example attribution。
recommendation.en: This changes a prior: RL can reorder pretrained knowledge probabilities, not just improve reasoning; reproduce the hard-example attribution.
